179: def _anchor_payload(documents: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...], runtime_epoch: str) -> str:
180:     if runtime_epoch not in {"strict", "fresh"}:
181:         raise AdoptionApplyError("adoption runtime epoch must be strict or fresh")
182:     body: dict[str, Any] = {
183:         "protocol": 1 if runtime_epoch == "strict" else 2,
184:         "documents": [dict(document) for document in documents],
185:     }
186:     if runtime_epoch == "fresh":
187:         body["runtime_epoch"] = "fresh-after-anchor-v1"
188:     return json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))

193:     return path.with_name(path.name + ".arrival-adopt.intent")

207: def _require_cache(plan: ArrivalAdoptionPlan) -> None:
208:     try:
209:         actual = plan.target_path.read_bytes()
210:     except OSError as exc:
211:         raise AdoptionStale(f"reviewed declaration cache is unavailable: {exc}") from exc
212:     if (
213:         actual != _cache_bytes(plan)
214:         or hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest() != plan.declaration_sha256
215:     ):
216:         raise AdoptionStale("reviewed declaration bytes changed")

219: def _selected_documents(
220:     text: str, target: Path, descriptor: StoreDescriptor
221: ) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], ...]:
222:     try:
223:         ast = parse_vertex(text, path=target)
224:         validate_vertex(ast)
225:         validate_arrival_runtime_identity(ast.name, ast.loops, refusal=AdoptionPreparationRefused)
226:         backend = ast.store_backend
227:         if (
228:             backend is None or backend.name != descriptor.backend
229:             or backend.lineage != descriptor.lineage
230:             or backend.role != Profile.AUTHORITY.value
231:         ):
232:             raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(
233:                 "reviewed declaration residence differs from authority descriptor"
234:             )
235:         location = (
236:             str(canonical_store_path(ast.store, target))
237:             if descriptor.backend == "file" and ast.store is not None
238:             else ast.store_location
239:         )
240:         if location != descriptor.location:
241:             raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(
242:                 "reviewed declaration store location differs from authority descriptor"
243:             )
244:         documents = tuple(document.as_json() for document in vertex_to_documents(ast))
245:         seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
246:         for document in documents:
247:             identity = (document["kind"], document["subject"])
248:             if identity in seen:
249:                 raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(f"duplicate declaration document {identity!r}")
250:             seen.add(identity)
251:         return documents
252:     except AdoptionPreparationRefused:
253:         raise
254:     except Exception as exc:
255:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(f"reviewed declaration is invalid: {exc}") from exc
256: 
257: 
258: def _scan_identity(records: tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...], lineage: str) -> None:
259:     for record in records:
260:         if record["k"] not in {"fact", "batch"}:
261:             continue
262:         for kind, row in rows_of_body(record["k"], record["body"]):
263:             if kind != "fact":
264:                 continue
265:             fact_id, fact_kind, _at, _observer, _origin, payload, _signature = row
266:             if fact_id == lineage:
267:                 raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(
268:                     "physical-lineage fact ID already occurs in captured prefix"
269:                 )
270:             if not fact_kind.startswith("_decl."):
271:                 continue
272:             try:
273:                 data = json.loads(payload)
274:             except ValueError:
275:                 continue
276:             if isinstance(data, dict) and data.get("lineage") == lineage:
277:                 raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(
278:                     "historical declaration overlay claims physical lineage"
279:                 )

282: def prepare_arrival_adoption(
283:     registry: BackendRegistry,
284:     descriptor: StoreDescriptor,
285:     *, target: Path | str, selected_head: Head,
286:     reviewed_text: str, reviewed_sha256: str, declaration_text: str,
287:     observer: str, credentials: WriteCredentials,
288:     fact_verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool],
289:     arrival_verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool],
290:     authored_at: float | None = None,
291:     runtime_epoch: Literal["strict", "fresh"] = "strict",
292: ) -> ArrivalAdoptionPlan:
293:     """Capture Full(S), verify the migration registry and sign one exact anchor."""
294:     target_path = Path(target).resolve()
295:     if descriptor.role is not Profile.AUTHORITY or not descriptor.lineage:
296:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused("adoption requires a lineage-pinned Authority descriptor")
297:     if not isinstance(selected_head, Head) or selected_head.lineage != descriptor.lineage:
298:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused("selected head must name the descriptor lineage")
299:     if not observer or not isinstance(observer, str):
300:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused("adopting observer must be explicit")
301:     if not credentials.mapped or credentials.signature_verifier is None:
302:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused("adoption requires pre-created mapped credentials")
303:     if not callable(fact_verify) or not callable(arrival_verify):
304:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused("adoption requires public FACT and ARRIVAL verifiers")
305:     if runtime_epoch not in {"strict", "fresh"}:
306:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused("adoption runtime epoch must be strict or fresh")
307:     if not all(
308:         isinstance(value, str)
309:         for value in (reviewed_text, reviewed_sha256, declaration_text)
310:     ):
311:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused("reviewed and published declaration text are required")
312:     reviewed = reviewed_text.encode("utf-8")
313:     if hashlib.sha256(reviewed).hexdigest() != reviewed_sha256:
314:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused("reviewed snapshot SHA-256 differs from selected text")
315:     published = declaration_text.encode("utf-8")
316:     try:
317:         if target_path.read_bytes() != published:
318:             raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(
319:                 "published declaration bytes differ from supplied authority text"
320:             )
321:     except OSError as exc:
322:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(f"copied declaration is unavailable: {exc}") from exc
323:     documents = _selected_documents(declaration_text, target_path, descriptor)
324:     try:
325:         reviewed_ast = parse_vertex(reviewed_text, path=target_path)
326:         validate_vertex(reviewed_ast)
327:         reviewed_documents = tuple(
328:             document.as_json() for document in vertex_to_documents(reviewed_ast)
329:         )
330:     except Exception as exc:
331:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(f"reviewed source snapshot is invalid: {exc}") from exc
332:     if reviewed_documents != documents:
333:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(
334:             "published authority declaration differs from reviewed source documents"
335:         )
336:     ledger = query = None
337:     try:
338:         ledger, query = registry.open(descriptor)
339:         captured = ledger.head()
340:         if captured != selected_head or ledger.verify(Full(through=selected_head)) != selected_head:
341:             raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(
342:                 "selected migration head is stale or not Full-verified"
343:             )
344:         records = tuple(ledger.scan(through=selected_head))
345:         _scan_identity(records, captured.lineage)
346:         keys, _evidence = key_registry_from_records(records, arrival_verify)
347:         valid = tuple(key for key, _ordinal in keys.keys_valid_at(observer, captured.ordinal + 1))
348:         if not valid:
349:             raise AdoptionPreparationRefused("adopting observer has no key valid at selected head")
350:         for document in documents:
351:             if document["kind"] != DECL_OBSERVER_DEFINED:
352:                 continue
353:             key = document["payload"].get("key")
354:             if key is not None:
355:                 named = document["subject"]
356:                 named_valid = {
357:                     item for item, _ordinal in keys.keys_valid_at(named, captured.ordinal + 1)
358:                 }
359:                 if key not in named_valid:
360:                     raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(
361:                         f"declared observer {named!r} key is not valid at selected head"
362:                     )
363:         if ledger.capabilities().max_atomic_records == 0:
364:             raise AdoptionPreparationRefused("backend cannot append an adoption anchor")
365:     except AdoptionPreparationRefused:
366:         raise
367:     except Exception as exc:
368:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(f"cannot establish adoption prefix: {exc}") from exc
369:     finally:
370:         _close(query)
371:         _close(ledger)
372: 
373:     try:
374:         preflight_projection_maintenance(registry, descriptor, through=captured)
375:     except Exception as exc:
376:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(
377:             f"required projection maintenance is unavailable at S: {exc}"
378:         ) from exc
379: 
380:     session = CredentialResolutionSession()
381:     context = CapturedSigningContext(captured, ((observer, valid),), ())
382:     namespace = credentials.binding_namespace
383:     assert namespace is not None
384:     def _sign(domain: SigningDomain) -> Callable[[str, str], str | None]:
385:         def sign(named: str, digest: str) -> str | None:
386:             request = CredentialRequest(namespace, named, domain, CredentialPurpose.AUTHORSHIP)
387:             return session.sign(
388:                 credentials, request, digest, context=context,
389:                 authorized_keys=context.keys_for_author(named), required=True,
390:             )
391:         return sign
392:     at = time.time() if authored_at is None else authored_at
393:     try:
394:         draft = build_declaration_anchor_draft(
395:             lineage=captured.lineage, authored_at=at, observer=observer,
396:             documents=documents, fact_signer=_sign(SigningDomain.FACT),
397:             arrival_signer=_sign(SigningDomain.ARRIVAL),
398:             runtime_epoch=runtime_epoch,
399:         )
400:     except CredentialBindingRefused as exc:
401:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(f"mapped adoption binding refused: {exc}") from exc
402:     except Exception as exc:
403:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(f"cannot sign adoption anchor: {exc}") from exc
404:     bindings = session.evidence
405:     if (
406:         len(bindings) != 2
407:         or bindings[0].request.domain is not SigningDomain.FACT
408:         or bindings[1].request.domain is not SigningDomain.ARRIVAL
409:         or bindings[0].public_key != bindings[1].public_key
410:         or bindings[0].public_key not in valid
411:     ):
412:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused("mapped adoption bindings disagree")
413:     bound_key = bindings[0].public_key
414:     if not isinstance(draft.signature, str) or not isinstance(
415:         draft.body.get("signature"), str
416:     ):
417:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused("draft signatures are missing")
418:     inner_digest = fact_commitment_hash(
419:         "_decl.genesis", at, observer, "", draft.body["payload"]
420:     )
421:     outer_digest = content_commitment("fact", at, observer, "", dict(draft.body))
422:     try:
423:         fact_ok = fact_verify(bound_key, draft.body["signature"], inner_digest)
424:         arrival_ok = arrival_verify(bound_key, draft.signature, outer_digest)
425:     except Exception as exc:
426:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(
427:             f"independent adoption signature verification failed: {exc}"
428:         ) from exc
429:     if not fact_ok or not arrival_ok:
430:         raise AdoptionPreparationRefused(
431:             "draft signatures do not verify under the selected mapped public key"
432:         )
433:     return ArrivalAdoptionPlan(
434:         target_path, descriptor, captured.lineage,
435:         ReadBasis(captured.lineage, captured, None, None), captured, observer,
436:         reviewed_text, reviewed_sha256, declaration_text,
437:         hashlib.sha256(published).hexdigest(), documents, draft,
438:         _exact_drafts((draft,)), bindings, runtime_epoch,
439:     )

442: def _intent_data(plan: ArrivalAdoptionPlan, phase: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
443:     return {
444:         "schema": _SCHEMA, "phase": phase, "target": str(plan.target_path),
445:         "descriptor": _descriptor_dict(plan.descriptor),
446:         "captured_head": _head_dict(plan.captured_head),
447:         "observer": plan.observer, "reviewed_text": plan.reviewed_text,
448:         "reviewed_sha256": plan.reviewed_sha256,
449:         "declaration_text": plan.declaration_text,
450:         "declaration_sha256": plan.declaration_sha256,
451:         "runtime_epoch": plan.runtime_epoch,
452:         "drafts": json.loads(plan.exact_drafts), "exact_drafts": plan.exact_drafts,
453:         "bindings": [
454:             {"request": {"namespace": evidence.request.namespace,
455:                          "observer": evidence.request.observer,
456:                          "domain": evidence.request.domain.value,
457:                          "purpose": evidence.request.purpose.value},
458:              "key_ref": evidence.key_ref, "algorithm": evidence.algorithm,
459:              "public_key": evidence.public_key, "provenance": evidence.provenance}
460:             for evidence in plan.credential_bindings
461:         ],
462:     }

465: def _result(plan: ArrivalAdoptionPlan, status: str, head: Head,
466:             commit: Commit | None, projection: ProjectionSyncResult | None,
467:             phase: str, file_written: bool,
468:             observed_head: Head | None = None) -> ArrivalAdoptionResult:
469:     return ArrivalAdoptionResult(
470:         status, plan.target_path, plan.descriptor, plan.lineage, plan.basis,
471:         plan.captured_head, head, commit, plan.fact_ids, None, phase,
472:         file_written, projection, plan.credential_bindings, observed_head,
473:         plan.runtime_epoch,
474:     )

476: 
477: def _finish(registry: BackendRegistry, plan: ArrivalAdoptionPlan,
478:             intent: Path, data: dict[str, Any], head: Head,
479:             commit: Commit | None, status: str,
480:             failure_hook: Callable[[str], None] | None,
481:             observed_head: Head | None = None) -> ArrivalAdoptionResult:
482:     projection = None
483:     try:
484:         projection = sync_projection(registry, plan.descriptor, through=head)
485:         if projection.projected_after.ordinal < head.ordinal:
486:             raise AdoptionApplyError("projection did not reach adoption head")
487:         data["phase"] = "synced"
488:         _replace_json(intent, data)
489:         if failure_hook:
490:             failure_hook("after-sync")
491:         _require_cache(plan)
492:         data["phase"] = "published"
493:         _replace_json(intent, data)
494:         if failure_hook:
495:             failure_hook("after-publication")
496:         _remove_intent(intent)
497:     except Exception as exc:
498:         raise AdoptionCommittedIncomplete(
499:             "adoption committed but projection or cache reconciliation remains",
500:             phase=data["phase"], head=head, commit=commit,
501:             intent_path=intent, cause=exc,
502:         ) from exc
503:     return _result(
504:         plan, status, head, commit, projection, "published", False, observed_head
505:     )

507: 
508: def apply_arrival_adoption(
509:     registry: BackendRegistry, plan: ArrivalAdoptionPlan,
510:     *, failure_hook: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
511: ) -> ArrivalAdoptionResult:
512:     """Reserve the signed draft, CAS against S, then sync and reconcile cache."""
513:     with _declaration_lock(plan.target_path):
514:         if _exact_drafts((plan.draft,)) != plan.exact_drafts:
515:             raise AdoptionApplyError("prepared adoption draft changed")
516:         if plan.draft.body.get("payload") != _anchor_payload(
517:             plan.documents, plan.runtime_epoch
518:         ):
519:             raise AdoptionApplyError("prepared adoption epoch differs from signed draft")
520:         _require_cache(plan)
521:         intent = arrival_adoption_intent_path(plan.target_path)
522:         data = _intent_data(plan, "prepared")
523:         try:
524:             _write_exclusive_json(intent, data)
525:         except FileExistsError as exc:
526:             raise AdoptionApplyError(f"unfinished adoption intent exists: {intent}") from exc
527:         if failure_hook:
528:             try:
529:                 failure_hook("after-intent")
530:             except Exception as exc:
531:                 raise AdoptionRecoveryRequired(
532:                     "adoption intent is durable before append; recover explicitly",
533:                     intent_path=intent, cause=exc,
534:                 ) from exc
535:         ledger = query = None
536:         try:
537:             try:
538:                 ledger, query = registry.open(plan.descriptor)
539:                 current = ledger.head()
540:             except Exception as exc:
541:                 raise AdoptionRecoveryRequired(
542:                     "adoption intent is durable but custody could not be opened",
543:                     intent_path=intent, cause=exc,
544:                 ) from exc
545:             if current != plan.captured_head:
546:                 raise AdoptionStale(
547:                     "migration head changed before adoption append; recover intent "
548:                     "to prove whether it is superseded",
549:                     intent_path=intent,
550:                 )
551:             try:
552:                 preflight_projection_maintenance(
553:                     registry, plan.descriptor, through=plan.captured_head
554:                 )
555:             except Exception as exc:
556:                 raise AdoptionRecoveryRequired(
557:                     "adoption intent is durable but required projection maintenance "
558:                     "is unavailable before append",
559:                     intent_path=intent, cause=exc,
560:                 ) from exc
561:             try:
562:                 commit = ledger.append(plan.captured_head, (plan.draft,))
563:             except Exception as exc:
564:                 from .arrival_contract import ContractRefusal
565:                 from .arrival_head_seam import NotWitnessed
566:                 if isinstance(exc, ContractRefusal):
567:                     raise AdoptionStale(
568:                         f"adoption append refused: {exc}; recover intent to "
569:                         "establish its disposition",
570:                         intent_path=intent,
571:                     ) from exc
572:                 if isinstance(exc, NotWitnessed):
573:                     data["phase"] = "append-unwitnessed"
574:                     with suppress(Exception):
575:                         _replace_json(intent, data)
576:                     raise AdoptionUnwitnessed(
577:                         "adoption committed without a complete witness",
578:                         head=exc.head, commit=exc.commit, intent_path=intent, cause=exc,
579:                     ) from exc
580:                 data["phase"] = "append-unknown"
581:                 with suppress(Exception):
582:                     _replace_json(intent, data)
583:                 raise AdoptionOutcomeUnknown(
584:                     "adoption append outcome is unknown", head=plan.captured_head,
585:                     intent_path=intent, cause=exc,
586:                 ) from exc
587:             data["phase"] = "appended"
588:             try:
589:                 _replace_json(intent, data)
590:                 if failure_hook:
591:                     failure_hook("after-append")
592:             except Exception as exc:
593:                 raise AdoptionCommittedIncomplete(
594:                     "adoption committed but append phase recording failed",
595:                     phase="appended", head=commit.after, commit=commit,
596:                     intent_path=intent, cause=exc,
597:                 ) from exc
598:         finally:
599:             _close(query)
600:             _close(ledger)
601:         return _finish(registry, plan, intent, data, commit.after, commit,
602:                        "applied", failure_hook)
603: 
604: 
605: def _intent_object(value: Any, label: str) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
606:     if not isinstance(value, dict):
607:         raise AdoptionApplyError(f"adoption intent {label} must be an object")
608:     return value
609: 
610: 
611: def _intent_string(value: Any, label: str) -> str:
612:     if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
613:         raise AdoptionApplyError(f"adoption intent {label} must be a nonempty string")
614:     return value
615: 
616: 
617: def _plan_from_intent(data: Any) -> ArrivalAdoptionPlan:
618:     root = _intent_object(data, "root")
619:     if root.get("schema") != _SCHEMA:
620:         raise AdoptionApplyError("unsupported adoption intent")
621:     if root.get("phase") not in {
622:         "prepared", "append-unknown", "append-unwitnessed", "appended",
623:         "synced", "published",
624:     }:
625:         raise AdoptionApplyError("adoption intent phase is invalid")
626:     try:
627:         captured_data = _intent_object(root["captured_head"], "captured head")
628:         ordinal = captured_data["ordinal"]
629:         if not isinstance(ordinal, int) or isinstance(ordinal, bool) or ordinal < 0:
630:             raise AdoptionApplyError("adoption intent captured ordinal is invalid")
631:         captured = Head(
632:             _intent_string(captured_data["lineage"], "captured lineage"),
633:             ordinal,
634:             _intent_string(captured_data["record_hash"], "captured hash"),
635:         )
636:         descriptor_data = _intent_object(root["descriptor"], "descriptor")
637:         for field in ("backend", "location", "lineage", "role"):
638:             _intent_string(descriptor_data[field], f"descriptor {field}")
639:         descriptor = _descriptor_from(descriptor_data)
640:         target = Path(_intent_string(root["target"], "target")).resolve()
641:         text = _intent_string(root["declaration_text"], "authority text")
642:         digest = _intent_string(root["declaration_sha256"], "authority hash")
643:         reviewed_text = _intent_string(root["reviewed_text"], "reviewed text")
644:         reviewed_sha256 = _intent_string(root["reviewed_sha256"], "reviewed hash")
645:         observer = _intent_string(root["observer"], "observer")
646:         runtime_epoch = root.get("runtime_epoch", "strict")
647:         if runtime_epoch not in {"strict", "fresh"}:
648:             raise AdoptionApplyError("adoption intent runtime epoch is invalid")
649:         if hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() != digest:
650:             raise AdoptionApplyError("adoption intent declaration bytes do not verify")
651:         if hashlib.sha256(reviewed_text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() != reviewed_sha256:
652:             raise AdoptionApplyError("adoption intent reviewed snapshot bytes do not verify")
653:         raw_drafts = root["drafts"]
654:         if not isinstance(raw_drafts, list):
655:             raise AdoptionApplyError("adoption intent drafts must be a list")
656:         exact_drafts = _intent_string(root["exact_drafts"], "exact drafts")
657:         drafts = _drafts_from_exact(raw_drafts, exact_drafts)
658:         if len(drafts) != 1 or drafts[0].body.get("id") != captured.lineage:
659:             raise AdoptionApplyError("adoption intent has no exact lineage anchor")
660:         raw_bindings = root["bindings"]
661:         if not isinstance(raw_bindings, list):
662:             raise AdoptionApplyError("adoption intent bindings must be a list")
663:         evidence = []
664:         for index, raw in enumerate(raw_bindings):
665:             item = _intent_object(raw, f"binding {index}")
666:             request = _intent_object(item["request"], f"binding {index} request")
667:             evidence.append(CredentialBindingEvidence(
668:                 CredentialRequest(
669:                     _intent_string(request["namespace"], "binding namespace"),
670:                     _intent_string(request["observer"], "binding observer"),
671:                     SigningDomain(_intent_string(request["domain"], "binding domain")),
672:                     CredentialPurpose(_intent_string(request["purpose"], "binding purpose")),
673:                 ),
674:                 _intent_string(item["key_ref"], "binding key ref"),
675:                 _intent_string(item["algorithm"], "binding algorithm"),
676:                 _intent_string(item["public_key"], "binding public key"),
677:                 _intent_string(item["provenance"], "binding provenance"),
678:             ))
679:         if descriptor.lineage != captured.lineage:
680:             raise AdoptionApplyError("adoption intent descriptor and captured lineage disagree")
681:         return ArrivalAdoptionPlan(
682:             target, descriptor, captured.lineage,
683:             ReadBasis(captured.lineage, captured, None, None), captured,
684:             observer, reviewed_text, reviewed_sha256,
685:             text, digest, (), drafts[0], exact_drafts, tuple(evidence),
686:             runtime_epoch,
687:         )
688:     except AdoptionApplyError:
689:         raise
690:     except Exception as exc:
691:         raise AdoptionApplyError(f"malformed adoption intent: {exc}") from exc
692: 
693: 
694: def _revalidate_reserved(
695:     ledger: Any,
696:     plan: ArrivalAdoptionPlan,
697:     *,
698:     fact_verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool],
699:     arrival_verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool],
700: ) -> None:
701:     """Prove a public recovery intent is the same authorized adoption proposal."""
702:     try:
703:         if plan.descriptor.role is not Profile.AUTHORITY or plan.descriptor.lineage != plan.lineage:
704:             raise AdoptionApplyError("reserved descriptor is not this lineage's Authority")
705:         if ledger.verify(Full(through=plan.captured_head)) != plan.captured_head:
706:             raise AdoptionApplyError("reserved predecessor is not Full-verified")
707:         records = tuple(ledger.scan(through=plan.captured_head))
708:         _scan_identity(records, plan.lineage)
709:         registry, _evidence = key_registry_from_records(records, arrival_verify)
710:         valid = {
711:             key for key, _ordinal in registry.keys_valid_at(
712:                 plan.observer, plan.captured_head.ordinal + 1
713:             )
714:         }
715:         if not valid:
716:             raise AdoptionApplyError("reserved author has no key valid at S")
717:         documents = _selected_documents(
718:             plan.declaration_text, plan.target_path, plan.descriptor
719:         )
720:         reviewed_ast = parse_vertex(plan.reviewed_text, path=plan.target_path)
721:         validate_vertex(reviewed_ast)
722:         reviewed_documents = tuple(
723:             document.as_json() for document in vertex_to_documents(reviewed_ast)
724:         )
725:         if reviewed_documents != documents:
726:             raise AdoptionApplyError("reserved reviewed documents differ from authority form")
727:         for document in documents:
728:             if document["kind"] != DECL_OBSERVER_DEFINED:
729:                 continue
730:             key = document["payload"].get("key")
731:             if key is not None and key not in {
732:                 item for item, _ordinal in registry.keys_valid_at(
733:                     document["subject"], plan.captured_head.ordinal + 1
734:                 )
735:             }:
736:                 raise AdoptionApplyError("reserved observer key was not valid at S")
737: 
738:         bindings = plan.credential_bindings
739:         if len(bindings) != 2:
740:             raise AdoptionApplyError("reserved FACT and ARRIVAL binding evidence is incomplete")
741:         by_domain = {item.request.domain: item for item in bindings}
742:         if set(by_domain) != {SigningDomain.FACT, SigningDomain.ARRIVAL}:
743:             raise AdoptionApplyError("reserved binding domains are invalid or duplicated")
744:         fact_binding = by_domain[SigningDomain.FACT]
745:         arrival_binding = by_domain[SigningDomain.ARRIVAL]
746:         for item in bindings:
747:             if (
748:                 item.request.observer != plan.observer
749:                 or item.request.purpose is not CredentialPurpose.AUTHORSHIP
750:                 or not all((item.key_ref, item.algorithm, item.public_key, item.provenance))
751:                 or item.public_key not in valid
752:             ):
753:                 raise AdoptionApplyError("reserved binding is not authorized at S")
754:         if (
755:             fact_binding.request.namespace != arrival_binding.request.namespace
756:             or fact_binding.key_ref != arrival_binding.key_ref
757:             or fact_binding.public_key != arrival_binding.public_key
758:         ):
759:             raise AdoptionApplyError("reserved FACT and ARRIVAL bindings disagree")
760: 
761:         draft = plan.draft
762:         payload = _anchor_payload(documents, plan.runtime_epoch)
763:         body = draft.body
764:         if (
765:             draft.kind != "fact" or draft.observer != plan.observer
766:             or draft.origin != "" or body.get("id") != plan.lineage
767:             or body.get("kind") != "_decl.genesis"
768:             or body.get("ts") != draft.authored_at
769:             or body.get("observer") != plan.observer
770:             or body.get("origin") != "" or body.get("payload") != payload
771:             or not isinstance(body.get("signature"), str)
772:             or not isinstance(draft.signature, str)
773:         ):
774:             raise AdoptionApplyError("reserved declaration anchor differs from reviewed documents")
775:         expected_body = body_of_fact_row((
776:             plan.lineage, "_decl.genesis", draft.authored_at,
777:             plan.observer, "", payload, body["signature"],
778:         ))
779:         if dict(body) != expected_body:
780:             raise AdoptionApplyError("reserved declaration anchor has unexpected fields")
781:         fact_digest = fact_commitment_hash(
782:             "_decl.genesis", draft.authored_at, plan.observer, "", payload
783:         )
784:         arrival_digest = content_commitment(
785:             "fact", draft.authored_at, plan.observer, "", dict(body)
786:         )
787:         key = fact_binding.public_key
788:         if not fact_verify(key, body["signature"], fact_digest):
789:             raise AdoptionApplyError("reserved FACT signature does not verify")
790:         if not arrival_verify(key, draft.signature, arrival_digest):
791:             raise AdoptionApplyError("reserved ARRIVAL signature does not verify")
792:     except AdoptionApplyError:
793:         raise
794:     except Exception as exc:
795:         raise AdoptionApplyError(f"cannot revalidate reserved adoption: {exc}") from exc
796: 
797: 
798: def recover_arrival_adoption(
799:     registry: BackendRegistry, intent: Path | str,
800:     *, fact_verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool],
801:     arrival_verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool],
802:     failure_hook: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
803: ) -> ArrivalAdoptionResult:
804:     """Reconcile the exact reserved row; never re-sign or append a duplicate."""
805:     intent_path = Path(intent).resolve()
806:     suffix = ".arrival-adopt.intent"
807:     if (
808:         not intent_path.name.endswith(suffix)
809:         or len(intent_path.name) <= len(suffix)
810:     ):
811:         raise AdoptionApplyError("adoption intent path has an invalid suffix")
812:     target_path = intent_path.with_name(intent_path.name[:-len(suffix)])
813:     if not callable(fact_verify) or not callable(arrival_verify):
814:         raise AdoptionApplyError("recovery requires public FACT and ARRIVAL verifiers")
815:     with _declaration_lock(target_path):
816:         try:
817:             data = json.loads(intent_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
818:             plan = _plan_from_intent(data)
819:         except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
820:             raise AdoptionApplyError(f"cannot read adoption intent: {exc}") from exc
821:         if plan.target_path != target_path:
822:             raise AdoptionApplyError("adoption intent path does not match its target")
823:         ledger = query = None
824:         try:
825:             try:
826:                 ledger, query = registry.open(plan.descriptor)
827:             except Exception as exc:
828:                 raise AdoptionRecoveryRequired(
829:                     "reserved adoption intent is durable but custody could not be opened",
830:                     intent_path=intent_path, cause=exc,
831:                 ) from exc
832:             predecessor = ledger.head_at(Watermark(plan.lineage, plan.captured_head.ordinal))
833:             if predecessor != plan.captured_head:
834:                 raise AdoptionStale("adoption predecessor hash changed")
835:             _revalidate_reserved(
836:                 ledger, plan, fact_verify=fact_verify,
837:                 arrival_verify=arrival_verify,
838:             )
839:             current = ledger.head()
840:             observed_head = current
841:             if current == predecessor:
842:                 _require_cache(plan)
843:                 try:
844:                     preflight_projection_maintenance(
845:                         registry, plan.descriptor, through=predecessor
846:                     )
847:                 except Exception as exc:
848:                     raise AdoptionRecoveryRequired(
849:                         "reserved adoption cannot append without required projection "
850:                         "maintenance",
851:                         intent_path=intent_path, cause=exc,
852:                     ) from exc
853:                 try:
854:                     commit = ledger.append(predecessor, (plan.draft,))
855:                 except Exception as exc:
856:                     from .arrival_contract import ContractRefusal
857:                     from .arrival_head_seam import NotWitnessed
858:                     if isinstance(exc, ContractRefusal):
859:                         raise AdoptionStale(
860:                             f"reserved adoption CAS refused: {exc}",
861:                             intent_path=intent_path,
862:                         ) from exc
863:                     if isinstance(exc, NotWitnessed):
864:                         raise AdoptionUnwitnessed(
865:                             "reserved adoption committed without a complete witness",
866:                             head=exc.head, commit=exc.commit, intent_path=intent_path,
867:                             cause=exc,
868:                         ) from exc
869:                     raise AdoptionOutcomeUnknown(
870:                         "reserved adoption append outcome is unknown", head=predecessor,
871:                         intent_path=intent_path, cause=exc,
872:                     ) from exc
873:                 current = commit.after
874:                 observed_head = current
875:                 data["phase"] = "appended"
876:                 try:
877:                     _replace_json(intent_path, data)
878:                     if failure_hook:
879:                         failure_hook("after-append")
880:                 except Exception as exc:
881:                     raise AdoptionCommittedIncomplete(
882:                         "reserved adoption committed but phase recording failed",
883:                         phase="appended", head=current, commit=commit,
884:                         intent_path=intent_path, cause=exc,
885:                     ) from exc
886:             else:
887:                 if current.ordinal < predecessor.ordinal + 1:
888:                     raise AdoptionStale("reserved adoption has no successor at S+1")
889:                 adoption_head = ledger.head_at(
890:                     Watermark(plan.lineage, predecessor.ordinal + 1)
891:                 )
892:                 if ledger.verify(Full(through=adoption_head)) != adoption_head:
893:                     raise AdoptionStale("reserved adoption suffix is not Full-verified")
894:                 successor = ledger.read(predecessor.ordinal + 1)
895:                 if not _record_matches_draft(successor, plan.draft):
896:                     _remove_intent(intent_path)
897:                     raise AdoptionStale(
898:                         "a different Full-verified record occupies S+1; "
899:                         "superseded adoption intent retired"
900:                     )
901:                 commit = Commit(
902:                     before=predecessor,
903:                     records=(successor,),
904:                     after=adoption_head,
905:                     durability=DurabilityReceipt(
906:                         ledger.capabilities().durability,
907:                         "reconciled from Full-verified custody; original witness unavailable",
908:                     ),
909:                 )
910:                 current = adoption_head
911:                 data["phase"] = "appended"
912:                 try:
913:                     _replace_json(intent_path, data)
914:                 except Exception as exc:
915:                     raise AdoptionCommittedIncomplete(
916:                         "adoption row is committed but appended phase recording failed",
917:                         phase="appended", head=current, commit=commit,
918:                         intent_path=intent_path, cause=exc,
919:                     ) from exc
920:         finally:
921:             _close(query)
922:             _close(ledger)
923:         return _finish(registry, plan, intent_path, data, current, commit,
924:                        "recovered", failure_hook, observed_head)

1: """Closeable, per-member Arrival capture for later aggregate composition.
2: 
3: This module captures evidence only.  It does not invent a common head, merge
4: rows, select a fold order, or open a legacy store.  Topology expansion is
5: injected so locator/name discovery remains a consumer concern.
6: """

44: def _detached(ast: Any) -> Any:
45:     """Reconstruct a private AST from canonical declaration documents."""
46:     if not hasattr(ast, "loops"):

170: class AggregateCapture:
171:     """All retained member snapshots for one sequential aggregate observation."""
172: 
173:     __slots__ = ("_members", "_definitions", "_nodes", "_closed")
174: 
175:     def __init__(
176:         self,
177:         members: tuple[AggregateMember, ...],
178:         definitions: tuple[CapturedDefinition, ...],
179:         nodes: tuple[_CapturedNode, ...],
180:     ) -> None:
181:         self._members = members
182:         self._definitions = definitions
183:         self._nodes = nodes
184:         self._closed = False
185: 
186:     @property
187:     def members(self) -> tuple[AggregateMember, ...]:
188:         """Detached member evidence; a caller cannot mutate capture topology."""
189:         return tuple(
190:             replace(member, effective_declaration=_detached(member.effective_declaration))
191:             for member in self._members
192:         )
193: 
194:     @property
195:     def definitions(self) -> tuple[CapturedDefinition, ...]:
196:         """Detached frozen definitions; nested AST maps stay capture-private."""
197:         return tuple(
198:             replace(definition, effective_declaration=_detached(definition.effective_declaration))
199:             for definition in self._definitions
200:         )
201: 
202:     def close(self) -> None:
203:         if self._closed:
204:             return
205:         self._closed = True
206:         first_error: BaseException | None = None
207:         for node in reversed(self._nodes):
208:             try:
209:                 node.close()
210:             except BaseException as exc:  # preserve every remaining close
211:                 if first_error is None:
212:                     first_error = exc
213:         if first_error is not None:
214:             raise first_error
215: 
216:     def __enter__(self) -> AggregateCapture:
217:         return self
218: 
219:     def __exit__(self, *_unused: object) -> None:
220:         self.close()

223: def _effective_declaration(node: AggregatePlanNode, opened: OpenedRead) -> tuple[Any, str | None]:
224:     facts = opened.snapshot.facts(
225:         FactRequest(limit=None, kind="_decl", include_internal=True, order="oldest")
226:     ).items
227:     documents = resolve_declaration_documents_from_snapshot(
228:         opened.snapshot.declaration_anchor, facts
229:     )
230:     if documents is None:
231:         raise AggregateCaptureRefused(
232:             f"descriptor occurrence {node.locator} has no adopted declaration"
233:         )
234:     rows = documents.documents if isinstance(documents, Unhistorized) else documents
235:     return (
236:         effective_declaration_from_documents(rows, node.local_ast),
237:         opened.snapshot.declaration_anchor.own_lineage,
238:     )
239: 
240: 
241: def _member(
242:     captured: _CapturedNode, *, role: str
243: ) -> AggregateMember:
244:     node = captured.node
245:     return AggregateMember(
246:         identity=MemberIdentity(
247:             path=node.path,
248:             locator=str(node.locator),
249:             declaration_identity=captured.declaration_identity,
250:             role=role,
251:         ),
252:         definition=node.definition,
253:         basis=captured.opened.basis,
254:         effective_declaration=captured.effective_declaration,
255:         snapshot=captured.opened.snapshot,
256:         runtime_epoch=captured.opened.runtime_epoch(),
257:     )
258: 
259: 
260: def _occurrence(node: AggregatePlanNode, *, role: str | None = None) -> OccurrenceIdentity:
261:     return OccurrenceIdentity(node.path, str(node.locator), node.role if role is None else role)
262: 
263: 
264: def capture_aggregate(
265:     registry: BackendRegistry,
266:     root: AggregatePlanNode,
267:     resolver: AggregateTopologyResolver,
268:     *,
269:     opened_root: OpenedRead | None = None,
270: ) -> AggregateCapture:
271:     """Capture every resolver-selected descriptor occurrence sequentially.
272: 
273:     A descriptor's topology is expanded only from its effective declaration at
274:     that node's bounded head. Storeless nodes expand from their frozen local
275:     AST. Each current snapshot remains open until the returned capture closes.
276:     """
277:     captured_nodes: list[_CapturedNode] = []
278:     members: list[AggregateMember] = []
279:     definitions: list[CapturedDefinition | None] = []
280:     active: list[Path] = []
281: 
282:     def visit(node: AggregatePlanNode) -> CapturedDefinition:
283:         locator = node.locator.resolve()
284:         if locator in active:
285:             chain = " -> ".join(str(path) for path in (*active, locator))
286:             raise AggregateCycle(f"composition cycle: {chain}")
287:         active.append(locator)
288:         definition_index = len(definitions)
289:         definitions.append(None)
290:         try:
291:             if node.descriptor is None:
292:                 if getattr(node.local_ast, "store", None) is not None:
293:                     raise AggregateCaptureRefused(
294:                         "aggregate occurrence "
295:                         f"{node.locator} has storage without an explicit Arrival descriptor"
296:                     )
297:                 effective = _detached(node.local_ast)
298:                 basis = None
299:             else:
300:                 opened = opened_root if node is root and opened_root is not None else open_read(
301:                     registry, node.descriptor
302:                 )
303:                 try:
304:                     effective, declaration_identity = _effective_declaration(node, opened)
305:                 except BaseException:
306:                     with suppress(BaseException):
307:                         opened.close()
308:                     raise
309:                 captured = _CapturedNode(
310:                     node, opened, _detached(effective), declaration_identity
311:                 )
312:                 captured_nodes.append(captured)
313:                 effective = captured.effective_declaration
314:                 basis = captured.opened.basis
315:                 # Discover's own descriptor is a retained overlay role on this
316:                 # exact resource, never a recursive self-child or second open.
317:                 if effective.discover is not None:
318:                     members.append(_member(captured, role="own-overlay"))
319:                 elif node.role != "root" or effective.combine is None:
320:                     # A descriptor root may resolve to a plain declaration
321:                     # even when its local ingress still describes composition.
322:                     # It remains a leaf occurrence of its own captured store.
323:                     members.append(_member(captured, role=node.role))
324:             child_definitions = tuple(
325:                 visit(child) for child in resolver.children(node, effective)
326:             )
327:             definition = CapturedDefinition(
328:                 identity=_occurrence(node),
329:                 local_definition=node.definition,
330:                 effective_declaration=effective,
331:                 basis=basis,
332:                 children=tuple(child.identity for child in child_definitions),
333:             )
334:             definitions[definition_index] = definition
335:             return definition
336:         finally:
337:             active.pop()
338: 
339:     try:
340:         visit(root)
341:         return AggregateCapture(
342:             tuple(members),
343:             tuple(definition for definition in definitions if definition is not None),
344:             tuple(captured_nodes),
345:         )
346:     except BaseException:
347:         for node in reversed(captured_nodes):
348:             with suppress(BaseException):
349:                 node.close()
350:         raise

=== libs/engine/src/engine/arrival_boundary_continuity.py ===
1: """Pure declaration-history checks for Arrival boundary consumption edges.
2: 
3: The supported Arrival runtime rebuilds current fold state from facts, but old
4: owned ticks remain reset/count/period edges.  This module establishes that a
5: current consumer has one continuous declared role for each edge it will use.
6: It deliberately performs no custody, projection, signing, or source execution.
7: """

114:     def membership(self, name: str) -> Literal["present", "absent", "unknown"]:
115:         if name in self.names:
116:             return "present"
117:         return "unknown" if self.unknown_generator else "absent"

120: _TOMBSTONE_TO_DEFINED = {
121:     tombstone: defined for defined, tombstone in DEFINED_TO_TOMBSTONE.items()
122: }
123: _DEFINED_KINDS = frozenset(DEFINED_TO_TOMBSTONE) | {
124:     DECL_LENS_DEFINED,
125:     DECL_VERTEX_DEFINED,
126: }
127: _ENV_VALUE = re.compile(r"\$[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\Z")

130: def _copy_documents(
131:     documents: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
132: ) -> tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]:
133:     return tuple(copy.deepcopy(dict(document)) for document in documents)
134: 
135: 
136: def _document_map(
137:     documents: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
138: ) -> dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, Any]]:
139:     mapped: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
140:     for document in documents:
141:         kind = document["kind"]
142:         subject = document["subject"]
143:         mapped[(kind, subject)] = copy.deepcopy(dict(document))
144:     return mapped
145: 
146: 
147: def _documents_tuple(
148:     mapped: Mapping[tuple[str, str], Mapping[str, Any]],
149: ) -> tuple[Mapping[str, Any], ...]:
150:     return tuple(copy.deepcopy(dict(document)) for document in mapped.values())

153: def declaration_document_revisions(
154:     anchor: DeclarationAnchor,
155:     facts: Sequence[Fact],
156:     *,
157:     target_documents: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None,
158: ) -> tuple[DeclarationDocumentRevision, ...]:
159:     """Return genesis, own-overlay groups, and an optional proposed target.
160: 
161:     Foreign declaration rows are intentionally excluded before any caller can
162:     inspect their source paths.  Rows sharing an Arrival ordinal are applied in
163:     sequence and exposed as one observable revision.
164:     """
165:     internal = sorted(
166:         (fact for fact in facts if is_internal_kind(fact.kind)),
167:         key=lambda fact: (fact.arrival_ordinal, fact.arrival_seq),
168:     )
169:     if anchor.own_lineage is None:
170:         if any(fact.kind == DECL_GENESIS for fact in internal):
171:             raise UnadoptedLineage(
172:                 "declaration genesis rows occur without an own-lineage marker"
173:             )
174:         raise DeclarationResolutionError(
175:             "boundary continuity requires a historized own declaration"
176:         )
177:     genesis = anchor.genesis
178:     if (
179:         genesis is None
180:         or genesis.id != anchor.own_lineage
181:         or genesis.kind != DECL_GENESIS
182:     ):
183:         raise DeclarationResolutionError(
184:             "own-lineage declaration marker has no matching genesis"
185:         )
186:     _runtime_epoch_payload(genesis.payload, genesis.arrival_ordinal)
187: 
188:     mapped = _document_map(genesis.payload.get("documents", ()))
189:     revisions = [
190:         DeclarationDocumentRevision(
191:             arrival_ordinal=genesis.arrival_ordinal,
192:             fact_ids=(genesis.id,),
193:             document_fact_ids=(),
194:             documents=_documents_tuple(mapped),
195:         )
196:     ]
197:     grouped: dict[int, list[Fact]] = {}
198:     for fact in internal:
199:         if fact.kind == DECL_GENESIS:
200:             continue
201:         if fact.arrival_ordinal < genesis.arrival_ordinal:
202:             # A self-scoped overlay cannot establish a runtime definition
203:             # before the declaration genesis that licenses its lineage.
204:             continue
205:         payload = fact.payload
206:         if payload.get("lineage") != anchor.own_lineage:
207:             continue
208:         if fact.kind not in _DEFINED_KINDS and fact.kind not in _TOMBSTONE_TO_DEFINED:
209:             continue
210:         grouped.setdefault(fact.arrival_ordinal, []).append(fact)
211: 
212:     for ordinal in sorted(grouped):
213:         group = grouped[ordinal]
214:         for fact in group:
215:             payload = fact.payload
216:             subject = payload.get("subject")
217:             if fact.kind in _TOMBSTONE_TO_DEFINED:
218:                 mapped.pop((_TOMBSTONE_TO_DEFINED[fact.kind], subject), None)
219:             else:
220:                 mapped[(fact.kind, subject)] = {
221:                     "kind": fact.kind,
222:                     "subject": subject,
223:                     "payload": copy.deepcopy(payload.get("payload", {})),
224:                 }
225:         revisions.append(
226:             DeclarationDocumentRevision(
227:                 arrival_ordinal=ordinal,
228:                 fact_ids=tuple(fact.id for fact in group),
229:                 document_fact_ids=tuple(
230:                     (fact.kind, str(fact.payload.get("subject")), fact.id)
231:                     for fact in group
232:                 ),
233:                 documents=_documents_tuple(mapped),
234:             )
235:         )
236: 
237:     if target_documents is not None:
238:         target = _copy_documents(target_documents)
239:         if not revisions or target != revisions[-1].documents:
240:             revisions.append(
241:                 DeclarationDocumentRevision(
242:                     arrival_ordinal=None,
243:                     fact_ids=(),
244:                     document_fact_ids=(),
245:                     documents=target,
246:                     proposed=True,
247:                 )
248:             )
249:     return tuple(revisions)
250: 
251: 
252: def collect_verified_parameter_rows(
253:     anchor: DeclarationAnchor,
254:     facts: Sequence[Fact],
255:     *,
256:     target_documents: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
257:     base_dir: Path,
258: ) -> dict[str, tuple[Mapping[str, str], ...]]:
259:     """Read, hash, and parse own historical pinned parameter snapshots.
260: 
261:     Missing, changed, unpinned, or malformed historical inputs remain unknown;
262:     they do not poison an unrelated direct loop.  Current runtime pin checks
263:     remain a separate existing gate.
264:     """
265:     from .compiler import parse_source_params_bytes
266: 
267:     verified: dict[str, tuple[Mapping[str, str], ...]] = {}
268:     revisions = declaration_document_revisions(
269:         anchor, facts, target_documents=target_documents
270:     )
271:     for revision in revisions:
272:         for document in revision.documents:
273:             if document.get("kind") != DECL_SOURCE_DEFINED:
274:                 continue
275:             payload = document.get("payload", {})
276:             if payload.get("form") != "template" or payload.get("loop") is None:
277:                 continue
278:             from_document = payload.get("from")
279:             if not isinstance(from_document, Mapping):
280:                 continue
281:             pin = from_document.get("params_sha256")
282:             path_text = from_document.get("path")
283:             if not isinstance(pin, str) or not isinstance(path_text, str):
284:                 continue
285:             if pin in verified:
286:                 continue
287:             path = Path(path_text)
288:             candidate = path if path.is_absolute() else base_dir / path
289:             try:
290:                 data = candidate.read_bytes()
291:                 if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != pin:
292:                     continue
293:                 rows = parse_source_params_bytes(data, source=candidate)
294:             except (OSError, UnicodeError, ValueError):
295:                 continue
296:             verified[pin] = tuple(dict(row.values) for row in rows)
297:     return verified
298: 
299: 
300: def _literal_kind(value: object) -> tuple[str | None, bool]:
301:     if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
302:         return None, False
303:     if value.startswith("$$"):
304:         return value[1:], False
305:     if _ENV_VALUE.fullmatch(value):
306:         return None, True
307:     return value, False
308: 
309: 
310: def _namespace(
311:     documents: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
312:     verified_params: Mapping[str, Sequence[Mapping[str, str]]],
313: ) -> _Namespace:
314:     names = {"cite"}
315:     unknown = False
316:     vertex_name: str | None = None
317:     has_vertex_boundary = False
318:     for document in documents:
319:         kind = document.get("kind")
320:         subject = document.get("subject")
321:         payload = document.get("payload", {})
322:         if kind == DECL_VERTEX_DEFINED:
323:             candidate = payload.get("name")
324:             if not isinstance(candidate, str) or not candidate:
325:                 raise DeclarationResolutionError(
326:                     "vertex declaration has no explicit runtime name"
327:                 )
328:             vertex_name = candidate
329:             has_vertex_boundary = bool(payload.get("boundary", ()))
330:         elif kind == DECL_KIND_DEFINED and isinstance(subject, str):
331:             names.add(subject)
332:         elif kind == DECL_SOURCE_DEFINED:
333:             if payload.get("form") != "template" or payload.get("loop") is None:
334:                 continue
335:             rows: list[Mapping[str, str]] = []
336:             for param in payload.get("params", ()):
337:                 if isinstance(param, Mapping) and isinstance(param.get("values"), Mapping):
338:                     rows.append(param["values"])
339:             from_document = payload.get("from")
340:             if isinstance(from_document, Mapping):
341:                 pin = from_document.get("params_sha256")
342:                 if isinstance(pin, str) and pin in verified_params:
343:                     rows.extend(verified_params[pin])
344:                 else:
345:                     unknown = True
346:             for row in rows:
347:                 literal, indirect = _literal_kind(row.get("kind"))
348:                 if literal is not None:
349:                     names.add(literal)
350:                 unknown = unknown or indirect
351:     if vertex_name is None:
352:         raise DeclarationResolutionError(
353:             "declaration documents have no vertex identity"
354:         )
355:     return _Namespace(
356:         names=frozenset(names),
357:         unknown_generator=unknown,
358:         vertex_name=vertex_name,
359:         has_vertex_boundary=has_vertex_boundary,
360:     )
