363: def _issue(
364:     reason: BoundaryContinuityReason,
365:     *,
366:     vertex: str,
367:     loop: str | None = None,
368:     tick: Tick | None = None,
369:     revision: DeclarationDocumentRevision | None = None,
370:     declaration_fact_id: str | None = None,
371:     declaration_kind: str | None = None,
372:     detail: str,
373: ) -> BoundaryContinuityConflict:
374:     return BoundaryContinuityConflict(
375:         BoundaryContinuityIssue(
376:             reason=reason,
377:             vertex_name=vertex,
378:             loop_name=loop,
379:             tick_id=tick.id if tick is not None else None,
380:             tick_ordinal=tick.arrival_ordinal if tick is not None else None,
381:             tick_seq=tick.arrival_seq if tick is not None else None,
382:             declaration_fact_id=(
383:                 declaration_fact_id
384:                 if declaration_fact_id is not None
385:                 else _revision_fact_id(revision, loop, declaration_kind)
386:             ),
387:             declaration_ordinal=(
388:                 revision.arrival_ordinal if revision is not None else None
389:             ),
390:             detail=detail,
391:         )
392:     )
393: 
394: 
395: def _revision_fact_id(
396:     revision: DeclarationDocumentRevision | None,
397:     loop_name: str | None,
398:     declaration_kind: str | None,
399: ) -> str | None:
400:     if revision is None:
401:         return None
402:     if not revision.document_fact_ids:
403:         # Genesis is the one row that establishes every seed document.
404:         return revision.fact_ids[0] if len(revision.fact_ids) == 1 else None
405:     if declaration_kind is not None:
406:         for kind, _subject, fact_id in reversed(revision.document_fact_ids):
407:             if kind == declaration_kind:
408:                 return fact_id
409:         return None
410:     if loop_name is not None:
411:         loop_kinds = {
412:             DECL_KIND_DEFINED,
413:             DEFINED_TO_TOMBSTONE[DECL_KIND_DEFINED],
414:         }
415:         for kind, subject, fact_id in reversed(revision.document_fact_ids):
416:             if kind in loop_kinds and subject == loop_name:
417:                 return fact_id
418:     return None
419: 
420: 
421: def analyze_boundary_continuity(
422:     anchor: DeclarationAnchor,
423:     facts: Sequence[Fact],
424:     ticks: Sequence[Tick],
425:     *,
426:     target_documents: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
427:     verified_params: Mapping[str, Sequence[Mapping[str, str]]] | None = None,
428:     compiled_loop_names: Collection[str] | None = None,
429:     runtime_epoch: RuntimeEpoch | None = None,
430: ) -> BoundaryContinuityResult:
431:     """Validate every owned edge consumed by the target declaration."""
432:     verified = verified_params or {}
433:     revisions = declaration_document_revisions(
434:         anchor, facts, target_documents=target_documents
435:     )
436:     namespaces = tuple(_namespace(revision.documents, verified) for revision in revisions)
437:     target = namespaces[-1]
438: 
439:     if target.vertex_name in target.names:
440:         raise _issue(
441:             "reserved-runtime-name",
442:             vertex=target.vertex_name,
443:             loop=target.vertex_name,
444:             detail=(
445:                 f"loop name {target.vertex_name!r} is reserved for the vertex "
446:                 "boundary role"
447:             ),
448:         )
449: 
450:     if compiled_loop_names is not None:
451:         compiled = frozenset(compiled_loop_names)
452:         missing = target.names - compiled
453:         extra = compiled - target.names
454:         if missing or (extra and not target.unknown_generator):
455:             parts = []
456:             if missing:
457:                 parts.append(f"missing {sorted(missing)!r}")
458:             if extra:
459:                 parts.append(f"unproved {sorted(extra)!r}")
460:             raise _issue(
461:                 "runtime-namespace-mismatch",
462:                 vertex=target.vertex_name,
463:                 detail="compiled runtime namespace disagrees with declaration: "
464:                 + "; ".join(parts),
465:             )
466: 
467:     own_declaration_facts = tuple(
468:         fact
469:         for fact in facts
470:         if (
471:             fact.kind == DECL_GENESIS
472:             and fact.id == anchor.own_lineage
473:         )
474:         or (
475:             is_internal_kind(fact.kind)
476:             and fact.payload.get("lineage") == anchor.own_lineage
477:         )
478:     )
479:     own_declaration_by_ordinal = {
480:         fact.arrival_ordinal: fact for fact in own_declaration_facts
481:     }
482:     declared_epoch = _runtime_epoch_payload(
483:         anchor.genesis.payload, anchor.genesis.arrival_ordinal
484:     ) if anchor.genesis is not None else RuntimeEpoch("strict", None)
485:     if declared_epoch.mode == "fresh" and runtime_epoch != declared_epoch:
486:         raise DeclarationResolutionError(
487:             "fresh boundary continuity requires the physically verified runtime epoch"
488:         )
489:     owned_ticks = tuple(
490:         tick for tick in ticks
491:         if tick.origin == target.vertex_name
492:         and (
493:             declared_epoch.start_ordinal is None
494:             or tick.arrival_ordinal > declared_epoch.start_ordinal
495:         )
496:     )
497:     for tick in owned_ticks:
498:         if tick.arrival_ordinal in own_declaration_by_ordinal:
499:             fact = own_declaration_by_ordinal[tick.arrival_ordinal]
500:             conflicting = DeclarationDocumentRevision(
501:                 arrival_ordinal=fact.arrival_ordinal,
502:                 fact_ids=(fact.id,),
503:                 document_fact_ids=(
504:                     (fact.kind, str(fact.payload.get("subject")), fact.id),
505:                 ),
506:                 documents=(),
507:             )
508:             raise _issue(
509:                 "invalid-projection-shape",
510:                 vertex=target.vertex_name,
511:                 loop=tick.name,
512:                 tick=tick,
513:                 revision=conflicting,
514:                 declaration_fact_id=fact.id,
515:                 detail=(
516:                     "owned tick shares an Arrival ordinal with an own-lineage "
517:                     "declaration fact"
518:                 ),
519:             )
520: 
521:     genesis_ordinal = revisions[0].arrival_ordinal
522: 
523:     def revision_at_tick(tick: Tick) -> int | None:
524:         if genesis_ordinal is None or tick.arrival_ordinal < genesis_ordinal:
525:             return None
526:         selected: int | None = None
527:         for index, revision in enumerate(revisions):
528:             if revision.proposed:
529:                 break
530:             ordinal = revision.arrival_ordinal
531:             if ordinal is not None and ordinal <= tick.arrival_ordinal:
532:                 selected = index
533:         return selected
534: 
535:     for tick in owned_ticks:
536:         start = revision_at_tick(tick)
537:         if tick.name == target.vertex_name and target.has_vertex_boundary:
538:             if start is None:
539:                 raise _issue(
540:                     "ambiguous-tick-role",
541:                     vertex=target.vertex_name,
542:                     loop=tick.name,
543:                     tick=tick,
544:                     detail="vertex-period tick predates declaration genesis",
545:                 )
546:             if namespaces[start].vertex_name != target.vertex_name:
547:                 raise _issue(
548:                     "ambiguous-tick-role",
549:                     vertex=target.vertex_name,
550:                     loop=tick.name,
551:                     tick=tick,
552:                     revision=revisions[start],
553:                     declaration_kind=DECL_VERTEX_DEFINED,
554:                     detail="vertex-period tick was received under another vertex identity",
555:                 )
556:             for index in range(start, len(revisions)):
557:                 if namespaces[index].vertex_name != target.vertex_name:
558:                     raise _issue(
559:                         "prior-incarnation",
560:                         vertex=target.vertex_name,
561:                         loop=tick.name,
562:                         tick=tick,
563:                         revision=revisions[index],
564:                         declaration_kind=DECL_VERTEX_DEFINED,
565:                         detail=(
566:                             f"vertex-period tick {tick.id!r} crosses a declaration "
567:                             "vertex identity discontinuity"
568:                         ),
569:                     )
570:             at_receipt = namespaces[start].membership(tick.name)
571:             if at_receipt != "absent":
572:                 raise _issue(
573:                     "ambiguous-tick-role",
574:                     vertex=target.vertex_name,
575:                     loop=tick.name,
576:                     tick=tick,
577:                     revision=revisions[start],
578:                     detail=(
579:                         "vertex-name tick had a present or unprovable same-name "
580:                         "loop role at receipt"
581:                     ),
582:                 )
583: 
584:             # A current vertex boundary consumes this as a vertex-period edge.
585:             # Current C5/runtime namespace checks separately prevent an actual
586:             # same-name loop, so do not also reinterpret it as a loop edge.
587:             continue
588:         if tick.name == target.vertex_name:
589:             # With no current vertex-boundary consumer, the saved period value
590:             # has no supported detached-runtime effect.  Keep the row as
591:             # evidence and re-check it if a later proposal adds that consumer.
592:             continue
593: 
594:         target_membership = target.membership(tick.name)
595:         if target_membership == "absent":
596:             continue
597:         if start is None:
598:             raise _issue(
599:                 "unproven-loop-role",
600:                 vertex=target.vertex_name,
601:                 loop=tick.name,
602:                 tick=tick,
603:                 detail="owned loop tick predates declaration genesis",
604:             )
605:         for index in range(start, len(revisions)):
606:             if namespaces[index].vertex_name != target.vertex_name:
607:                 raise _issue(
608:                     "unproven-loop-role" if index == start else "prior-incarnation",
609:                     vertex=target.vertex_name,
610:                     loop=tick.name,
611:                     tick=tick,
612:                     revision=revisions[index],
613:                     detail=(
614:                         f"owned tick {tick.id!r} crosses a declaration vertex "
615:                         "identity discontinuity"
616:                     ),
617:                 )
618:             membership = namespaces[index].membership(tick.name)
619:             if membership == "present":
620:                 continue
621:             if membership == "absent":
622:                 reason: BoundaryContinuityReason = (
623:                     "unproven-loop-role" if index == start else "prior-incarnation"
624:                 )
625:             else:
626:                 reason = "unproven-generated-incarnation"
627:             raise _issue(
628:                 reason,
629:                 vertex=target.vertex_name,
630:                 loop=tick.name,
631:                 tick=tick,
632:                 revision=revisions[index],
633:                 detail=(
634:                     f"owned tick {tick.id!r} cannot be consumed by current loop "
635:                     f"{tick.name!r}: declared membership became {membership}"
636:                 ),
637:             )
638: 
639:     return BoundaryContinuityResult(
640:         provable_names=target.names,
641:         has_unknown_generators=target.unknown_generator,
642:         vertex_name=target.vertex_name,
643:         has_vertex_boundary=target.has_vertex_boundary,
644:     )

=== libs/engine/src/engine/arrival_consumer.py ===
1: """Descriptor-first, read-only Arrival consumer opening.
2: 
3: This module owns the composition that neither a query adapter nor an SDK
4: renderer may spell independently: registry opening and head attestation happen
5: before a query snapshot, custody completes the projection watermark, and the
6: caller receives no append-capable ledger.
7: """
8: 
9: from __future__ import annotations
10: 
11: from contextlib import suppress
12: from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, cast
13: 
14: from .arrival_contract import (
15:     ArrivalLedger,
16:     Continuation,
17:     FactPage,
18:     FactRequest,
19:     Head,
20:     HeadMismatch,
21:     InvalidContinuation,
22:     NotAuthority,
23:     ProjectionAbsent,
24:     ProjectionRequirement,
25:     QuerySnapshot,
26:     ReadBasis,
27:     Watermark,
28: )
29: from .arrival_head_seam import (
30:     AttestedLedger,
31:     Compared,
32:     Indeterminate,
33:     OpenReport,
34:     PreGenesis,
35:     complete_projection_custody,
36: )
37: from .declaration import validate_arrival_declaration_anchor
38: 
39: if TYPE_CHECKING:  # pragma: no cover - imports only for annotations
40:     from .arrival_contract import StoreDescriptor
41:     from .arrival_registry import BackendRegistry
42: 
43: __all__ = ["OpenedRead", "open_read"]
44: 
45: 
46: def _close_quietly(handle: object) -> None:
47:     close = getattr(handle, "close", None)
48:     if callable(close):
49:         with suppress(Exception):
50:             close()
51: 
52: 
53: class OpenedRead:
54:     """A closeable query snapshot plus its custody-completed read basis.
55: 
56:     ``_query`` and ``_ledger`` are deliberately private. The former may own
57:     adapter resources and the latter can append; exposing either would make a
58:     read opener an authority escape hatch.
59:     """
60: 
61:     def __init__(
62:         self,
63:         snapshot: QuerySnapshot,
64:         basis: ReadBasis,
65:         report: OpenReport,
66:         _query: object,
67:         _ledger: object,
68:     ) -> None:
69:         self.snapshot = snapshot
70:         self.basis = basis
71:         self.report = report
72:         self._query = _query
73:         self._ledger = _ledger
74:         self._closed = False
75: 
76:     def continuation(
77:         self, request: FactRequest, page: FactPage
78:     ) -> Continuation | None:
79:         """Bind ``page.cursor`` to the exact facts request that produced it."""
80:         if page.cursor is None:
81:             return None
82:         if self.basis.projected_through is None:
83:             raise ProjectionAbsent("an unrepresented projection cannot continue")
84:         if self.basis.view_generation is None:
85:             raise InvalidContinuation(
86:                 "this query adapter cannot prove a stable derived view for resume"
87:             )
88:         return Continuation(
89:             captured_head=self.basis.captured_head,
90:             projected_through=self.basis.projected_through,
91:             request=request,
92:             cursor=page.cursor,
93:             view_generation=self.basis.view_generation,
94:         )
95: 
96:     def runtime_epoch(self):
97:         """Return the own signed epoch from this same attested read basis."""
98:         from .declaration import runtime_epoch_from_anchor
99: 
100:         anchor = self.snapshot.declaration_anchor
101:         genesis = anchor.genesis
102:         if genesis is None:
103:             return runtime_epoch_from_anchor(anchor)
104:         return runtime_epoch_from_anchor(
105:             anchor, wire_record=cast(ArrivalLedger, self._ledger).read(genesis.arrival_ordinal)
106:         )
107: 
108:     def close(self) -> None:
109:         """Close snapshot, query handle, then custody handle without leaking."""
110:         if self._closed:
111:             return
112:         self._closed = True
113:         _close_quietly(self.snapshot)
114:         _close_quietly(self._query)
115:         _close_quietly(self._ledger)
116: 
117:     def __enter__(self) -> OpenedRead:
118:         return self
119: 
120:     def __exit__(self, *exc: object) -> None:
121:         self.close()
122: 
123: 
124: def _head_at(ledger: AttestedLedger, head: Head, *, label: str) -> Head:
125:     resolved = ledger.head_at(Watermark(lineage=head.lineage, ordinal=head.ordinal))
126:     if resolved != head:
127:         raise InvalidContinuation(
128:             f"{label} head no longer resolves to its recorded hash"
129:         )
130:     return resolved
131: 
132: 
133: def open_read(
134:     registry: BackendRegistry,
135:     descriptor: StoreDescriptor,
136:     *,
137:     requirement: ProjectionRequirement = ProjectionRequirement.CURRENT,
138:     continuation: Continuation | None = None,
139: ) -> OpenedRead:
140:     """Open one descriptor-first, attested, bounded read without writer access."""
141:     if descriptor.role is None:
142:         raise NotAuthority(
143:             "the supported SDK read path requires an explicit descriptor role"
144:         )
145:     ledger, query = registry.open(descriptor)
146:     snapshot: QuerySnapshot | None = None
147:     try:
148:         if not isinstance(ledger, AttestedLedger):
149:             raise TypeError("BackendRegistry.open must return an AttestedLedger")
150:         report = ledger.opened
151:         comparison = report.comparison
152:         if isinstance(comparison, PreGenesis):
153:             if comparison.ledger_refusal is not None:
154:                 raise comparison.ledger_refusal
155:             raise ProjectionAbsent("a pre-genesis ledger has no captured read head")
156:         if isinstance(comparison, Indeterminate):
157:             raise comparison.refusal
158:         if not isinstance(comparison, Compared):  # defensive against future report arms
159:             raise TypeError(f"unsupported head comparison {comparison!r}")
160: 
161:         if continuation is None:
162:             captured = comparison.presented
163:             represented_from_token = None
164:         else:
165:             if continuation.view_generation is None:
166:                 raise InvalidContinuation(
167:                     "continuations require a derived-view generation"
168:                 )
169:             captured = _head_at(ledger, continuation.captured_head, label="continuation captured")
170:             represented_from_token = _head_at(
171:                 ledger, continuation.projected_through, label="continuation represented"
172:             )
173:             if represented_from_token.ordinal > captured.ordinal:
174:                 raise InvalidContinuation(
175:                     "continuation represented prefix exceeds its captured head"
176:                 )
177: 
178:         snapshot = query.open_snapshot(
179:             captured_head=captured,
180:             requirement=requirement,
181:             continuation=continuation,
182:         )
183:         watermark = snapshot.represented
184:         validate_arrival_declaration_anchor(snapshot.declaration_anchor, captured)
185:         if watermark is None:
186:             if represented_from_token is not None:
187:                 raise InvalidContinuation(
188:                     "projection disappeared since this continuation was issued"
189:                 )
190:             basis = ReadBasis(
191:                 lineage=captured.lineage,
192:                 captured_head=captured,
193:                 projected_through=None,
194:                 view_generation=snapshot.view_generation,
195:             )
196:         elif watermark.lineage != captured.lineage:
197:             raise NotAuthority(
198:                 f"query snapshot represents {watermark.lineage}, not {captured.lineage}"
199:             )
200:         else:
201:             # The query transaction can observe a projection written after the
202:             # seam captured H, including while resuming a prior page. Every
203:             # reported watermark still needs custody membership validation.
204:             observed = complete_projection_custody(
205:                 ledger,
206:                 captured=captured,
207:                 represented=watermark,
208:                 lineage_refusal=NotAuthority,
209:                 conflict_refusal=HeadMismatch,
210:             )
211:             if (
212:                 continuation is not None
213:                 and snapshot.view_generation != continuation.view_generation
214:             ):
215:                 raise InvalidContinuation(
216:                     "projection view changed since this continuation was issued"
217:                 )
218:             if represented_from_token is not None:
219:                 if watermark.ordinal < represented_from_token.ordinal:
220:                     raise InvalidContinuation(
221:                         "projection no longer reaches the continuation prefix"
222:                     )
223:                 basis = ReadBasis(
224:                     lineage=captured.lineage,
225:                     captured_head=captured,
226:                     projected_through=represented_from_token,
227:                     view_generation=snapshot.view_generation,
228:                 )
229:             elif watermark.ordinal > captured.ordinal:
230:                 basis = ReadBasis(
231:                     lineage=captured.lineage,
232:                     captured_head=captured,
233:                     projected_through=captured,
234:                     view_generation=snapshot.view_generation,
235:                 )
236:             else:
237:                 basis = ReadBasis(
238:                     lineage=captured.lineage,
239:                     captured_head=captured,
240:                     projected_through=observed,
241:                     view_generation=snapshot.view_generation,
242:                 )
243:         return OpenedRead(
244:             snapshot=snapshot, basis=basis, report=report, _query=query, _ledger=ledger
245:         )
246:     except BaseException:
247:         if snapshot is not None:
248:             _close_quietly(snapshot)
249:         _close_quietly(query)
250:         _close_quietly(ledger)
251:         raise

280:     return target.with_name(target.name + ".arrival-decl.lock")

283: @contextmanager
284: def _declaration_lock(target: Path):
285:     """Serialize apply/recovery while releasing the lock on process death."""
286:     lock_path = _declaration_lock_path(target)
287:     lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
288:     with lock_path.open("a+b") as lock_fh:
289:         fcntl.flock(lock_fh.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX)
290:         try:
291:             yield
292:         finally:
293:             fcntl.flock(lock_fh.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)

311:         "role": None if descriptor.role is None else descriptor.role.value,
312:         "query": descriptor.query,

314:     }

320:         backend=str(data["backend"]),
321:         location=str(data["location"]),
322:         lineage=data.get("lineage"),
323:         role=None if role is None else Profile(str(role)),
324:         query=data.get("query"),
325:         witness=data.get("witness"),
326:     )
327: 
328: 
329: def _intent_data(plan: DeclarationEditPlan, *, phase: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
330:     return {
331:         "schema": "loops.engine/arrival-declaration-intent/v1",
332:         "phase": phase,
333:         "target": str(plan.target_path),
334:         "descriptor": _descriptor_dict(plan.descriptor),
335:         "lineage": plan.lineage,
336:         "captured_head": _head_dict(plan.captured_head),
337:         "basis": {
338:             "lineage": plan.basis.lineage,
339:             "captured_head": _head_dict(plan.basis.captured_head),
340:             "projected_through": _head_dict(plan.basis.projected_through),
341:             "view_generation": plan.basis.view_generation,
342:         },
343:         "observer": plan.observer,
344:         "fact_ids": list(plan.fact_ids),
345:         "drafts": json.loads(plan.exact_drafts),
346:         "exact_drafts": plan.exact_drafts,
347:         "old_cache_b64": base64.b64encode(plan.old_cache_bytes).decode("ascii"),
348:         "old_cache_sha256": plan.old_cache_sha256,
349:         "proposed_text": plan.proposed_text,
350:         "key_introductions": list(plan.key_introductions),
351:     }

353: 
354: def _fsync_parent(path: Path) -> None:
355:     try:
356:         fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
357:     except OSError:
358:         raise
359:     try:
360:         os.fsync(fd)
361:     finally:
362:         os.close(fd)
363: 
364: 
365: def _write_exclusive_json(path: Path, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
366:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
367:     encoded = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
368:     fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
369:     try:
370:         with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
371:             stream.write(encoded + "\n")
372:             stream.flush()
373:             os.fsync(stream.fileno())
374:         _fsync_parent(path)
375:     except BaseException:
376:         with suppress(FileNotFoundError):
377:             path.unlink()
378:         raise
379: 
380: 
381: def _replace_json(path: Path, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
382:     encoded = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
383:     fd, raw = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)
384:     temp = Path(raw)
385:     try:
386:         with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
387:             stream.write(encoded + "\n")
388:             stream.flush()
389:             os.fsync(stream.fileno())
390:         temp.replace(path)
391:         _fsync_parent(path)
392:     finally:
393:         with suppress(FileNotFoundError):
394:             temp.unlink()
395: 
396: 
397: def _read_intent(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
398:     try:
399:         data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
400:     except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
401:         raise DeclarationApplyError(f"cannot read declaration intent {path}: {exc}") from exc
402:     if (
403:         not isinstance(data, dict)
404:         or data.get("schema") != "loops.engine/arrival-declaration-intent/v1"
405:     ):
406:         raise DeclarationApplyError(f"malformed declaration intent: {path}")
407:     return data
408: 
409: 
410: def _drafts_from_intent(data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[RecordDraft, ...]:
411:     return _drafts_from_exact(
412:         data["drafts"],
413:         str(data.get("exact_drafts", "")),
414:     )
415: 
416: 
417: def _drafts_from_exact(raw: Any, expected_exact: str) -> tuple[RecordDraft, ...]:
418:     if not isinstance(raw, list):
419:         raise DeclarationApplyError("declaration intent drafts are not a list")
420:     drafts = tuple(
421:         RecordDraft(
422:             kind=str(item["kind"]),
423:             authored_at=float(item["authored_at"]),
424:             observer=str(item["observer"]),
425:             origin=str(item["origin"]),
426:             body=dict(item["body"]),
427:             signature=item.get("signature"),
428:         )
429:         for item in raw
430:     )
431:     actual_exact = _exact_drafts(drafts)
432:     if actual_exact != expected_exact:
433:         raise DeclarationApplyError("declaration intent draft bytes do not verify")
434:     return drafts
435: 
436: 
437: def _record_matches_draft(record: Mapping[str, Any], draft: RecordDraft) -> bool:
438:     return (
439:         record.get("k") == draft.kind
440:         and record.get("at") == draft.authored_at
441:         and record.get("observer") == draft.observer
442:         and record.get("origin") == draft.origin
443:         and record.get("body") == dict(draft.body)
444:         and record.get("sig") == draft.signature
445:     )
446: 
447: 
448: def _unique_sibling(path: Path, label: str) -> Path:
449:     fd, raw = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.{label}.", dir=path.parent)
450:     os.close(fd)
451:     candidate = Path(raw)
452:     candidate.unlink()
453:     return candidate
454: 
455: 
456: def _create_cache_temp(path: Path, content: bytes) -> None:
457:     """Create and fsync a complete proposal without replacing an existing path."""
458:     fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
459:     try:
460:         with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
461:             stream.write(content)
462:             stream.flush()
463:             os.fsync(stream.fileno())
464:         _fsync_parent(path)
465:     except BaseException:
466:         with suppress(FileNotFoundError):
467:             path.unlink()
468:         raise
469: 
470: 
471: def _verify_cache_temp(path: Path, expected: bytes) -> None:
472:     """Validate bytes and re-fsync a temp that survived a crash boundary."""
473:     with path.open("rb") as stream:
474:         if stream.read() != expected:
475:             raise DeclarationStale(
476:                 "prepared declaration cache temp bytes differ from the proposal"
477:             )
478:         os.fsync(stream.fileno())
479:     _fsync_parent(path)
480: 
481: 
482: def _publish_cache(
483:     plan: DeclarationEditPlan,
484:     *,
485:     intent: Path,
486:     intent_data: dict[str, Any],
487:     failure_hook: Callable[[str], None] | None,
488: ) -> None:
489:     """Detach the verified old cache, then exclusively link a full new file."""
490:     target = plan.target_path
491:     temp = (
492:         Path(intent_data["cache_temp"])
493:         if intent_data.get("cache_temp")
494:         else _unique_sibling(target, "cache")
495:     )
496:     backup = (
497:         Path(intent_data["cache_backup"])
498:         if intent_data.get("cache_backup")
499:         else _unique_sibling(target, "backup")
500:     )
501:     intent_data["cache_temp"] = str(temp)
502:     intent_data["cache_backup"] = str(backup)
503:     _replace_json(intent, intent_data)
504:     try:
505:         proposed = plan.proposed_text.encode("utf-8")
506:         if temp.exists():
507:             _verify_cache_temp(temp, proposed)
508:         else:
509:             _create_cache_temp(temp, proposed)
510:             if failure_hook:
511:                 failure_hook("after-cache-temp")
512:         if target.exists():
513:             current = target.read_bytes()
514:             if current != plan.old_cache_bytes:
515:                 raise DeclarationStale(
516:                     "declaration cache changed after preparation; refusing publication"
517:                 )
518:             if backup.exists():
519:                 raise DeclarationApplyError(
520:                     "a prior cache publication left a backup beside the live declaration"
521:                 )
522:             target.rename(backup)
523:             _fsync_parent(target)
524:         elif not backup.exists():
525:             raise DeclarationApplyError(
526:                 "declaration cache is absent without the verified detached backup"
527:             )
528:         if failure_hook:
529:             failure_hook("after-cache-detach")
530:         if backup.read_bytes() != plan.old_cache_bytes:
531:             raise DeclarationApplyError(
532:                 "detached declaration cache bytes differ from prepared evidence"
533:             )
534:         os.link(temp, target)
535:         temp.unlink()
536:         _fsync_parent(target)
537:         if failure_hook:
538:             failure_hook("after-cache-link")
539:         with suppress(FileNotFoundError):
540:             backup.unlink()
541:         _fsync_parent(backup)
542:     except BaseException:
543:         raise
544: 
545: 
546: def _cleanup_cache_artifacts(
547:     plan: DeclarationEditPlan, intent_data: Mapping[str, Any]
548: ) -> None:
549:     """Remove only verified publication leftovers after the new cache is live."""
550:     proposed = plan.proposed_text.encode("utf-8")
551:     for field, expected in (
552:         ("cache_temp", proposed),
553:         ("cache_backup", plan.old_cache_bytes),
554:     ):
555:         raw = intent_data.get(field)
556:         if not raw:
557:             continue
558:         path = Path(str(raw))
559:         if not path.exists():
560:             continue
561:         if path.read_bytes() != expected:
562:             raise DeclarationStale(
563:                 f"declaration publication artifact {path} does not match its intent"
564:             )
565:         path.unlink()
566:         _fsync_parent(path)
567: 
568: 
569: def _plan_from_intent(
570:     data: Mapping[str, Any], drafts: tuple[RecordDraft, ...]
571: ) -> DeclarationEditPlan:
572:     captured_data = data["captured_head"]
573:     captured = Head(
574:         lineage=str(captured_data["lineage"]),
575:         ordinal=int(captured_data["ordinal"]),
576:         record_hash=str(captured_data["record_hash"]),
577:     )
578:     old_bytes = base64.b64decode(data["old_cache_b64"], validate=True)
579:     if hashlib.sha256(old_bytes).hexdigest() != data["old_cache_sha256"]:
580:         raise DeclarationApplyError("declaration intent cache bytes do not verify")
581:     basis_data = data.get("basis")
582:     if basis_data is None:
583:         basis = ReadBasis(
584:             lineage=captured.lineage,
585:             captured_head=captured,
586:             projected_through=None,
587:             view_generation=None,
588:         )
589:     else:
590:         if not isinstance(basis_data, Mapping):
591:             raise DeclarationApplyError("declaration intent basis is malformed")
592:         basis_captured_data = basis_data.get("captured_head")
593:         if not isinstance(basis_captured_data, Mapping):
594:             raise DeclarationApplyError("declaration intent captured basis is malformed")
595:         basis_captured = Head(
596:             lineage=str(basis_captured_data["lineage"]),
597:             ordinal=int(basis_captured_data["ordinal"]),
598:             record_hash=str(basis_captured_data["record_hash"]),
599:         )
600:         projected_data = basis_data.get("projected_through")
601:         projected = None
602:         if projected_data is not None:
603:             if not isinstance(projected_data, Mapping):
604:                 raise DeclarationApplyError(
605:                     "declaration intent projected basis is malformed"
606:                 )
607:             projected = Head(
608:                 lineage=str(projected_data["lineage"]),
609:                 ordinal=int(projected_data["ordinal"]),
610:                 record_hash=str(projected_data["record_hash"]),
611:             )
612:         view_generation = basis_data.get("view_generation")
613:         if view_generation is not None and not isinstance(view_generation, str):
614:             raise DeclarationApplyError(
615:                 "declaration intent basis view generation is malformed"
616:             )
617:         basis = ReadBasis(
618:             lineage=str(basis_data["lineage"]),
619:             captured_head=basis_captured,
620:             projected_through=projected,
621:             view_generation=view_generation,
622:         )
623:         if (
624:             basis.lineage != captured.lineage
625:             or basis.captured_head != captured
626:             or basis.projected_through != captured
627:         ):
628:             raise DeclarationStale(
629:                 "declaration intent basis disagrees with its CURRENT predecessor head"
630:             )
631:     return DeclarationEditPlan(
632:         status="planned",
633:         target_path=Path(data["target"]).resolve(),
634:         descriptor=_descriptor_from(data["descriptor"]),
635:         lineage=str(data["lineage"]),
636:         basis=basis,
637:         captured_head=captured,
638:         before_documents=(),
639:         proposed_documents=(),
640:         changes=(),
641:         authored_at=drafts[0].authored_at if drafts else None,
642:         observer=str(data["observer"]),
643:         drafts=drafts,
644:         fact_ids=tuple(str(value) for value in data["fact_ids"]),
645:         key_introductions=tuple(str(value) for value in data.get("key_introductions", ())),
646:         old_cache_bytes=old_bytes,
647:         old_cache_sha256=str(data["old_cache_sha256"]),
648:         proposed_text=str(data["proposed_text"]),
649:         atomic_limit=None,
650:         exact_drafts=str(data["exact_drafts"]),
651:     )
652: 
653: 
654: def _descriptor_location(target: Path, ast: Any, descriptor: StoreDescriptor) -> str:
655:     backend = ast.store_backend
656:     if backend is None:
657:         raise _preparation_refused(
658:             "proposed declaration has no explicit store backend"
659:         )
660:     if descriptor.backend == "file":
661:         if ast.store is None:
662:             raise _preparation_refused(
663:                 "proposed file declaration has no store location"
664:             )
665:         return str(canonical_store_path(ast.store, target))
666:     if ast.store_location is None:
667:         raise _preparation_refused(
668:             "proposed non-file declaration has no opaque store location"
669:         )
670:     return str(ast.store_location)
671: 
672: 
673: def _validate_residence(target: Path, ast: Any, descriptor: StoreDescriptor) -> None:
674:     if descriptor.role is not Profile.AUTHORITY:
675:         raise _preparation_refused(
676:             "declaration edits require an Authority descriptor"
677:         )
678:     if descriptor.lineage is None:
679:         raise _preparation_refused(
680:             "declaration edit descriptor must pin a lineage"
681:         )
682:     backend = ast.store_backend
683:     if (
684:         backend is None
685:         or backend.name != descriptor.backend
686:         or backend.lineage != descriptor.lineage
687:         or backend.role != Profile.AUTHORITY.value
688:     ):
689:         raise _preparation_refused(
690:             "proposed declaration residence must preserve backend, lineage and authority role"
691:         )
692:     if _descriptor_location(target, ast, descriptor) != descriptor.location:
693:         raise _preparation_refused(
694:             "proposed declaration residence must preserve the descriptor location"
695:         )
696: 
697: 
698: def _key_is_well_formed(key: object) -> bool:
699:     if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
700:         return False
701:     try:
702:         return len(base64.b64decode(key, validate=True)) == 32
703:     except (ValueError, TypeError):
704:         return False
705: 
706: 
707: def _valid_author_keys(registry: Any, observer: str, head: Head) -> tuple[str, ...]:
708:     return tuple(
709:         key for key, _introduced in registry.keys_valid_at(observer, head.ordinal + 1)
710:     )
711: 
712: 
713: def _signed_with_existing_key(
714:     *,
715:     credentials: WriteCredentials,
716:     signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None] | None,
717:     verifier: Callable[[str, str, str], bool],
718:     registry: Any,
719:     author: str,
720:     head: Head,
721:     digest: str,
722:     label: str,
723:     domain: SigningDomain,
724:     purpose: CredentialPurpose,
725:     context: CapturedSigningContext,
726:     session: CredentialResolutionSession,
727: ) -> str:
728:     if credentials.mapped:
729:         request = CredentialRequest(
730:             namespace=credentials.binding_namespace,
731:             observer=author,
732:             domain=domain,
733:             purpose=purpose,
734:         )
735:         try:
736:             signature = session.sign(
737:                 credentials,
738:                 request,
739:                 digest,
740:                 context=context,
741:                 authorized_keys=context.keys_for_author(author),
742:                 required=True,
743:             )
744:         except CredentialBindingRefused as exc:
745:             raise _preparation_refused(
746:                 f"{label} mapped credential refused: {exc}",
747:                 captured_head=head,
748:             ) from exc
749:         if signature is None:  # required=True makes this unreachable
750:             raise _preparation_refused(f"missing {label} signature")
751:         return signature
752:     if not callable(signer):
753:         raise _preparation_refused(f"missing {label} signer")
754:     keys = _valid_author_keys(registry, author, head)
755:     if not keys:
756:         raise _preparation_refused(
757:             f"edit author {author!r} has no key valid at the captured Arrival head"
758:         )
759:     signature = signer(author, digest)
760:     if not signature:
761:         raise _preparation_refused(f"missing {label} signature")
762:     if not any(verifier(key, signature, digest) for key in keys):
763:         raise _preparation_refused(
764:             f"{label} signature does not verify under a key valid for edit author "
765:             f"{author!r} at the captured Arrival head"
766:         )
767:     return signature
768: 
769: 
770: def _declaration_row(
771:     change: Change,
772:     *,
773:     lineage: str,
774:     authored_at: float,
775:     observer: str,
776:     credentials: WriteCredentials,
777:     registry: Any,
778:     captured_head: Head,
779:     fact_verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool],
780:     context: CapturedSigningContext,
781:     session: CredentialResolutionSession,
782: ) -> tuple[str, tuple[Any, ...]]:
783:     row_payload: dict[str, Any] = {
784:         "lineage": lineage,
785:         "subject": change.subject,
786:         "change": change.annotation,
787:     }
788:     if change.payload is not None:
789:         row_payload["payload"] = dict(change.payload)
790:     payload_text = json.dumps(row_payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
791:     fact_id = str(ULID())
792:     fact_digest = fact_commitment_hash(
793:         change.kind, authored_at, observer, "", payload_text
794:     )
795:     inner_signature = _signed_with_existing_key(
796:         credentials=credentials,
797:         signer=credentials.fact_signer,
798:         verifier=fact_verify,
799:         registry=registry,
800:         author=observer,
801:         head=captured_head,
802:         digest=fact_digest,
803:         label="FACT",
804:         domain=SigningDomain.FACT,
805:         purpose=CredentialPurpose.AUTHORSHIP,
806:         context=context,
807:         session=session,
808:     )
809:     row = (
810:         fact_id,
811:         change.kind,
812:         authored_at,
813:         observer,
814:         "",
815:         payload_text,
816:         inner_signature,
817:     )
818:     return fact_id, row
819: 
820: 
821: def _key_draft(
822:     author: str,
823:     observer: str,
824:     key: str,
825:     *,
826:     authored_at: float,
827:     credentials: WriteCredentials,
828:     registry: Any,
829:     captured_head: Head,
830:     arrival_verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool],
831:     context: CapturedSigningContext,
832:     session: CredentialResolutionSession,
833: ) -> RecordDraft:
834:     body = {"observer": observer, "key": key}
835:     digest = content_commitment("key", authored_at, author, "", body)
836:     signature = _signed_with_existing_key(
837:         credentials=credentials,
838:         signer=credentials.arrival_signer,
839:         verifier=arrival_verify,
840:         registry=registry,
841:         author=author,
842:         head=captured_head,
843:         digest=digest,
844:         label="Arrival key-introduction",
845:         domain=SigningDomain.ARRIVAL,
846:         purpose=CredentialPurpose.KEY_INTRODUCTION,
847:         context=context,
848:         session=session,
849:     )
850:     return RecordDraft(
851:         kind="key",
852:         authored_at=authored_at,
853:         observer=author,
854:         origin="",
855:         body=body,
856:         signature=signature,
857:     )

859: 
860: def prepare_declaration_edit(
861:     registry: BackendRegistry,
862:     descriptor: StoreDescriptor,
863:     *,
864:     target: Path | str,
865:     proposed_text: str,
866:     observer: str,
867:     credentials: WriteCredentials | None,
868:     fact_verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool],
869:     arrival_verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool],
870:     source_cache_bytes: bytes | None = None,
871:     require_cache_basis: bool = False,
872: ) -> DeclarationEditPlan:
873:     """Prepare one exact declaration transition against an attested CURRENT head.
874: 
875:     This function only reads and signs in memory. It creates no intent, does
876:     not append, and does not touch the declaration cache. The registry opener
877:     is expected to return an attested custody handle; its ``scan`` is the
878:     structurally verified genesis-through-head sequence required by the
879:     iterable authorship seam.
880:     """
881:     target_path = Path(target).resolve()
882:     if not isinstance(proposed_text, str) or not proposed_text:
883:         raise _preparation_refused("proposed declaration text is empty")
884:     try:
885:         old_cache_bytes = target_path.read_bytes()
886:     except OSError as exc:
887:         raise _preparation_refused(
888:             f"cannot read declaration cache {target_path}: {exc}"
889:         ) from exc
890:     if source_cache_bytes is not None and old_cache_bytes != source_cache_bytes:
891:         raise _preparation_refused(
892:             "declaration cache changed while preparing the requested splice"
893:         )
894:     try:
895:         ast = parse_vertex(proposed_text, path=target_path)
896:         validate_vertex(ast)
897:     except Exception as exc:
898:         raise _preparation_refused(
899:             f"proposed declaration is not valid Vertex grammar/semantics: {exc}"
900:         ) from exc
901:     validate_arrival_runtime_identity(
902:         ast.name,
903:         ast.loops,
904:         refusal=_preparation_refused,
905:     )
906:     _validate_residence(target_path, ast, descriptor)
907:     proposed_documents = tuple(
908:         document.as_json() for document in vertex_to_documents(ast)
909:     )
910: 
911:     ledger: ArrivalLedger | None = None
912:     query: ArrivalQuery | None = None
913:     snapshot: Any | None = None
914:     atomic_limit: int | None = None
915:     captured_head: Head | None = None
916:     try:
917:         ledger, query = registry.open(descriptor)
918:         report = getattr(ledger, "opened", None)
919:         comparison = getattr(report, "comparison", None)
920:         if isinstance(comparison, PreGenesis):
921:             if comparison.ledger_refusal is not None:
922:                 raise _preparation_refused(
923:                     f"Arrival ledger is not opened: {comparison.ledger_refusal}"
924:                 )
925:             raise _preparation_refused(
926:                 "Arrival ledger has no captured head for declaration editing"
927:             )
928:         if isinstance(comparison, Indeterminate):
929:             raise _preparation_refused(
930:                 f"Arrival head attestation is indeterminate: {comparison.refusal}"
931:             )
932:         if not isinstance(comparison, Compared):
933:             raise _preparation_refused(
934:                 "registry opener did not provide a compared Arrival head"
935:             )
936:         captured_head = comparison.presented
937:         snapshot = query.open_snapshot(
938:             captured_head=captured_head,
939:             requirement=ProjectionRequirement.CURRENT,
940:             continuation=None,
941:         )
942:         validate_arrival_declaration_anchor(
943:             snapshot.declaration_anchor, captured_head
944:         )
945:         facts = snapshot.facts(
946:             FactRequest(
947:                 limit=None,
948:                 kind="_decl",
949:                 include_internal=True,
950:                 order="oldest",
951:             )
952:         ).items

954:             snapshot.declaration_anchor, facts
955:         )

957:             raise _preparation_refused(
958:                 "the CURRENT Arrival snapshot has no historized declaration"
959:             )
960:         represented = snapshot.represented

962:             raise _preparation_refused(
963:                 "the CURRENT declaration snapshot has no matching lineage basis"
964:             )

966:             ledger,
967:             captured=captured_head,
968:             represented=represented,

970:             conflict_refusal=lambda message: _preparation_refused(message),
971:         )
972:         if projected.ordinal < captured_head.ordinal:
973:             behind = ProjectionBehind(
974:                 "the CURRENT declaration snapshot is behind the captured Arrival head"
975:             )
976:             behind.captured_head = captured_head
977:             behind.projected_head = projected
978:             raise behind
979:         basis = ReadBasis(
980:             lineage=captured_head.lineage,

988:                 local_ast = parse_vertex(

991:                 local_documents = tuple(
992:                     document.as_json() for document in vertex_to_documents(local_ast)
993:                 )

996:                     f"current declaration cache is not valid for this splice: {exc}"
997:                 ) from exc

1000:                     "declaration cache differs from CURRENT Arrival history; "
1001:                     "convenience mutation refused"

1004:         continuity_ticks = tuple(
1005:             snapshot.ticks(TickRequest(since=float("-inf")))
1006:         )

1008:             snapshot.declaration_anchor,
1009:             facts,
1010:             target_documents=proposed_documents,

1015:             facts,
1016:             continuity_ticks,

1018:             verified_params=verified_params,

1021:                 wire_record=(

1024:                 ),

1028:         if credentials is not None and credentials.mapped:
1029:             mapped_verifier = credentials.signature_verifier
1030:             if mapped_verifier is None:  # guarded by WriteCredentials construction
1031:                 raise _preparation_refused(
1032:                     "mapped declaration credentials have no signature verifier",
1033:                     captured_head=captured_head,
1034:                 )
1035:             def registry_verifier(key: str, signature: str, digest: str) -> bool:
1036:                 return mapped_verifier(
1037:                     SigningDomain.ARRIVAL, key, signature, digest
1038:                 )

1040:             ledger.scan(through=captured_head), registry_verifier
1041:         )

1043:     except DeclarationPreparationError:
1044:         raise
1045:     except BoundaryContinuityConflict as exc:
1046:         raise _preparation_refused(
1047:             f"boundary continuity refuses declaration preparation: {exc}",
1048:             captured_head=captured_head,
1049:         ) from exc
1050:     except Exception as exc:
1051:         raise _preparation_refused(
1052:             f"cannot establish declaration preparation basis: {exc}",
1053:             captured_head=captured_head,
1054:             projected_head=getattr(exc, "projected_head", None),
1055:         ) from exc

1057:         _close_quietly(snapshot)
1058:         _close_quietly(query)
1059:         _close_quietly(ledger)
1060: 
1061:     if not changes:
1062:         return DeclarationEditPlan(
1063:             status="noop",
1064:             target_path=target_path,
1065:             descriptor=descriptor,
1066:             lineage=captured_head.lineage,
1067:             basis=basis,
1068:             captured_head=captured_head,
1069:             before_documents=before_documents,
1070:             proposed_documents=proposed_documents,
1071:             changes=(),
1072:             authored_at=None,
1073:             observer=observer,
1074:             drafts=(),
1075:             fact_ids=(),
1076:             key_introductions=(),
1077:             old_cache_bytes=old_cache_bytes,
1078:             old_cache_sha256=hashlib.sha256(old_cache_bytes).hexdigest(),
1079:             proposed_text=proposed_text,
1080:             atomic_limit=atomic_limit,
1081:             exact_drafts=_exact_drafts(()),
1082:         )

1084:     if credentials is None:
1085:         raise _preparation_refused(
1086:             "declaration edits require fact and Arrival signers"
1087:         )

1089:         captured_head=captured_head,
1090:         author_keys=tuple(
1091:             (
1092:                 named_observer,
1093:                 tuple(
1094:                     key
1095:                     for key, _introduced in key_registry.keys_valid_at(
1096:                         named_observer, captured_head.ordinal + 1
1097:                     )
1098:                 ),
1099:             )
1100:             for named_observer in sorted(key_registry.introductions)
1101:         ),
1102:         receipt_keys=(),
1103:     )

1107:     fact_ids: list[str] = []
1108:     for change in changes:

1110:             change,
1111:             lineage=captured_head.lineage,
1112:             authored_at=authored_at,
1113:             observer=observer,

1115:             registry=key_registry,
1116:             captured_head=captured_head,
1117:             fact_verify=fact_verify,
1118:             context=signing_context,
1119:             session=credential_session,
1120:         )

1122:         rows.append(row)
1123:     body = body_of_fact_row(rows[0]) if len(rows) == 1 else body_of_batch(rows)
1124:     envelope_kind = "fact" if len(rows) == 1 else "batch"
1125:     envelope_digest = content_commitment(
1126:         envelope_kind, authored_at, observer, "", body
1127:     )

1129:         credentials=credentials,
1130:         signer=credentials.arrival_signer,
1131:         verifier=arrival_verify,
1132:         registry=key_registry,
1133:         author=observer,
1134:         head=captured_head,
1135:         digest=envelope_digest,
1136:         label="Arrival declaration envelope",
1137:         domain=SigningDomain.ARRIVAL,
1138:         purpose=CredentialPurpose.AUTHORSHIP,
1139:         context=signing_context,
1140:         session=credential_session,
1141:     )
1142:     declaration_draft = RecordDraft(
1143:         kind=envelope_kind,
1144:         authored_at=authored_at,
1145:         observer=observer,
1146:         origin="",
1147:         body=body,
1148:         signature=outer_signature,
1149:     )
1150: 
1151:     proposed_keys: dict[str, str] = {}
1152:     for document in proposed_documents:
1153:         if document["kind"] != DECL_OBSERVER_DEFINED:
1154:             continue
1155:         key = document["payload"].get("key")
1156:         if key is None:
1157:             continue
1158:         if not _key_is_well_formed(key):
1159:             raise _preparation_refused(
1160:                 f"observer {document['subject']!r} carries a malformed public key"
1161:             )
1162:         proposed_keys[str(document["subject"])] = str(key)
1163:     existing_keys = {
1164:         named_observer: {key for key, _ordinal in keys}
1165:         for named_observer, keys in key_registry.introductions.items()
1166:     }
1167:     key_drafts: list[RecordDraft] = []
1168:     for named_observer, key in proposed_keys.items():
1169:         if key in existing_keys.get(named_observer, set()):
1170:             continue
1171:         key_drafts.append(
1172:             _key_draft(
1173:                 observer,
1174:                 named_observer,
1175:                 key,
1176:                 authored_at=authored_at,
1177:                 credentials=credentials,
1178:                 registry=key_registry,
1179:                 captured_head=captured_head,
1180:                 arrival_verify=arrival_verify,
1181:                 context=signing_context,
1182:                 session=credential_session,
1183:             )
1184:         )
1185: 
1186:     drafts = tuple((*key_drafts, declaration_draft))
1187:     if atomic_limit is not None and len(drafts) > atomic_limit:
1188:         raise AtomicLimitExceeded(
1189:             f"declaration edit needs {len(drafts)} Arrival records, but the "
1190:             f"backend atomic limit is {atomic_limit}; refused before append"
1191:         )
1192:     return DeclarationEditPlan(
1193:         status="planned",
1194:         target_path=target_path,
1195:         descriptor=descriptor,
1196:         lineage=captured_head.lineage,
1197:         basis=basis,
1198:         captured_head=captured_head,
1199:         before_documents=before_documents,
1200:         proposed_documents=proposed_documents,
1201:         changes=changes,
1202:         authored_at=authored_at,
1203:         observer=observer,
1204:         drafts=drafts,
1205:         fact_ids=tuple(fact_ids),
1206:         key_introductions=tuple(draft.body["observer"] for draft in key_drafts),
1207:         old_cache_bytes=old_cache_bytes,
1208:         old_cache_sha256=hashlib.sha256(old_cache_bytes).hexdigest(),
1209:         proposed_text=proposed_text,
1210:         atomic_limit=atomic_limit,
1211:         exact_drafts=_exact_drafts(drafts),
1212:         credential_bindings=credential_session.evidence,
1213:     )

1216: def _result(
1217:     plan: DeclarationEditPlan,
1218:     *,
1219:     status: str,
1220:     head: Head | None,
1221:     commit: Any | None,
1222:     intent: Path | None,
1223:     phase: str,
1224:     file_written: bool,
1225:     changes: tuple[Change, ...] | None,
1226: ) -> DeclarationEditResult:
1227:     return DeclarationEditResult(
1228:         status=status, target_path=plan.target_path, descriptor=plan.descriptor,
1229:         lineage=plan.lineage, basis=plan.basis,
1230:         captured_head=plan.captured_head, head=head,
1231:         commit=commit, fact_ids=plan.fact_ids, intent_path=intent,
1232:         phase=phase, file_written=file_written, changes=changes,
1233:     )

1236: def _validate_plan(plan: DeclarationEditPlan) -> None:
1237:     if plan.status not in {"planned", "noop"}:
1238:         raise DeclarationApplyError("only a planned declaration edit can be applied")
1239:     if _exact_drafts(plan.drafts) != plan.exact_drafts:
1240:         raise DeclarationApplyError(
1241:             "declaration plan drafts changed after preparation; refusing append"
1242:         )
1243:     if hashlib.sha256(plan.old_cache_bytes).hexdigest() != plan.old_cache_sha256:
1244:         raise DeclarationApplyError(
1245:             "declaration plan cache evidence changed after preparation"
1246:         )
1247: 
1248: 
1249: def _remove_intent(path: Path) -> None:
1250:     try:
1251:         path.unlink()
1252:     except FileNotFoundError:
1253:         return
1254:     _fsync_parent(path)
1255: 
1256: 
1257: def apply_declaration_edit(
1258:     registry: BackendRegistry,
1259:     plan: DeclarationEditPlan,
1260:     *,
1261:     failure_hook: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
1262: ) -> DeclarationEditResult:
1263:     """Apply an edit under the target's process-safe operation lock."""
1264:     with _declaration_lock(plan.target_path):
1265:         return _apply_declaration_edit(
1266:             registry, plan, failure_hook=failure_hook
1267:         )
1268: 
1269: 
1270: def _apply_declaration_edit(
1271:     registry: BackendRegistry,
1272:     plan: DeclarationEditPlan,
1273:     *,
1274:     failure_hook: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
1275: ) -> DeclarationEditResult:
1276:     """Append one prepared declaration transition and publish its cache.
1277: 
1278:     The prepared drafts are submitted exactly once under the captured full
1279:     head. Contract refusals are zero-prefix stale refusals; transport and
1280:     witness failures retain the intent and their identity for recovery.
1281:     """
1282:     _validate_plan(plan)
1283:     if plan.status == "noop":
1284:         return _result(
1285:             plan, status="noop", head=plan.captured_head, commit=None, intent=None,
1286:             phase="noop", file_written=False, changes=plan.changes,
1287:         )
1288:     intent = declaration_intent_path(plan.target_path)
1289:     try:
1290:         if plan.target_path.read_bytes() != plan.old_cache_bytes:
1291:             raise DeclarationStale(
1292:                 "declaration cache changed after preparation; refusing append"
1293:             )
1294:     except OSError as exc:
1295:         raise DeclarationApplyError(
1296:             f"cannot recheck declaration cache before append: {exc}"
1297:         ) from exc
1298:     data = _intent_data(plan, phase="prepared")
1299:     append_drafts = _drafts_from_exact(
1300:         json.loads(plan.exact_drafts), plan.exact_drafts
1301:     )
1302:     try:
1303:         _write_exclusive_json(intent, data)
1304:     except FileExistsError as exc:
1305:         raise DeclarationApplyError(
1306:             f"unfinished declaration intent already exists: {intent}"
1307:         ) from exc
1308:     if failure_hook:
1309:         try:
1310:             failure_hook("after-intent")
1311:         except Exception as exc:
1312:             raise DeclarationApplyError(
1313:                 "declaration intent was durable but append did not start"
1314:             ) from exc
1315: 
1316:     ledger: Any | None = None
1317:     query: Any | None = None
1318:     commit: Any | None = None
1319:     head: Head | None = None
1320:     append_entered = False
1321:     try:
1322:         ledger, query = registry.open(plan.descriptor)
1323:         try:
1324:             append_entered = True
1325:             commit = ledger.append(plan.captured_head, append_drafts)
1326:         except Exception as exc:
1327:             from .arrival_contract import ContractRefusal
1328:             from .arrival_head_seam import NotWitnessed
1329: 
1330:             if isinstance(exc, ContractRefusal):
1331:                 _remove_intent(intent)
1332:                 raise DeclarationStale(
1333:                     f"declaration append refused before mutation: {exc}"
1334:                 ) from exc
1335:             if isinstance(exc, NotWitnessed):
1336:                 head = exc.head
1337:                 data["phase"] = "append-unwitnessed"
1338:                 with suppress(Exception):
1339:                     _replace_json(intent, data)
1340:                 raise DeclarationUnwitnessed(
1341:                     "declaration records committed but their witness is unknown",
1342:                     head=exc.head, commit=exc.commit, intent_path=intent,
1343:                     fact_ids=plan.fact_ids, cause=exc,
1344:                 ) from exc
1345:             data["phase"] = "append-unknown"
1346:             with suppress(Exception):
1347:                 _replace_json(intent, data)
1348:             raise DeclarationOutcomeUnknown(
1349:                 "declaration append outcome is unknown; recover the intent",
1350:                 head=None, intent_path=intent, fact_ids=plan.fact_ids, cause=exc,
1351:             ) from exc
1352:         head = commit.after
1353:         try:
1354:             data["phase"] = "appended"
1355:             _replace_json(intent, data)
1356:             if failure_hook:
1357:                 failure_hook("after-append")
1358:         except Exception as exc:
1359:             raise DeclarationCommittedIncomplete(
1360:                 "declaration append committed but append phase recording failed",
1361:                 phase="appended", head=head, commit=commit, intent_path=intent,
1362:                 fact_ids=plan.fact_ids, cause=exc,
1363:             ) from exc
1364:     except (DeclarationStale, DeclarationUnwitnessed, DeclarationOutcomeUnknown,
1365:             DeclarationCommittedIncomplete):
1366:         raise
1367:     except Exception as exc:
1368:         if not append_entered:
1369:             raise DeclarationApplyError(
1370:                 "declaration append was refused before entering the append call; "
1371:                 "prepared intent retained for inspection",
1372:             ) from exc
1373:         raise DeclarationOutcomeUnknown(
1374:             "declaration append path failed; recover the intent",
1375:             head=head, intent_path=intent, fact_ids=plan.fact_ids, cause=exc,
1376:         ) from exc
1377:     finally:
1378:         _close_quietly(query)
1379:         _close_quietly(ledger)
1380: 
1381:     try:
1382:         from .arrival_maintenance import sync_projection
1383: 
1384:         sync_projection(registry, plan.descriptor, through=head)
1385:         data["phase"] = "synced"
1386:         _replace_json(intent, data)
1387:         if failure_hook:
1388:             failure_hook("after-sync")
1389:         data["phase"] = "publishing"
1390:         _publish_cache(
1391:             plan, intent=intent, intent_data=data, failure_hook=failure_hook
1392:         )
1393:         data["phase"] = "published"
1394:         _replace_json(intent, data)
1395:         if failure_hook:
1396:             failure_hook("before-intent-remove")
1397:         _remove_intent(intent)
1398:     except Exception as exc:
1399:         raise DeclarationCommittedIncomplete(
1400:             "declaration append committed but a later phase failed; recover the intent",
1401:             phase=str(data.get("phase", "appended")), head=head,
1402:             commit=commit, intent_path=intent, fact_ids=plan.fact_ids, cause=exc,
1403:         ) from exc
1404:     return _result(
1405:         plan, status="applied", head=head, commit=commit, intent=None,
1406:         phase="published", file_written=True, changes=plan.changes,
1407:     )
1408: 
1409: 
1410: def recover_declaration_edit(
1411:     registry: BackendRegistry,
1412:     intent: Path | str,
1413:     *,
1414:     failure_hook: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
1415: ) -> DeclarationEditResult:
1416:     """Recover an edit under the target's process-safe operation lock."""
1417:     intent_path = Path(intent).resolve()
1418:     with _declaration_lock(Path(_read_intent(intent_path)["target"])):
1419:         return _recover_declaration_edit(
1420:             registry, intent_path, failure_hook=failure_hook
1421:         )
1422: 
1423: 
1424: def _recover_declaration_edit(
1425:     registry: BackendRegistry,
1426:     intent: Path | str,
1427:     *,
1428:     failure_hook: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
1429: ) -> DeclarationEditResult:
1430:     """Reconcile an edit intent by exact suffix membership, then finish cache."""
1431:     intent_path = Path(intent).resolve()
1432:     data = _read_intent(intent_path)
1433:     drafts = _drafts_from_intent(data)
1434:     plan = _plan_from_intent(data, drafts)
1435:     captured = plan.captured_head
1436:     ledger: Any | None = None
1437:     query: Any | None = None
1438:     try:
1439:         ledger, query = registry.open(plan.descriptor)
1440:         captured_at_ledger = ledger.head_at(
1441:             Watermark(lineage=captured.lineage, ordinal=captured.ordinal)
1442:         )
1443:         if captured_at_ledger != captured:
1444:             raise DeclarationStale(
1445:                 "declaration intent predecessor head hash no longer matches"
1446:             )
1447:         actual = ledger.head()
1448:         if actual == captured:
1449:             if data.get("cache_temp") or data.get("cache_backup"):
1450:                 raise DeclarationApplyError(
1451:                     "unapplied declaration intent has cache publication artifacts"
1452:                 )
1453:             if plan.target_path.read_bytes() != plan.old_cache_bytes:
1454:                 raise DeclarationStale(
1455:                     "unapplied declaration intent has competing cache bytes"
1456:                 )
1457:             _remove_intent(intent_path)
1458:             return _result(
1459:                 plan, status="not-applied", head=actual, commit=None, intent=None,
1460:                 phase="not-applied", file_written=False, changes=None,
1461:             )
1462:         first = captured.ordinal + 1
1463:         for index, draft in enumerate(drafts):
1464:             ordinal = first + index
1465:             if actual.ordinal < ordinal or not _record_matches_draft(
1466:                 ledger.read(ordinal), draft
1467:             ):
1468:                 raise DeclarationStale(
1469:                     "declaration intent does not occupy its exact expected suffix"
1470:                 )
1471:     except DeclarationStale:
1472:         raise
1473:     except Exception as exc:
1474:         raise DeclarationApplyError(
1475:             f"cannot reconcile declaration intent against Arrival custody: {exc}"
1476:         ) from exc
1477:     finally:
1478:         _close_quietly(query)
1479:         _close_quietly(ledger)
1480: 
1481:     file_written = False
1482:     try:
1483:         from .arrival_maintenance import sync_projection
1484: 
1485:         sync_projection(registry, plan.descriptor, through=actual)
1486:         data["phase"] = "synced"
1487:         _replace_json(intent_path, data)
1488:         if failure_hook:
1489:             failure_hook("after-sync")
1490:         if plan.target_path.exists():
1491:             current = plan.target_path.read_bytes()
1492:             if current == plan.proposed_text.encode("utf-8"):
1493:                 _cleanup_cache_artifacts(plan, data)
1494:                 data["phase"] = "published"
1495:                 _replace_json(intent_path, data)
1496:             elif current == plan.old_cache_bytes:
1497:                 data["phase"] = "publishing"
1498:                 _publish_cache(
1499:                     plan, intent=intent_path, intent_data=data,
1500:                     failure_hook=failure_hook,
1501:                 )
1502:                 file_written = True
1503:                 data["phase"] = "published"
1504:                 _replace_json(intent_path, data)
1505:             else:
1506:                 raise DeclarationStale(
1507:                     "competing declaration cache bytes are present; refusing overwrite"
1508:                 )
1509:         elif data.get("cache_backup"):
1510:             data["phase"] = "publishing"
1511:             _publish_cache(
1512:                 plan, intent=intent_path, intent_data=data,
1513:                 failure_hook=failure_hook,
1514:             )
1515:             file_written = True
1516:             data["phase"] = "published"
1517:             _replace_json(intent_path, data)
1518:         else:
1519:             raise DeclarationApplyError(
1520:                 "declaration cache is missing and has no detached recovery backup"
1521:             )
1522:         _remove_intent(intent_path)
1523:     except Exception as exc:
1524:         raise DeclarationCommittedIncomplete(
1525:             "declaration custody is committed but cache recovery remains incomplete",
1526:             phase=str(data.get("phase", "synced")), head=actual, commit=None,
1527:             intent_path=intent_path, fact_ids=plan.fact_ids, cause=exc,
1528:         ) from exc
1529:     return _result(
1530:         plan, status="recovered", head=actual, commit=None, intent=None,
1531:         phase="published", file_written=file_written, changes=None,
1532:     )

=== libs/engine/src/engine/arrival_initialization.py ===
1: """Fresh Arrival initialization and recovery.
2: 
3: This module is intentionally a coordinator.  It knows the Arrival contracts
4: and the registry, but it never opens a concrete store or a projection itself.
5: The file adapter is therefore just one possible implementation of the
6: operation.
7: """
8:

50: def new_lineage() -> str:
51:     """Mint one stable lineage identifier for a reserved initialization."""
52:     return str(ULID())

55: class ArrivalInitializationError(ArrivalError):
56:     """A fresh Arrival initialization could not complete."""
57: 
58: 
59: class InitializationConflict(ArrivalInitializationError):
60:     """An existing artifact does not match the durable initialization plan."""
61: 
62: 
63: class InitializationRecoveryRequired(ArrivalInitializationError):
64:     """An unfinished initialization intent must be recovered explicitly."""
65: 
66: 
67: class InitializationOutcomeUnknown(ArrivalInitializationError):
68:     """An initialization append did not prove whether it committed."""
69: 
70:     def __init__(
71:         self,
72:         message: str,
73:         *,
74:         phase: str,
75:         lineage: str,
76:         fact_id: str,
77:         captured_head: Head | None,
78:         intent_path: Path,
79:         cause: BaseException,
80:     ) -> None:
81:         super().__init__(message)
82:         self.phase = phase
83:         self.lineage = lineage
84:         self.fact_id = fact_id
85:         self.captured_head = captured_head
86:         self.intent_path = str(intent_path)
87:         self.cause = cause

132: def arrival_intent_path(target: Path | str) -> Path:
133:     """The exclusive intent sidecar for one declaration target."""
134: 
135:     target_path = Path(target).resolve()
136:     return target_path.with_name(target_path.name + ".arrival-init.intent")
137: 
138: 
139: def _json_value(value: Any) -> Any:
140:     if isinstance(value, Path):
141:         return str(value)
142:     if isinstance(value, Profile):
143:         return value.value
144:     if isinstance(value, Head):
145:         return {
146:             "lineage": value.lineage,
147:             "ordinal": value.ordinal,
148:             "record_hash": value.record_hash,
149:         }
150:     if isinstance(value, Mapping):
151:         return {str(k): _json_value(v) for k, v in value.items()}
152:     if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
153:         return [_json_value(v) for v in value]
154:     return value
155: 
156: 
157: def _atomic_write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
158:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
159:     fd, raw = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)
160:     tmp = Path(raw)
161:     try:
162:         with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
163:             stream.write(text)
164:             stream.flush()
165:             os.fsync(stream.fileno())
166:         tmp.replace(path)
167:         _fsync_parent(path)
168:     finally:
169:         with suppress(FileNotFoundError):
170:             tmp.unlink()
171: 
172: 
173: def _reserve(path: Path, plan: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
174:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
175:     encoded = json.dumps(_json_value(plan), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
176:     flags = os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL
177:     fd = os.open(path, flags, 0o600)
178:     try:
179:         with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
180:             stream.write(encoded + "\n")
181:             stream.flush()
182:             os.fsync(stream.fileno())
183:         _fsync_parent(path)
184:     except BaseException:
185:         with suppress(FileNotFoundError):
186:             path.unlink()
187:         raise
188: 
189: 
190: def _save_intent(path: Path, plan: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
191:     _atomic_write(path, json.dumps(_json_value(plan), sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
192: 
193: 
194: def _publish_exclusive(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
195:     """Publish a complete declaration without replacing a concurrent writer."""
196:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
197:     fd, raw = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)
198:     temporary = Path(raw)
199:     try:
200:         with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
201:             stream.write(text)
202:             stream.flush()
203:             os.fsync(stream.fileno())
204:         os.link(temporary, path)
205:         temporary.unlink()
206:         _fsync_parent(path)
207:     except BaseException:
208:         with suppress(FileNotFoundError):
209:             temporary.unlink()
210:         raise
211: 
212: 
213: def _fsync_parent(path: Path) -> None:
214:     directory_fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY)
215:     try:
216:         os.fsync(directory_fd)
217:     finally:
218:         os.close(directory_fd)
219: 
220: 
221: def _reserved_genesis_signer(
222:     plan: Mapping[str, Any],
223: ) -> Callable[[str, str], str | None]:
224:     """Return the exact signature reserved before the durable mint."""
225:     genesis = plan["genesis"]
226:     digest = content_commitment(
227:         genesis["kind"], genesis["at"], genesis["observer"],
228:         genesis["origin"], genesis["body"],
229:     )
230: 
231:     def sign(observer: str, offered_digest: str) -> str | None:
232:         if observer == genesis["observer"] and offered_digest == digest:
233:             return genesis["signature"]
234:         return None
235: 
236:     return sign
237: 
238: 
239: def _read_intent(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
240:     try:
241:         data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
242:     except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
243:         raise InitializationConflict(f"cannot read initialization intent {path}: {exc}") from exc
244:     if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get("schema") != _INTENT_SCHEMA:
245:         raise InitializationConflict(f"unsupported or malformed initialization intent: {path}")
246:     if data.get("phase") not in _PHASES:
247:         raise InitializationConflict(f"initialization intent has an invalid phase: {path}")
248:     return data
249:

251: def _descriptor_dict(descriptor: StoreDescriptor) -> dict[str, Any]:
252:     return {
253:         "backend": descriptor.backend,
254:         "location": descriptor.location,
255:         "lineage": descriptor.lineage,
256:         "role": None if descriptor.role is None else descriptor.role.value,
257:         "query": descriptor.query,
258:         "witness": descriptor.witness,
259:     }
260: 
261: 
262: def _descriptor_from(data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> StoreDescriptor:
263:     role = data.get("role")
264:     return StoreDescriptor(
265:         backend=str(data["backend"]),
266:         location=str(data["location"]),
267:         lineage=data.get("lineage"),
268:         role=None if role is None else Profile(str(role)),
269:         query=data.get("query"),
270:         witness=data.get("witness"),
271:     )
