273: 
274: def build_declaration_anchor_draft(
275:     *,
276:     lineage: str,
277:     authored_at: float,
278:     observer: str,
279:     documents: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
280:     fact_signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None],
281:     arrival_signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None],
282:     public_key: str | None = None,
283:     fact_verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool] | None = None,
284:     arrival_verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool] | None = None,
285:     runtime_epoch: str = "strict",
286: ) -> RecordDraft:
287:     if runtime_epoch not in {"strict", "fresh"}:
288:         raise ArrivalInitializationError("unsupported declaration runtime epoch")
289:     payload_body: dict[str, Any] = {
290:         "protocol": 1 if runtime_epoch == "strict" else 2,
291:         "documents": [dict(document) for document in documents],
292:     }
293:     if runtime_epoch == "fresh":
294:         payload_body["runtime_epoch"] = "fresh-after-anchor-v1"
295:     payload = json.dumps(
296:         payload_body,
297:         ensure_ascii=False,
298:         separators=(",", ":"),
299:     )
300:     inner_digest = fact_commitment_hash(
301:         "_decl.genesis", authored_at, observer, "", payload
302:     )
303:     inner_signature = fact_signer(observer, inner_digest)
304:     if not inner_signature:
305:         raise ArrivalInitializationError(
306:             f"founding observer {observer!r} has no fact signer"
307:         )
308:     if fact_verify is not None and (
309:         public_key is None or not fact_verify(public_key, inner_signature, inner_digest)
310:     ):
311:         raise ArrivalInitializationError("founding fact signer does not match the public key")
312:     body = body_of_fact_row(
313:         (lineage, "_decl.genesis", authored_at, observer, "", payload, inner_signature)
314:     )
315:     outer_digest = content_commitment("fact", authored_at, observer, "", body)
316:     outer_signature = arrival_signer(observer, outer_digest)
317:     if not outer_signature:
318:         raise ArrivalInitializationError(
319:             f"founding observer {observer!r} has no Arrival signer"
320:         )
321:     if arrival_verify is not None and (
322:         public_key is None or not arrival_verify(public_key, outer_signature, outer_digest)
323:     ):
324:         raise ArrivalInitializationError("founding Arrival signer does not match the public key")
325:     return RecordDraft(
326:         kind="fact",
327:         authored_at=authored_at,
328:         observer=observer,
329:         origin="",
330:         body=body,
331:         signature=outer_signature,
332:     )
333: 
334: 
335: def _same_record(record: Mapping[str, Any], draft: RecordDraft) -> bool:
336:     return (
337:         record.get("k") == draft.kind
338:         and record.get("at") == draft.authored_at
339:         and record.get("observer") == draft.observer
340:         and record.get("origin") == draft.origin
341:         and record.get("body") == dict(draft.body)
342:         and record.get("sig") == draft.signature
343:     )
344: 
345: 
346: def _declared_key_drafts(
347:     documents: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
348:     *,
349:     observer: str,
350:     public_key: str,
351:     at: float,
352:     signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None],
353:     verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool] | None,
354: ) -> tuple[RecordDraft, ...]:
355:     """Introduce declared observer keys using the valid founding key."""
356:     keys: dict[str, str] = {}
357:     for document in documents:
358:         if document["kind"] != "_decl.observer-defined":
359:             continue
360:         key = document["payload"].get("key")
361:         if key is None:
362:             continue
363:         subject = document["subject"]
364:         try:
365:             if not isinstance(key, str) or len(base64.b64decode(key, validate=True)) != 32:
366:                 raise ValueError
367:         except (ValueError, TypeError):
368:             raise InitializationConflict(
369:                 f"observer {subject!r} has a malformed public key"
370:             ) from None
371:         if subject == observer:
372:             if key != public_key:
373:                 raise InitializationConflict(
374:                     "declared founding key differs from genesis public key"
375:                 )
376:             continue
377:         if subject in keys and keys[subject] != key:
378:             raise InitializationConflict(f"observer {subject!r} has conflicting declared keys")
379:         keys[subject] = key
380:     drafts: list[RecordDraft] = []
381:     for subject, key in keys.items():
382:         body = {"observer": subject, "key": key}
383:         digest = content_commitment("key", at, observer, "", body)
384:         signature = signer(observer, digest)
385:         if not signature or (
386:             verify is not None and not verify(public_key, signature, digest)
387:         ):
388:             raise InitializationConflict("founding signer cannot authenticate key introduction")
389:         drafts.append(RecordDraft("key", at, observer, "", body, signature))
390:     return tuple(drafts)
391: 
392: 
393: def _draft_dict(draft: RecordDraft) -> dict[str, Any]:
394:     return {
395:         "kind": draft.kind,
396:         "authored_at": draft.authored_at,
397:         "observer": draft.observer,
398:         "origin": draft.origin,
399:         "body": dict(draft.body),
400:         "signature": draft.signature,
401:     }
402: 
403: 
404: def _bootstrap_matches(ledger: Any, current: Head, drafts: Sequence[RecordDraft]) -> bool:
405:     return current.ordinal >= len(drafts) and all(
406:         _same_record(ledger.read(ordinal), draft)
407:         for ordinal, draft in enumerate(drafts, start=1)
408:     )

410: 
411: def _phase(plan: dict[str, Any], value: str) -> None:
412:     plan["phase"] = value
413: 
414: 
415: def _check_preconditions(
416:     target: Path,
417:     descriptor: StoreDescriptor,
418:     documents: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
419:     declaration_text: str,
420:     observer: str,
421:     public_key: str,
422:     signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None],
423:     fact_signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None],
424:     arrival_signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None],
425: ) -> None:
426:     if descriptor.role is not Profile.AUTHORITY:
427:         raise InitializationConflict("fresh initialization requires an Authority descriptor")
428:     if not observer or not isinstance(observer, str):
429:         raise InitializationConflict("fresh initialization requires a non-empty observer")
430:     if not isinstance(public_key, str) or not public_key:
431:         raise InitializationConflict("fresh initialization requires a founding public key")
432:     try:
433:         if len(base64.b64decode(public_key, validate=True)) != 32:
434:             raise ValueError
435:     except (ValueError, TypeError):
436:         raise InitializationConflict(
437:             "founding public key must be raw-32-byte base64"
438:         ) from None
439:     if not isinstance(declaration_text, str) or not declaration_text.strip():
440:         raise InitializationConflict("declaration text must be non-empty UTF-8 text")
441:     if not callable(signer) or not callable(fact_signer) or not callable(arrival_signer):
442:         raise InitializationConflict("fresh initialization requires signer callables")
443:     if not isinstance(documents, Sequence) or isinstance(documents, (str, bytes)):
444:         raise InitializationConflict("declaration documents must be a sequence")
445:     try:
446:         json.dumps([dict(document) for document in documents], ensure_ascii=False)
447:     except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
448:         raise InitializationConflict(f"declaration documents are not JSON-safe: {exc}") from exc
449:     if target.exists():
450:         raise InitializationConflict(f"vertex file already exists: {target}")
451: 
452: 
453: def _validate_declaration(
454:     target: Path,
455:     descriptor: StoreDescriptor,
456:     documents: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
457:     declaration_text: str,
458:     lineage: str,
459: ) -> None:
460:     """Check the signed declaration inputs before reserving or minting.
461: 
462:     The declaration text is the human ingress form and the document sequence
463:     is what gets committed into ``_decl.genesis``.  They must describe the
464:     same residence and identity, otherwise recovery could faithfully preserve
465:     a plan that never represented the requested target.
466:     """
467:     try:
468:         from lang import parse_vertex, validate_vertex, vertex_to_documents
469: 
470:         ast = parse_vertex(declaration_text, path=target)
471:         validate_vertex(ast)
472:     except Exception as exc:
473:         raise InitializationConflict(
474:             f"declaration text is not valid Vertex grammar: {exc}"
475:         ) from exc
476:     from .declaration import validate_arrival_runtime_identity
477: 
478:     validate_arrival_runtime_identity(
479:         ast.name,
480:         ast.loops,
481:         refusal=InitializationConflict,
482:     )
483:     parsed_documents = [document.as_json() for document in vertex_to_documents(ast)]
484:     if [dict(document) for document in documents] != parsed_documents:
485:         raise InitializationConflict(
486:             "declaration text and declaration documents disagree"
487:         )
488:     backend = ast.store_backend
489:     if (
490:         backend is None
491:         or backend.name != descriptor.backend
492:         or backend.lineage != lineage
493:         or backend.role != Profile.AUTHORITY.value
494:     ):
495:         raise InitializationConflict(
496:             "declaration residence must match the requested backend, lineage and authority role"
497:         )
498:     location = ast.store_location
499:     if descriptor.backend == "file" and ast.store is not None:
500:         location = str(ast.store)
501:     if location is None:
502:         raise InitializationConflict("declaration residence must include a store location")
503:     if descriptor.backend == "file":
504:         parsed_location = (target.parent / location).resolve()
505:         requested_location = Path(descriptor.location).resolve()
506:         locations_match = parsed_location == requested_location
507:     else:
508:         # DSNs are adapter-owned and must survive the engine untouched.
509:         locations_match = location == descriptor.location
510:     if not locations_match:
511:         raise InitializationConflict(
512:             "declaration residence location does not match the requested descriptor"
513:         )
514: 
515: 
516: def initialize_arrival(
517:     registry: BackendRegistry,
518:     descriptor: StoreDescriptor,
519:     *,
520:     target: Path | str,
521:     documents: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
522:     declaration_text: str,
523:     observer: str,
524:     public_key: str,
525:     signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None],
526:     fact_signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None],
527:     arrival_signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None],
528:     fact_verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool] | None = None,
529:     arrival_verify: Callable[[str, str, str], bool] | None = None,
530:     lineage: str | None = None,
531:     authored_at: float | None = None,
532:     failure_hook: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
533: ) -> ArrivalInitializationResult:
534:     """Mint and publish a fresh Arrival declaration with recoverable intent."""
535:     target_path = Path(target).resolve()
536:     intent = arrival_intent_path(target_path)
537:     _check_preconditions(
538:         target_path, descriptor, documents, declaration_text, observer, public_key,
539:         signer, fact_signer, arrival_signer,
540:     )
541:     if intent.exists():
542:         raise InitializationRecoveryRequired(
543:             f"unfinished initialization intent exists: {intent}; recover explicitly"
544:         )
545:     chosen_lineage = lineage or descriptor.lineage or new_lineage()
546:     if descriptor.lineage is not None and descriptor.lineage != chosen_lineage:
547:         raise InitializationConflict("descriptor lineage does not match reserved lineage")
548:     _validate_declaration(
549:         target_path, descriptor, documents, declaration_text, chosen_lineage
550:     )
551:     at = time.time() if authored_at is None else authored_at
552:     genesis_body = {
553:         "protocol": 1,
554:         "lineage": chosen_lineage,
555:         "key": public_key,
556:     }
557:     genesis_digest = content_commitment(
558:         "genesis", at, observer, "", genesis_body
559:     )
560:     genesis_signature = signer(observer, genesis_digest)
561:     if not genesis_signature:
562:         raise InitializationConflict("founding signer produced no genesis signature")
563:     if arrival_verify is not None and not arrival_verify(
564:         public_key, genesis_signature, genesis_digest
565:     ):
566:         raise InitializationConflict("founding genesis signer does not match the public key")
567:     draft = build_declaration_anchor_draft(
568:         lineage=chosen_lineage,
569:         authored_at=at,
570:         observer=observer,
571:         documents=documents,
572:         fact_signer=fact_signer,
573:         arrival_signer=arrival_signer,
574:         public_key=public_key,
575:         fact_verify=fact_verify,
576:         arrival_verify=arrival_verify,
577:     )
578:     key_drafts = _declared_key_drafts(
579:         documents, observer=observer, public_key=public_key, at=at,
580:         signer=arrival_signer, verify=arrival_verify,
581:     )
582:     if key_drafts:
583:         # The minimum backend contract supports one record. Additional keys
584:         # and declaration genesis form one larger atomic unit; refuse its
585:         # unsupported size before reserving an intent or minting a lineage.
586:         ledger, query = registry.open(descriptor)
587:         try:
588:             limit = ledger.capabilities().max_atomic_records
589:             if limit is not None and len(key_drafts) + 1 > limit:
590:                 raise AtomicLimitExceeded(
591:                     f"initialization needs {len(key_drafts) + 1} records; atomic limit is {limit}"
592:                 )
593:         finally:
594:             for resource in (query, ledger):
595:                 close = getattr(resource, "close", None)
596:                 if callable(close):
597:                     close()
598:     planned = {
599:         "schema": _INTENT_SCHEMA,
600:         "phase": "reserved",
601:         "target": str(target_path),
602:         "descriptor": _descriptor_dict(
603:             StoreDescriptor(
604:                 descriptor.backend, descriptor.location, chosen_lineage,
605:                 descriptor.role, descriptor.query, descriptor.witness,
606:             )
607:         ),
608:         "lineage": chosen_lineage,
609:         "observer": observer,
610:         "public_key": public_key,
611:         "at": at,
612:         "genesis": {
613:             "kind": "genesis",
614:             "at": at,
615:             "observer": observer,
616:             "origin": "",
617:             "body": genesis_body,
618:             "signature": genesis_signature,
619:         },
620:         "documents": [dict(document) for document in documents],
621:         "declaration_text": declaration_text,
622:         "draft": _draft_dict(draft),
623:         "key_drafts": [_draft_dict(key_draft) for key_draft in key_drafts],
624:     }
625:     _reserve(intent, planned)
626:     try:
627:         return _continue(
628:             registry, intent, planned, failure_hook=failure_hook,
629:         )
630:     except BaseException:
631:         # The sidecar is the recovery record.  It is removed only once the
632:         # declaration bytes have been atomically published.
633:         raise
634: 
635: 
636: def _continue(
637:     registry: BackendRegistry,
638:     intent: Path,
639:     plan: dict[str, Any],
640:     *,
641:     failure_hook: Callable[[str], None] | None,
642: ) -> ArrivalInitializationResult:
643:     descriptor = _descriptor_from(plan["descriptor"])
644:     target = Path(plan["target"])
645:     draft_data = plan["draft"]
646:     draft = RecordDraft(
647:         kind=draft_data["kind"], authored_at=draft_data["authored_at"],
648:         observer=draft_data["observer"], origin=draft_data["origin"],
649:         body=draft_data["body"], signature=draft_data["signature"],
650:     )
651:     drafts = tuple(RecordDraft(**data) for data in plan.get("key_drafts", ())) + (draft,)
652:     ledger = query = None
653:     head: Head | None = None
654:     commit = None
655:     try:
656:         if plan["phase"] == "reserved":
657:             ledger, query = registry.open(descriptor)
658:             # PreGenesis carries no absence claim.  The adapter's exclusive
659:             # mint is the authority for an absent, existing, or corrupt
660:             # location and refuses safely in the latter two cases.
661:             try:
662:                 head = ledger.mint({
663:                     "observer": plan["observer"],
664:                     "signer": _reserved_genesis_signer(plan),
665:                     "key": plan["public_key"], "lineage": plan["lineage"],
666:                     "origin": "", "at": plan["at"],
667:                 })
668:             except Exception as mint_error:
669:                 from .arrival import GenesisRefused
670:                 from .arrival_contract import ContractRefusal
671:                 from .arrival_head_seam import NotWitnessed
672: 
673:                 if isinstance(mint_error, NotWitnessed):
674:                     raise InitializationUnwitnessed(
675:                         "genesis committed but its witness is unknown; recover "
676:                         "the initialization intent before retrying",
677:                         phase="reserved", lineage=plan["lineage"],
678:                         fact_id=plan["lineage"], head=mint_error.head,
679:                         commit=mint_error.commit, intent_path=intent,
680:                         cause=mint_error,
681:                     ) from mint_error
682:                 # A prior mint may have committed while its witness was
683:                 # unknown.  The failed exclusive mint is the proof that this
684:                 # is not a fresh location; only an exact custody comparison
685:                 # can turn that case into recoverable progress.
686:                 try:
687:                     head = _head_and_check_genesis(registry, descriptor, plan)
688:                 except Exception:
689:                     if isinstance(mint_error, (ContractRefusal, GenesisRefused)):
690:                         raise mint_error from None
691:                     raise InitializationOutcomeUnknown(
692:                         "genesis mint outcome is unknown; recover the durable "
693:                         "initialization intent before retrying",
694:                         phase="reserved", lineage=plan["lineage"],
695:                         fact_id=plan["lineage"], captured_head=None,
696:                         intent_path=intent, cause=mint_error,
697:                     ) from mint_error
698:                 if head.ordinal != 0:
699:                     raise mint_error from None
700:             _phase(plan, "minted")
701:             _save_intent(intent, plan)
702:             if failure_hook:
703:                 failure_hook("after-mint")
704:         else:
705:             head = _head_and_check_genesis(registry, descriptor, plan)
706:         if plan["phase"] == "minted":
707:             if ledger is None:
708:                 ledger, query = registry.open(descriptor)
709:             current = ledger.head()
710:             if current.ordinal == 0:
711:                 try:
712:                     commit = ledger.append(current, drafts)
713:                 except Exception as exc:
714:                     # Contract/grammar refusals are precommit diagnostics;
715:                     # an adapter exception outside those public families did
716:                     # not establish whether its append landed.
717:                     from .arrival_contract import ContractRefusal
718: 
719:                     if isinstance(exc, ContractRefusal):
720:                         raise
721:                     from .arrival import GenesisRefused
722: 
723:                     if isinstance(exc, GenesisRefused):
724:                         raise
725:                     from .arrival_head_seam import NotWitnessed
726: 
727:                     if isinstance(exc, NotWitnessed):
728:                         raise InitializationUnwitnessed(
729:                             "declaration committed but its witness is unknown; "
730:                             "recover the initialization intent before retrying",
731:                             phase="minted", lineage=plan["lineage"],
732:                             fact_id=str(draft.body["id"]), head=exc.head,
733:                             commit=exc.commit, intent_path=intent, cause=exc,
734:                         ) from exc
735:                     raise InitializationOutcomeUnknown(
736:                         "declaration append outcome is unknown; recover the "
737:                         "initialization intent before retrying",
738:                         phase="minted", lineage=plan["lineage"],
739:                         fact_id=str(draft.body["id"]), captured_head=current,
740:                         intent_path=intent, cause=exc,
741:                     ) from exc
742:                 head = commit.after
743:             elif _bootstrap_matches(ledger, current, drafts):
744:                 head = current
745:             else:
746:                 raise InitializationConflict("ledger contains a conflicting post-genesis record")
747:             _phase(plan, "declared")
748:             _save_intent(intent, plan)
749:             if failure_hook:
750:                 failure_hook("after-declaration")
751:         if plan["phase"] == "declared":
752:             if ledger is None:
753:                 ledger, query = registry.open(descriptor)
754:             current = ledger.head()
755:             # The declaration append is already durable at this point.  Keep
756:             # its observed head while projection sync runs so a sync failure
757:             # is reported as committed-incomplete with concrete identity.
758:             head = current
759:             if not _bootstrap_matches(ledger, current, drafts):
760:                 raise InitializationConflict(
761:                     "ledger no longer contains the planned declaration genesis"
762:                 )
763:             result = sync_projection(registry, descriptor)
764:             head = result.captured_head
765:             _phase(plan, "synced")
766:             _save_intent(intent, plan)
767:             if failure_hook:
768:                 failure_hook("after-sync")
769:         elif plan["phase"] in {"synced", "published"}:
770:             if ledger is None:
771:                 ledger, query = registry.open(descriptor)
772:             current = ledger.head()
773:             # Recovery has an observed committed head before attempting
774:             # publication or intent cleanup.
775:             head = current
776:             if not _bootstrap_matches(ledger, current, drafts):
777:                 raise InitializationConflict(
778:                     "ledger no longer contains the planned declaration genesis"
779:                 )
780:         else:
781:             head = ledger.head() if ledger is not None else _head_and_check_genesis(
782:                 registry, descriptor, plan
783:             )
784:         if plan["phase"] == "synced":
785:             if target.exists():
786:                 existing = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
787:                 if existing != plan["declaration_text"]:
788:                     raise InitializationConflict(
789:                         "existing declaration differs from initialization intent"
790:                     )
791:             else:
792:                 try:
793:                     _publish_exclusive(target, plan["declaration_text"])
794:                 except FileExistsError:
795:                     existing = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
796:                     if existing != plan["declaration_text"]:
797:                         raise InitializationConflict(
798:                             "a concurrent declaration differs from initialization intent"
799:                         ) from None
800:             _phase(plan, "published")
801:             _save_intent(intent, plan)
802:             if failure_hook:
803:                 failure_hook("after-publication")
804:         if plan["phase"] == "published":
805:             with suppress(FileNotFoundError):
806:                 intent.unlink()
807:                 _fsync_parent(intent)
808:         return ArrivalInitializationResult(
809:             target_path=str(target), location=descriptor.location,
810:             lineage=plan["lineage"], head=head,
811:             phase=plan["phase"], file_written=target.exists(),
812:         )
813:     except Exception as exc:
814:         if isinstance(
815:             exc,
816:             (
817:                 InitializationOutcomeUnknown,
818:                 InitializationUnwitnessed,
819:                 InitializationCommittedIncomplete,
820:             ),
821:         ):
822:             raise
823:         if head is not None and plan["phase"] in {"minted", "declared", "synced", "published"}:
824:             raise InitializationCommittedIncomplete(
825:                 "initialization committed but a later phase failed; recover "
826:                 "the durable intent",
827:                 phase=plan["phase"], lineage=plan["lineage"],
828:                 fact_id=str(draft.body["id"]), captured_head=head,
829:                 commit=commit, intent_path=intent, cause=exc,
830:             ) from exc
831:         raise
832:     finally:
833:         close = getattr(query, "close", None)
834:         if callable(close):
835:             close()
836:         close = getattr(ledger, "close", None)
837:         if callable(close):
838:             close()
839: 
840: 
841: def _head_and_check_genesis(
842:     registry: BackendRegistry,
843:     descriptor: StoreDescriptor,
844:     plan: Mapping[str, Any],
845: ) -> Head:
846:     ledger, query = registry.open(descriptor)
847:     try:
848:         head = ledger.head()
849:         record = ledger.read(0)
850:         body = record.get("body")
851:         genesis = plan["genesis"]
852:         if (
853:             record.get("k") != genesis["kind"]
854:             or record.get("at") != genesis["at"]
855:             or record.get("observer") != genesis["observer"]
856:             or record.get("origin") != genesis["origin"]
857:             or body != genesis["body"]
858:             or record.get("sig") != genesis["signature"]
859:         ):
860:             raise InitializationConflict("existing genesis differs from initialization intent")
861:         if head.lineage != plan["lineage"]:
862:             raise InitializationConflict(
863:                 "existing ledger lineage differs from initialization intent"
864:             )
865:         return head
866:     finally:
867:         getattr(query, "close", lambda: None)()
868:         getattr(ledger, "close", lambda: None)()
869: 
870: 
871: def recover_arrival_initialization(
872:     registry: BackendRegistry,
873:     intent: Path | str,
874:     *,
875:     # Retained as ignored compatibility parameters for callers of the first
876:     # recovery prototype. Recovery signs nothing: it uses the exact reserved
877:     # genesis signature from the durable intent.
878:     signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None] | None = None,
879:     fact_signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None] | None = None,
880:     arrival_signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None] | None = None,
881:     failure_hook: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
882: ) -> ArrivalInitializationResult:
883:     """Resume an intent by comparing exact custody content at every phase."""
884:     intent_path = Path(intent).resolve()
885:     if not intent_path.exists():
886:         raise InitializationConflict(f"initialization intent does not exist: {intent_path}")
887:     plan = _read_intent(intent_path)
888:     return _continue(
889:         registry, intent_path, plan, failure_hook=failure_hook,
890:     )

=== libs/engine/src/engine/arrival_sources.py ===
1: """Captured, tier-atomic source execution for an Arrival Authority.
2: 
3: Collection has no custody handle.  A CURRENT runtime capture is taken before
4: each tier's collectors run, and the resulting observations are planned against
5: that same head.  A completed tier uses one batch append and explicit projection
6: catch-up; failures retain collection and any durable commits without retrying a
7: collector.
8: """

351: def _latest_success(facts: Sequence[Any], kind: str) -> Any | None:
352:     matching = [
353:         fact
354:         for fact in facts
355:         if fact.kind == f"_sync.{kind}" and fact.payload.get("status") == "ok"
356:     ]
357:     return max(matching, key=lambda fact: (fact.ts, fact.id), default=None)
358: 
359: 
360: def _cadence_evidence(
361:     source_index: int,
362:     source: Any,
363:     cadence: Any,
364:     facts: Sequence[Any],
365:     *,
366:     evaluated_at: float,
367:     force: bool,
368: ) -> CadenceEvidence:
369:     last = _latest_success(facts, source.kind)
370:     mode = cadence.mode
371:     trigger_ids: tuple[str, ...] = ()
372:     interval = getattr(cadence, "_interval", None)
373:     if mode == "always":
374:         qualified = True
375:     elif mode == "elapsed":
376:         qualified = last is None or evaluated_at - last.ts >= interval
377:     elif mode == "triggered":
378:         threshold = float("-inf") if last is None else last.ts
379:         trigger_ids = tuple(
380:             fact.id
381:             for fact in facts
382:             if fact.kind in cadence.trigger_kinds and fact.ts > threshold
383:         )
384:         qualified = bool(trigger_ids)
385:     else:
386:         qualified = False
387:     if force:
388:         qualified = True
389:     return CadenceEvidence(
390:         source_index=source_index,
391:         kind=source.kind,
392:         mode=mode,
393:         evaluated_at=evaluated_at,
394:         latest_success_id=None if last is None else last.id,
395:         latest_success_ts=None if last is None else last.ts,
396:         trigger_fact_ids=trigger_ids,
397:         interval_seconds=interval,
398:         forced=force,
399:         qualified=qualified,
400:     )
401: 
402: 
403: def _source_observers(source: Any) -> tuple[str, ...]:
404:     nested = getattr(source, "sources", None)
405:     if nested is not None:
406:         return tuple(observer for item in nested for observer in _source_observers(item))
407:     observer = getattr(source, "observer", "")
408:     return (observer,) if observer else ()
409: 
410: 
411: def _preflight_known_admission(
412:     capture: RuntimeCapture,
413:     sources: Sequence[tuple[Any, Any]],
414:     qualifying: Sequence[int],
415:     *,
416:     observer: str,
417:     credentials: WriteCredentials,
418:     lifecycle_ids: Sequence[str],
419:     overall_sync_id: str,
420: ) -> None:
421:     from .admission import grant_for_observer
422: 
423:     effective = capture.effective_declaration
424:     try:
425:         grant_for_observer(effective, observer)
426:         for index in qualifying:
427:             for source_observer in _source_observers(sources[index][0]):
428:                 grant_for_observer(effective, source_observer)
429:         known = [
430:             BatchFactInput(
431:                 Fact.of(
432:                     f"_sync.{sources[index][0].kind}",
433:                     observer,
434:                     ts=capture.evaluated_at,
435:                     command=sources[index][0].command,
436:                     status="ok",
437:                 ),
438:                 fact_id=lifecycle_ids[index],
439:                 admit_undeclared=True,
440:             )
441:             for index in qualifying
442:         ]
443:         known.append(
444:             BatchFactInput(
445:                 Fact.of(
446:                     "_sync",
447:                     observer,
448:                     ts=capture.evaluated_at,
449:                     status="ok",
450:                     sources_run=len(qualifying),
451:                 ),
452:                 fact_id=overall_sync_id,
453:                 admit_undeclared=True,
454:             )
455:         )
456:         # One at a time checks exact lifecycle grant/strict/tick-signing rules
457:         # without imposing a fictitious whole-invocation atomic limit.
458:         for item in known:
459:             plan_batch_from_capture(capture, (item,), credentials=credentials)
460:         if capture.pending_boundaries:
461:             # Pending ticks are already known at H and can require a tick signer
462:             # in a signed era. Refuse before any external collector runs.
463:             plan_batch_from_capture(
464:                 capture,
465:                 (),
466:                 credentials=credentials,
467:                 include_pending_boundaries=True,
468:             )
469:     except Exception as exc:
470:         raise SourcePreparationRefused(
471:             "source lifecycle admission refused before collection",
472:             capture=capture,
473:             cause=exc,
474:         ) from exc
475: 
476: 
477: def prepare_source_invocation(
478:     registry: BackendRegistry,
479:     descriptor: StoreDescriptor,
480:     locator: Any,
481:     *,
482:     observer: str,
483:     credentials: WriteCredentials,
484:     force: bool = False,
485:     evaluated_at: float | None = None,
486:     id_factory: Callable[[], str] = _new_id,
487: ) -> SourceInvocationPlan:
488:     """Capture H, cadence, source order and tiers before any collector runs."""
489:     from .executor import _build_dependency_graph, _toposort_tiers
490: 
491:     if not observer:
492:         raise ValueError("source lifecycle observer must be explicit and nonempty")
493:     capture = capture_runtime(
494:         registry,
495:         descriptor,
496:         locator,
497:         source_mode=True,
498:         evaluated_at=evaluated_at,
499:         credentials=credentials,
500:     )
501:     sources = capture.sources
502:     evidence = tuple(
503:         _cadence_evidence(
504:             index,
505:             source,
506:             cadence,
507:             capture.runtime_facts,
508:             evaluated_at=capture.evaluated_at,
509:             force=force,
510:         )
511:         for index, (source, cadence) in enumerate(sources)
512:     )
513:     qualifying = tuple(item.source_index for item in evidence if item.qualified)
514:     deps = _build_dependency_graph(list(sources))
515:     tiers = tuple(tuple(tier) for tier in _toposort_tiers(set(qualifying), deps))
516:     invocation_id = id_factory()
517:     lifecycle_ids = tuple(id_factory() for _ in sources)
518:     overall_sync_id = id_factory()
519:     _preflight_known_admission(
520:         capture,
521:         sources,
522:         qualifying,
523:         observer=observer,
524:         credentials=credentials,
525:         lifecycle_ids=lifecycle_ids,
526:         overall_sync_id=overall_sync_id,
527:     )
528:     return SourceInvocationPlan(
529:         invocation_id=invocation_id,
530:         observer=observer,
531:         initial_capture=capture,
532:         cadence=evidence,
533:         qualifying_indices=qualifying,
534:         tiers=tiers,
535:         lifecycle_ids=lifecycle_ids,
536:         overall_sync_id=overall_sync_id,
537:     )
538: 
539: 
540: async def _close_owned_streams(
541:     stream: object | None,
542:     iterator: object | None,
543:     *,
544:     primary: BaseException | None,
545: ) -> Exception | None:
546:     """Attempt async close on the iterator and owner before propagating interruption.
547: 
548:     This releases Python iterator resources only. It does not claim that an
549:     underlying collector reversed or terminated any external effect.
550:     """
551:     failures: list[Exception] = []
552:     handles: list[object] = []
553:     deferred_interrupt: BaseException | None = None
554:     primary_is_interrupt = primary is not None and not isinstance(primary, Exception)
555:     for handle in (iterator, stream):
556:         if handle is None or any(handle is existing for existing in handles):
557:             continue
558:         handles.append(handle)
559:         try:
560:             close = getattr(handle, "aclose", None)
561:             if not callable(close):
562:                 continue
563:             await close()
564:         except Exception as exc:
565:             failures.append(exc)
566:         except BaseException as exc:
567:             if not primary_is_interrupt and deferred_interrupt is None:
568:                 deferred_interrupt = exc
569:     if deferred_interrupt is not None:
570:         raise deferred_interrupt
571:     return failures[0] if failures else None
572: 
573: 
574: async def _collect_one(
575:     invocation: SourceInvocationPlan,
576:     state: _CollectionState,
577:     source: Any,
578:     collector_factory: CollectorFactory | None,
579:     *,
580:     clock: Callable[[], float],
581:     id_factory: Callable[[], str],
582: ) -> CollectedSource:
583:     status: Literal["ok", "error", "invalid"] = "ok"
584:     stderr = ""
585:     returncode: int | None = None
586:     error_type: str | None = None
587:     error_message: str | None = None
588:     invalid: InvalidSourceOutput | None = None
589:     stream: object | None = None
590:     iterator: object | None = None
591:     primary: BaseException | None = None
592:     try:
593:         stream = source.collect() if collector_factory is None else collector_factory(source)
594:         iterator = aiter(stream)
595:         async for value in iterator:
596:             if not isinstance(value, Fact):
597:                 invalid = InvalidSourceOutput(state.source_index, value)
598:                 primary = invalid
599:                 status = "invalid"
600:                 break
601:             try:
602:                 fact_id = id_factory()
603:                 state.pairs.append((value, fact_id))
604:             except Exception as exc:
605:                 failure = _CollectionStepFailed(state, "bookkeeping", exc)
606:                 primary = failure
607:                 raise failure from exc
608:     except _CollectionStepFailed:
609:         raise
610:     except asyncio.CancelledError as exc:
611:         primary = exc
612:         raise
613:     except SourceError as exc:
614:         primary = exc
615:         status = "error"
616:         stderr = exc.stderr
617:         returncode = exc.returncode
618:         error_type = type(exc).__name__
619:         error_message = str(exc)
620:     except Exception as exc:
621:         primary = exc
622:         status = "error"
623:         error_type = type(exc).__name__
624:         error_message = str(exc)
625:     except BaseException as exc:
626:         primary = exc
627:         raise
628:     finally:
629:         cleanup_error = await _close_owned_streams(
630:             stream, iterator, primary=primary
631:         )
632:         if cleanup_error is not None and primary is None:
633:             raise _CollectionStepFailed(state, "cleanup", cleanup_error) from cleanup_error
634: 
635:     try:
636:         payload: dict[str, Any] = {
637:             "command": state.command,
638:             "status": "error" if status != "ok" else "ok",
639:             "count": len(state.pairs),
640:             "invocation_id": invocation.invocation_id,
641:             "source_index": state.source_index,
642:         }
643:         if stderr:
644:             payload["stderr"] = stderr
645:         if returncode is not None:
646:             payload["returncode"] = returncode
647:         if error_type is not None:
648:             payload["error_type"] = error_type
649:         if error_message is not None:
650:             payload["error"] = error_message
651:         if invalid is not None:
652:             payload["error_type"] = type(invalid).__name__
653:             payload["error"] = str(invalid)
654:         lifecycle = Fact(
655:             f"_sync.{state.kind}",
656:             clock(),
657:             payload,
658:             observer=invocation.observer,
659:         )
660:         return CollectedSource(
661:             source_index=state.source_index,
662:             kind=state.kind,
663:             command=state.command,
664:             source_observer=state.source_observer,
665:             facts=tuple(fact for fact, _fact_id in state.pairs),
666:             fact_ids=tuple(fact_id for _fact, fact_id in state.pairs),
667:             lifecycle_fact=lifecycle,
668:             lifecycle_id=invocation.lifecycle_ids[state.source_index],
669:             status=status,
670:             stderr=stderr,
671:             returncode=returncode,
672:             error_type=error_type,
673:             error_message=error_message,
674:             invalid_output=invalid,
675:         )
676:     except Exception as exc:
677:         raise _CollectionStepFailed(state, "bookkeeping", exc) from exc
678: 
679: 
680: async def collect_source_tier(
681:     invocation: SourceInvocationPlan,
682:     capture: RuntimeCapture,
683:     tier_index: int,
684:     collector_factory: CollectorFactory | None = None,
685:     *,
686:     clock: Callable[[], float] = time.time,
687:     id_factory: Callable[[], str] = _new_id,
688: ) -> CollectedTier:
689:     """Collect one fixed tier concurrently while retaining source-list order."""
690:     indices = invocation.tiers[tier_index]
691:     sources = invocation.initial_capture.sources
692:     states = [
693:         _CollectionState(
694:             source_index=index,
695:             kind=sources[index][0].kind,
696:             command=sources[index][0].command,
697:             source_observer=sources[index][0].observer,
698:             pairs=[],
699:         )
700:         for index in indices
701:     ]
702:     tasks = [
703:         asyncio.create_task(
704:             _collect_one(
705:                 invocation,
706:                 state,
707:                 sources[state.source_index][0],
708:                 collector_factory,
709:                 clock=clock,
710:                 id_factory=id_factory,
711:             )
712:         )
713:         for state in states
714:     ]
715:     try:
716:         collected = tuple(await asyncio.gather(*tasks))
717:     except _CollectionStepFailed as primary:
718:         for task in tasks:
719:             if not task.done():
720:                 task.cancel()
721:         settled = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
722:         for result in settled:
723:             if isinstance(result, BaseException) and not isinstance(
724:                 result, (_CollectionStepFailed, asyncio.CancelledError)
725:             ):
726:                 # This sibling already owns its chaining evidence. Adding or
727:                 # clearing a cause here would rewrite the control exception.
728:                 raise result  # noqa: B904
729:         completed = tuple(
730:             result for result in settled if isinstance(result, CollectedSource)
731:         )
732:         failed = tuple(
733:             result.state.partial(result.phase, result.cause)
734:             for result in settled
735:             if isinstance(result, _CollectionStepFailed)
736:         )
737:         cancelled = tuple(
738:             state.partial("cancelled")
739:             for state, result in zip(states, settled, strict=True)
740:             if isinstance(result, asyncio.CancelledError)
741:         )
742:         raise SourceTierCollectionFailed(
743:             tier_index=tier_index,
744:             basis=capture.basis,
745:             completed_sources=completed,
746:             failed_sources=failed,
747:             cancelled_sources=cancelled,
748:             cause=primary.cause,
749:         ) from primary.cause
750:     except BaseException:
751:         for task in tasks:
752:             if not task.done():
753:                 task.cancel()
754:         await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
755:         raise
756:     return CollectedTier(
757:         tier_index=tier_index,
758:         basis=capture.basis,
759:         sources=collected,
760:         include_pending_boundaries=tier_index == 0,
761:     )
762: 
763: 
764: def _overall_fact(
765:     invocation: SourceInvocationPlan,
766:     collected: Sequence[CollectedTier],
767:     *,
768:     now: float,
769: ) -> Fact:
770:     sources = [source for tier in collected for source in tier.sources]
771:     errors = sum(source.status != "ok" for source in sources)
772:     total = sum(len(source.facts) + 1 for source in sources)
773:     duration_ms = max(0, int((now - invocation.initial_capture.evaluated_at) * 1000))
774:     return Fact.of(
775:         "_sync",
776:         invocation.observer,
777:         ts=now,
778:         status="error" if errors else "ok",
779:         sources_run=len(invocation.qualifying_indices),
780:         sources_skipped=len(invocation.skipped),
781:         source_errors=errors,
782:         total_facts=total,
783:         duration_ms=duration_ms,
784:         invocation_id=invocation.invocation_id,
785:     )
786: 
787: 
788: def prepare_collected_tier(
789:     capture: RuntimeCapture,
790:     collected: CollectedTier,
791:     *,
792:     credentials: WriteCredentials,
793:     overall_fact: Fact | None = None,
794:     overall_sync_id: str | None = None,
795: ) -> BatchWritePlan:
796:     """Turn retained collection into one exact-H tier batch plan."""
797:     try:
798:         if collected.basis != capture.basis:
799:             raise ValueError(
800:                 "collected tier basis does not match the runtime capture basis"
801:             )
802:         invalid = next(
803:             (
804:                 source.invalid_output
805:                 for source in collected.sources
806:                 if source.invalid_output is not None
807:             ),
808:             None,
809:         )
810:         if invalid is not None:
811:             raise invalid
812:         items: list[BatchFactInput] = []
813:         for source in collected.sources:
814:             items.extend(
815:                 BatchFactInput(fact, fact_id=fact_id)
816:                 for fact, fact_id in zip(source.facts, source.fact_ids, strict=True)
817:             )
818:             items.append(
819:                 BatchFactInput(
820:                     source.lifecycle_fact,
821:                     fact_id=source.lifecycle_id,
822:                     admit_undeclared=True,
823:                 )
824:             )
825:         if overall_fact is not None:
826:             if overall_sync_id is None:
827:                 raise ValueError("overall_sync_id is required with overall_fact")
828:             items.append(
829:                 BatchFactInput(
830:                     overall_fact,
831:                     fact_id=overall_sync_id,
832:                     admit_undeclared=True,
833:                 )
834:             )
835:         return plan_batch_from_capture(
836:             capture,
837:             items,
838:             credentials=credentials,
839:             include_pending_boundaries=collected.include_pending_boundaries,
840:         )
841:     except Exception as exc:
842:         if isinstance(exc, SourceTierPreparationRefused):
843:             raise
844:         raise SourceTierPreparationRefused(collected, exc) from exc
845: 
846: 
847: def _dispatch_intents(
848:     capture: RuntimeCapture, plan: BatchWritePlan
849: ) -> tuple[DispatchIntent, ...]:
850:     runs = {
851:         **dict(zip(plan.pending_tick_ids, plan.pending_tick_runs, strict=True)),
852:         **{
853:             item.tick_id: item.tick_run
854:             for item in plan.items
855:             if item.tick_id is not None
856:         },
857:     }
858:     vertex_path = capture.effective_declaration.path
859:     intents: list[DispatchIntent] = []
860:     for draft in plan.drafts:
861:         if draft.kind != "tick":
862:             continue
863:         body = draft.body
864:         tick_id = str(body["id"])
865:         command = runs.get(tick_id)
866:         if not command:
867:             continue
868:         payload_text = str(body["payload"])
869:         payload = json.loads(payload_text)
870:         intents.append(
871:             DispatchIntent(
872:                 tick_id=tick_id,
873:                 tick_name=str(body["name"]),
874:                 command=command,
875:                 ts=float(body["ts"]),
876:                 since=None if body["since"] is None else float(body["since"]),
877:                 origin=str(body["origin"]),
878:                 payload_text=payload_text,
879:                 payload=MappingProxyType(payload),
880:                 fact_cursor=body.get("fact_cursor"),
881:                 window_start=body.get("window_start"),
882:                 window_hash=body.get("window_hash"),
883:                 vertex_path=vertex_path,
884:             )
885:         )
886:     return tuple(intents)
887: 
888: 
889: def _result(
890:     invocation: SourceInvocationPlan,
891:     *,
892:     bases: Sequence[ReadBasis],
893:     collected: Sequence[CollectedTier],
894:     durable: Sequence[TierCommitted],
895:     terminal_tier: CollectedTier | None = None,
896:     terminal_plan: BatchWritePlan | None = None,
897:     collected_uncommitted: CollectedTier | None = None,
898:     collected_unknown: CollectedTier | None = None,
899:     terminal: BaseException | None = None,
900: ) -> SourceInvocationResult:
901:     error_ids = tuple(
902:         source.lifecycle_id
903:         for tier in collected
904:         for source in tier.sources
905:         if source.status != "ok"
906:     )
907:     durable_indices = {tier.tier_index for tier in durable}
908:     durable_error_ids = tuple(
909:         source.lifecycle_id
910:         for tier in collected
911:         if tier.tier_index in durable_indices
912:         for source in tier.sources
913:         if source.status != "ok"
914:     )
915:     status: Literal["ok", "error", "incomplete"]
916:     if terminal is not None:
917:         status = "incomplete"
918:     elif error_ids:
919:         status = "error"
920:     else:
921:         status = "ok"
922:     return SourceInvocationResult(
923:         invocation_id=invocation.invocation_id,
924:         status=status,
925:         plan=invocation,
926:         bases=tuple(bases),
927:         collected_tiers=tuple(collected),
928:         durable_tiers=tuple(durable),
929:         terminal_tier=terminal_tier,
930:         terminal_plan=terminal_plan,
931:         collected_uncommitted=collected_uncommitted,
932:         collected_unknown=collected_unknown,
933:         error_lifecycle_ids=error_ids,
934:         durable_error_lifecycle_ids=durable_error_ids,
935:         overall_sync_id=invocation.overall_sync_id,
936:         terminal=terminal,
937:     )
938: 
939: 
940: async def execute_source_invocation(
941:     registry: BackendRegistry,
942:     descriptor: StoreDescriptor,
943:     locator: Any,
944:     invocation: SourceInvocationPlan,
945:     *,
946:     credentials: WriteCredentials,
947:     collector_factory: CollectorFactory | None = None,
948:     dispatcher: RunDispatcher | None = None,
949:     clock: Callable[[], float] = time.time,
950:     id_factory: Callable[[], str] = _new_id,
951: ) -> SourceInvocationResult:
952:     """Collect and commit fixed tiers once each; never retry external effects."""
953:     bases: list[ReadBasis] = []
954:     collected_tiers: list[CollectedTier] = []
955:     durable_tiers: list[TierCommitted] = []
956:     tiers: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...] = invocation.tiers or ((),)
957:     current_capture = invocation.initial_capture
958:     frozen_locator = invocation.initial_capture._locator_copy()
959: 
960:     for tier_index, _indices in enumerate(tiers):
961:         if tier_index:
962:             try:
963:                 current_capture = capture_runtime(
964:                     registry,
965:                     descriptor,
966:                     frozen_locator,
967:                     credentials=credentials,
968:                 )
969:             except Exception as exc:
970:                 return _result(
971:                     invocation,
972:                     bases=bases,
973:                     collected=collected_tiers,
974:                     durable=durable_tiers,
975:                     terminal=exc,
976:                 )
977:             if (
978:                 current_capture.declaration_documents
979:                 != invocation.initial_capture.declaration_documents
980:             ):
981:                 changed = DeclarationChangedDuringInvocation(
982:                     invocation.initial_capture, current_capture
983:                 )
984:                 return _result(
985:                     invocation,
986:                     bases=(*bases, current_capture.basis),
987:                     collected=collected_tiers,
988:                     durable=durable_tiers,
989:                     terminal=changed,
990:                 )
991:         bases.append(current_capture.basis)
992: 
993:         if invocation.tiers:
994:             try:
995:                 tier = await collect_source_tier(
996:                     invocation,
997:                     current_capture,
998:                     tier_index,
999:                     collector_factory,
1000:                     clock=clock,
1001:                     id_factory=id_factory,
1002:                 )
1003:             except SourceTierCollectionFailed as exc:
1004:                 return _result(
1005:                     invocation,
1006:                     bases=bases,
1007:                     collected=collected_tiers,
1008:                     durable=durable_tiers,
1009:                     terminal=exc,
1010:                 )
1011:         else:
1012:             tier = CollectedTier(
1013:                 tier_index=0,
1014:                 basis=current_capture.basis,
1015:                 sources=(),
1016:                 include_pending_boundaries=True,
1017:             )
1018:         collected_tiers.append(tier)
1019:         final_tier = tier_index == len(tiers) - 1
1020:         try:
1021:             overall = (
1022:                 _overall_fact(invocation, collected_tiers, now=clock())
1023:                 if final_tier
1024:                 else None
1025:             )
1026:             batch_plan = prepare_collected_tier(
1027:                 current_capture,
1028:                 tier,
1029:                 credentials=credentials,
1030:                 overall_fact=overall,
1031:                 overall_sync_id=invocation.overall_sync_id if final_tier else None,
1032:             )
1033:         except Exception as exc:
1034:             return _result(
1035:                 invocation,
1036:                 bases=bases,
1037:                 collected=collected_tiers,
1038:                 durable=durable_tiers,
1039:                 terminal_tier=tier,
1040:                 collected_uncommitted=tier,
1041:                 terminal=exc,
1042:             )
1043: 
1044:         try:
1045:             intents = _dispatch_intents(current_capture, batch_plan)
1046:         except Exception as exc:
1047:             return _result(
1048:                 invocation,
1049:                 bases=bases,
1050:                 collected=collected_tiers,
1051:                 durable=durable_tiers,
1052:                 terminal_tier=tier,
1053:                 terminal_plan=batch_plan,
1054:                 collected_uncommitted=tier,
1055:                 terminal=exc,
1056:             )
1057: 
1058:         try:
1059:             outcome = execute_batch_write(
1060:                 registry,
1061:                 descriptor,
1062:                 batch_plan,
1063:                 after_commit=lambda head: sync_projection(
1064:                     registry, descriptor, through=head
1065:                 ),
1066:             )
1067:         except NotWitnessed as exc:
1068:             if exc.commit is not None:
1069:                 outcome = CommittedBatchWrite(
1070:                     exc.commit,
1071:                     batch_plan.items,
1072:                     ProjectionOutcome.PENDING,
1073:                     batch_plan.pending_tick_ids,
1074:                     batch_plan.pending_tick_names,
1075:                     batch_plan.pending_tick_runs,
1076:                 )
1077:                 durable_tiers.append(
1078:                     TierCommitted(
1079:                         tier_index,
1080:                         current_capture.basis,
1081:                         tier,
1082:                         batch_plan,
1083:                         outcome,
1084:                         witnessed=False,
1085:                         dispatch_intents=intents,
1086:                     )
1087:                 )
1088:             return _result(
1089:                 invocation,
1090:                 bases=bases,
1091:                 collected=collected_tiers,
1092:                 durable=durable_tiers,
1093:                 terminal_tier=tier,
1094:                 terminal_plan=batch_plan,
1095:                 collected_uncommitted=None if exc.commit is not None else tier,
1096:                 terminal=exc,
1097:             )
1098:         except BatchPostCommitProjectionFailed as exc:
1099:             outcome = CommittedBatchWrite(
1100:                 exc.commit,
1101:                 batch_plan.items,
1102:                 ProjectionOutcome.FAILED,
1103:                 batch_plan.pending_tick_ids,
1104:                 batch_plan.pending_tick_names,
1105:                 batch_plan.pending_tick_runs,
1106:             )
1107:             durable_tiers.append(
1108:                 TierCommitted(
1109:                     tier_index,
1110:                     current_capture.basis,
1111:                     tier,
1112:                     batch_plan,
1113:                     outcome,
1114:                     witnessed=True,
1115:                     dispatch_intents=intents,
1116:                 )
1117:             )
1118:             return _result(
1119:                 invocation,
1120:                 bases=bases,
1121:                 collected=collected_tiers,
1122:                 durable=durable_tiers,
1123:                 terminal_tier=tier,
1124:                 terminal_plan=batch_plan,
1125:                 terminal=exc,
1126:             )
1127:         except BatchWriteCommitUnknown as exc:
1128:             # The append was attempted exactly once, but its durability is unknown.
1129:             # Calling this tier "uncommitted" would invite an unsafe retry.
1130:             return _result(
1131:                 invocation,
1132:                 bases=bases,
1133:                 collected=collected_tiers,
1134:                 durable=durable_tiers,
1135:                 terminal_tier=tier,
1136:                 terminal_plan=batch_plan,
1137:                 collected_unknown=tier,
1138:                 terminal=exc,
1139:             )
1140:         except Exception as exc:
1141:             return _result(
1142:                 invocation,
1143:                 bases=bases,
1144:                 collected=collected_tiers,
1145:                 durable=durable_tiers,
1146:                 terminal_tier=tier,
1147:                 terminal_plan=batch_plan,
1148:                 collected_uncommitted=tier,
1149:                 terminal=exc,
1150:             )
1151: 
1152:         committed = TierCommitted(
1153:             tier_index=tier_index,
1154:             basis=current_capture.basis,
1155:             collected=tier,
1156:             plan=batch_plan,
1157:             outcome=outcome,
1158:             witnessed=True,
1159:             dispatch_intents=intents,
1160:         )
1161:         if dispatcher is not None and intents:
1162:             try:
1163:                 dispatcher(committed.commit, intents)
1164:             except Exception as exc:
1165:                 committed = replace(committed, dispatch_succeeded=False)
1166:                 durable_tiers.append(committed)
1167:                 failed = DispatchFailed(committed.commit, intents, exc)
1168:                 return _result(
1169:                     invocation,
1170:                     bases=bases,
1171:                     collected=collected_tiers,
1172:                     durable=durable_tiers,
1173:                     terminal_tier=tier,
1174:                     terminal_plan=batch_plan,
1175:                     terminal=failed,
1176:                 )
1177:             committed = replace(committed, dispatch_succeeded=True)
1178:         durable_tiers.append(committed)
1179: 
1180:     return _result(
1181:         invocation,
1182:         bases=bases,
1183:         collected=collected_tiers,
1184:         durable=durable_tiers,
1185:     )

=== libs/engine/src/engine/declaration.py ===
1: """Store-backed declaration resolver — the file dissolves to locator + ingress.
2: 
3: SPEC §9.5: a store is the canonical residence of its vertex declaration. The
4: ``.vertex`` file survives as two things and no more — a **locator** (its
5: ``store`` field says where the store lives) and an **ingress form** (the human
6: edit surface, and the pre-genesis fallback). Once a store's lineage is opened
7: (a ``_decl.genesis`` event exists), "a file that does persist is a cache of a
8: fold head, never an authority."
9: 
10: This module is that authority's read half. It reconstructs the same
11: ``VertexFile`` AST the parser returns — so every downstream consumer (compiler,
12: vertex_reader, emit checks, signing) is untouched in type terms — from the
13: store's declaration events instead of from the file text.
14: 
15: The seam is :func:`load_declaration`. The fold is
16: :func:`resolve_declaration_documents`. Both are protocol surface the loops-go
17: conformance oracle mirrors, so the rules here are explicit over clever.
18: 
19: Resolution contract (SPEC §9.2 Lineage, §9.5):
20: 
21: - **Genesis is identity, not fold state.** A store's lineage is opened exactly
22:   once; the genesis event carries the whole initial document set as its
23:   payload. Genesis is NOT resolved by Latest — its documents are the base the
24:   overlay is applied on top of. **Which genesis is self is recorded outside
25:   the fact stream**: the ``store_meta`` table's ``own_lineage`` row, stamped
26:   by ``absorb_genesis`` in the same transaction that mints the genesis. Merge
27:   copies facts, never meta — so foreign genesis rows arrive as inert citizens
28:   and can never hijack identity. Resolution selects the genesis row whose id
29:   equals the marker; a marker whose row is missing is corruption
30:   (:class:`DeclarationResolutionError`). An UNMARKED store holding any genesis
31:   rows refuses (:class:`UnadoptedLineage`) — identity is claimed only by the
32:   explicit adopt ceremony (``loops store adopt``), never inferred from facts.
33: 
34: - **Self-lineage scoping from day one.** Merge already carries arbitrary fact
35:   rows across stores today, so a foreign store's declaration events can be
36:   physically present. Every overlay/tombstone row must carry
37:   ``lineage == <this store's genesis id>`` in its payload to participate; rows
38:   with a foreign or absent lineage are **inert** — read, counted, never folded.
39: 
40: - **Fail closed on protocol.** A genesis whose ``protocol`` exceeds
41:   :data:`~lang.document.DECLARATION_PROTOCOL_VERSION` is refused entirely
42:   (:class:`UnsupportedProtocol`) — never partially interpreted.
43: 
44: - **Overlay is Latest per (kind, subject), replay-ordered.** Non-genesis
45:   ``_decl.*-defined`` rows overlay the genesis document set; the store's replay
46:   order is receipt order, ``ORDER BY rowid`` (see ``SqliteStore.since``), so the
47:   row this store received *later* wins regardless of its ``ts``.
48:   ``_decl.*-retired``/``-removed`` rows are subject tombstones. Unknown
49:   ``_decl.*`` kinds (receipts, future protocol) are skipped safely.
50: 
51: - **Same-``ts`` tie-break: an edit is in force at its own ``ts``, inclusive.**
52:   The ``as_of`` cutoff is ``_ts <= as_of`` (a declaration edit at ``ts == as_of``
53:   participates), matching ``StoreReader.facts_between``'s inclusive upper bound
54:   (``ts <= until_ts``). With the equal-cursors default (``as_of = until_ts``,
55:   SPEC §9.3), the consequence is deterministic and explicit: **when a fact and a
56:   declaration edit share an exact float ``ts``, the fact folds under the NEW
57:   ontology** — the edit wins its own instant, regardless of physical append
58:   order. The tie-break is purely ``ts``-based (not witness/rowid order), so it is
59:   reproducible across runs and across a ``rebuild(dump(S))`` that reassigns
60:   rowids. This governs the ``as_of`` **event-time** axis only.
61: 
62: - **Witness-order selection (``at=``) is implemented (0.8.0).** The finer axis
63:   SPEC §9.4 grounds fact-residence on is now live: pass a
64:   :class:`~engine.witness.WitnessPosition` as ``at=`` (mutually exclusive with
65:   ``as_of``) and the cutoff is the receipt prefix ``arrival_ordinal <= at.ordinal`` rather
66:   than ``ts <= as_of``. Selection and replay now share one axis — the prefix is
67:   chosen by arrival coordinate and replayed by arrival coordinate — so ``at``
68:   no longer has to reconcile two orderings; the ``as_of`` ts tie-break above
69:   governs that selector only. The
70:   position is A10-verified against this store before its ordinal is applied
71:   (:func:`~engine.witness.verify_position_for_store`).
72: 
73: The overlay-row *payload shape* this reader consumes —
74: ``{"lineage": <genesis id>, "subject": <str>, "payload": <document payload>}``
75: for a ``*-defined`` row and ``{"lineage": <genesis id>, "subject": <str>}`` for
76: a tombstone — is the contract the S4 edit ceremony (``SqliteStore.absorb_edit``)
77: emits; the Go conformance oracle mirrors both halves.
78: """
79:

103: @dataclass(frozen=True)
104: class RuntimeEpoch:
105:     """Signed own-genesis choice for runtime replay, separate from custody history."""
106: 
107:     mode: Literal["strict", "fresh"]
108:     start_ordinal: int | None
109: 
110: 
111: def _runtime_epoch_payload(payload: Mapping[str, Any], ordinal: int) -> RuntimeEpoch:
112:     protocol = payload.get("protocol", 1)
113:     if type(protocol) is not int:
114:         raise UnsupportedProtocol("declaration genesis protocol must be an integer")
115:     if protocol not in (1, 2):
116:         raise UnsupportedProtocol(
117:             f"genesis protocol {protocol} is unsupported; "
118:             f"supported protocols are 1 and {DECLARATION_PROTOCOL_VERSION}"
119:         )
120:     if protocol == 2:
121:         if (
122:             set(payload) != {"protocol", "documents", "runtime_epoch"}
123:             or payload.get("runtime_epoch") != "fresh-after-anchor-v1"
124:             or not isinstance(payload.get("documents"), list)
125:         ):
126:             raise UnsupportedProtocol("protocol 2 requires the exact fresh-after-anchor-v1 payload")
127:         return RuntimeEpoch("fresh", ordinal)
128:     if "runtime_epoch" in payload:
129:         raise UnsupportedProtocol("runtime epoch marker requires declaration protocol 2")
130:     return RuntimeEpoch("strict", None)
131: 
132: 
133: def runtime_epoch_from_anchor(
134:     anchor: DeclarationAnchor,
135:     *,
136:     wire_record: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
137: ) -> RuntimeEpoch:
138:     """Interpret only the own genesis; a fresh marker needs its physical row.
139: 
140:     The wire comparison prevents a modified derived index from inventing an
141:     epoch. It does not replace custody's independent head attestation.
142:     """
143:     genesis = anchor.genesis
144:     if (
145:         anchor.own_lineage is None or genesis is None
146:         or genesis.id != anchor.own_lineage or genesis.kind != DECL_GENESIS
147:     ):
148:         raise DeclarationResolutionError("runtime epoch requires an own declaration genesis")
149:     epoch = _runtime_epoch_payload(genesis.payload, genesis.arrival_ordinal)
150:     if wire_record is None:
151:         if epoch.mode == "fresh":
152:             raise DeclarationResolutionError(
153:                 "fresh runtime epoch requires its physical genesis row"
154:             )
155:         return epoch
156:     from .arrival_body import rows_of_body
157: 
158:     kind = wire_record.get("k")
159:     body = wire_record.get("body")
160:     try:
161:         rows = tuple(rows_of_body(kind, body)) if kind in {"fact", "batch"} else ()
162:     except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
163:         raise DeclarationResolutionError("physical declaration genesis row is malformed") from exc
164:     selected = rows[genesis.arrival_seq] if genesis.arrival_seq < len(rows) else None
165:     if (
166:         wire_record.get("lin") != anchor.own_lineage
167:         or wire_record.get("ord") != genesis.arrival_ordinal
168:         or selected != (
169:             "fact", (
170:                 genesis.id, genesis.kind, genesis.ts, genesis.observer,
171:                 genesis.origin, genesis.payload_text, genesis.signature,
172:             ),
173:         )
174:     ):
175:         raise DeclarationResolutionError(
176:             "runtime epoch projection differs from physical declaration genesis"
177:         )
178:     try:
179:         physical_payload = json.loads(genesis.payload_text)
180:     except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
181:         raise DeclarationResolutionError(
182:             "physical declaration genesis payload is malformed"
183:         ) from exc
184:     if physical_payload != genesis.payload:
185:         raise DeclarationResolutionError("runtime epoch projection payload differs from custody")
186:     physical_epoch = _runtime_epoch_payload(physical_payload, genesis.arrival_ordinal)
187:     if physical_epoch != epoch:
188:         raise DeclarationResolutionError("runtime epoch projection disagrees with custody")
189:     if physical_epoch.mode == "fresh" and (
190:         kind != "fact"
191:         or genesis.arrival_seq != 0
192:         or not isinstance(wire_record.get("sig"), str)
193:         or not isinstance(genesis.signature, str)
194:     ):
195:         raise DeclarationResolutionError("fresh runtime epoch genesis is unsigned")
196:     return epoch

198: if TYPE_CHECKING:  # pragma: no cover - typing only
199:     from lang.ast import VertexFile
200: 
201:     from engine.witness import WitnessPosition

203: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
204: # Tombstone vocabulary: which "*-defined" subject a "*-retired/-removed" row
205: # removes. The forward mapping is the frozen vocabulary home in lang.document
206: # (DEFINED_TO_TOMBSTONE); this is its inverse. Lens and the vertex singleton
207: # have no tombstone — a lens is replaced by re-definition, and the
208: # vertex-defined singleton IS the identity.
209: # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
210: 
211: _TOMBSTONE_OF_DEFINED: dict[str, str] = {v: k for k, v in DEFINED_TO_TOMBSTONE.items()}
212: 
213: #: The "*-defined" declaration kinds an overlay row may (re)define — the
214: #: tombstonable subjects plus the two singletons (lens, vertex) that are
215: #: replaced by re-definition and have no tombstone.
216: _DEFINED_KINDS: frozenset[str] = frozenset(_TOMBSTONE_OF_DEFINED.values()) | {
217:     DECL_LENS_DEFINED,
218:     DECL_VERTEX_DEFINED,
219: }
