1041: def hydrate_arrival_candidate(
1042:     snapshot: QuerySnapshot,
1043:     basis: ReadBasis,
1044:     locator: VertexFile,
1045:     *,
1046:     fold_overrides: dict[str, FoldOverride] | None = None,
1047:     wire_genesis_record: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
1048: ) -> Vertex:
1049:     """Build the supported storeless candidate from this bounded snapshot."""
1050:     candidate, _effective = _hydrate_effective_arrival_candidate(
1051:         snapshot,
1052:         basis,
1053:         locator,
1054:         fold_overrides=fold_overrides,
1055:         wire_genesis_record=wire_genesis_record,
1056:     )
1057:     return candidate
1058: 
1059: 
1060: def plan_ordinary_write(
1061:     snapshot: QuerySnapshot,
1062:     basis: ReadBasis,
1063:     vertex: Vertex,
1064:     fact: Fact,
1065:     *,
1066:     grant: Grant | None,
1067:     credentials: WriteCredentials,
1068:     custodian: str,
1069:     fact_id: str | None = None,
1070:     admit_undeclared: bool = False,
1071:     _mutate_candidate: bool = False,
1072:     _signing_context: CapturedSigningContext | None = None,
1073:     _credential_session: CredentialResolutionSession | None = None,
1074: ) -> OrdinaryWritePlan:
1075:     """Internal, caller-responsible planner for one local fact and tick.
1076: 
1077:     ``vertex`` must be a detached reconstruction of this exact snapshot.
1078:     Supported consumers use :func:`prepare_ordinary_write`, which creates it
1079:     through :func:`hydrate_arrival_candidate`; this lower-level seam exists
1080:     for focused engine composition and must not be offered as a coherent
1081:     writer from a stale caller-owned vertex.
1082:     """
1083:     _ensure_current_basis(snapshot, basis)
1084:     if getattr(vertex, "_store", None) is not None:
1085:         raise RuntimeWriteRefused("ordinary planning requires a detached vertex")
1086:     if getattr(vertex, "_has_children", False):
1087:         raise RuntimeWriteRefused("multi-store child execution is not in stage 3A")
1088:     from .declaration import validate_arrival_runtime_identity
1089: 
1090:     validate_arrival_runtime_identity(
1091:         vertex.name,
1092:         vertex.kinds,
1093:         refusal=RuntimeWriteRefused,
1094:     )
1095:     anchor = snapshot.declaration_anchor
1096:     if anchor.own_lineage is None or anchor.genesis is None:
1097:         raise RuntimeWriteRefused("ordinary emission requires a declaration anchor")
1098:     from .declaration import validate_arrival_declaration_anchor
1099: 
1100:     validate_arrival_declaration_anchor(anchor, basis.captured_head)
1101: 
1102:     credential_session = _credential_session or CredentialResolutionSession()
1103:     existing_plan = _existing_fact_plan(
1104:         snapshot,
1105:         basis,
1106:         fact,
1107:         credentials,
1108:         fact_id,
1109:         signing_context=_signing_context,
1110:         credential_session=credential_session,
1111:     )
1112:     if existing_plan is not None:
1113:         return existing_plan
1114:     facts = snapshot.facts(FactRequest(limit=None, include_internal=True, order="oldest")).items
1115:     # The neutral request is receipt-ordered, but keep this safety boundary at
1116:     # the chain calculation: window membership is coordinates, never a
1117:     # backend's event-time or identifier presentation order.
1118:     facts = tuple(sorted(facts, key=lambda row: (row.arrival_ordinal, row.arrival_seq)))
1119:     ticks = snapshot.ticks(TickRequest(since=float("-inf")))
1120:     chosen_id = fact_id if fact_id is not None else str(ULID())
1121:     payload_text = _payload_text(fact.payload)
1122:     inner_signature = _author_signature(
1123:         credentials,
1124:         credential_session,
1125:         _signing_context,
1126:         captured_head=basis.captured_head,
1127:         observer=fact.observer,
1128:         domain=SigningDomain.FACT,
1129:         purpose=CredentialPurpose.AUTHORSHIP,
1130:         digest=fact_commitment_hash(
1131:             fact.kind, fact.ts, fact.observer, fact.origin, payload_text
1132:         ),
1133:         legacy_signer=credentials.fact_signer,
1134:     )
1135:     fact_row = (
1136:         chosen_id,
1137:         fact.kind,
1138:         fact.ts,
1139:         fact.observer,
1140:         fact.origin,
1141:         payload_text,
1142:         inner_signature,
1143:     )
1144:     candidate = vertex if _mutate_candidate else vertex.detached_copy()
1145:     receipt = candidate.plan_receive_receipt(
1146:         fact,
1147:         grant,
1148:         id_override=chosen_id,
1149:         admit_undeclared=admit_undeclared,
1150:     )
1151:     if not receipt.stored:
1152:         raise _AdmissionPlanRefused("admission rejected the fact before append")
1153:     fact_body = body_of_fact_row(fact_row)
1154:     outer_signature = _author_signature(
1155:         credentials,
1156:         credential_session,
1157:         _signing_context,
1158:         captured_head=basis.captured_head,
1159:         observer=fact.observer,
1160:         domain=SigningDomain.ARRIVAL,
1161:         purpose=CredentialPurpose.AUTHORSHIP,
1162:         digest=content_commitment(
1163:             "fact", fact.ts, fact.observer, fact.origin, fact_body
1164:         ),
1165:         legacy_signer=credentials.arrival_signer,
1166:     )
1167:     drafts = [
1168:         RecordDraft(
1169:             kind="fact",
1170:             authored_at=fact.ts,
1171:             observer=fact.observer,
1172:             origin=fact.origin,
1173:             body=fact_body,
1174:             signature=outer_signature,
1175:         )
1176:     ]
1177:     tick_id: str | None = None
1178:     if receipt.tick is not None:
1179:         previous_hash, window_start = _current_tick_context(ticks, current_fact_id=chosen_id)
1180:         tick = receipt.tick
1181:         tick_id = str(ULID())
1182:         if any(existing.id == tick_id for existing in ticks):
1183:             raise RuntimeWriteRefused(f"generated tick id {tick_id!r} already exists")
1184:         tick_payload_text = _payload_text(tick.payload)
1185:         tick_row = (
1186:             tick_id,
1187:             tick.name,
1188:             tick.ts.timestamp(),
1189:             None if tick.since is None else tick.since.timestamp(),
1190:             tick.origin,
1191:             tick_payload_text,
1192:             previous_hash,
1193:             window_start,
1194:             chosen_id,
1195:             _window_hash(facts, start=window_start, appended=fact_row),
1196:         )
1197:         signed_era = any(
1198:             existing.signature is not None and existing.window_hash is not None
1199:             for existing in ticks
1200:         )
1201:         tick_signature = _tick_signature(
1202:             credentials,
1203:             credential_session,
1204:             _signing_context,
1205:             captured_head=basis.captured_head,
1206:             digest=tick_commitment_hash(tick_row),
1207:             signed_era=signed_era,
1208:         )
1209:         tick_body = body_of_tick_row((*tick_row, tick_signature))
1210:         drafts.append(
1211:             RecordDraft(
1212:                 kind="tick",
1213:                 authored_at=tick.ts.timestamp(),
1214:                 observer=custodian,
1215:                 origin=tick.origin,
1216:                 body=tick_body,
1217:                 signature=None,
1218:             )
1219:         )
1220:     return OrdinaryWritePlan(
1221:         captured_head=basis.captured_head,
1222:         fact_id=chosen_id,
1223:         tick_id=tick_id,
1224:         drafts=tuple(drafts),
1225:         tick_run=None if receipt.tick is None else receipt.tick.run,
1226:         credential_bindings=credential_session.evidence,
1227:     )
1228: 
1229: 
1230: def _custodian_from_verified_genesis(ledger: AttestedLedger) -> str:
1231:     """Return the physical lineage's tick custodian from its verified record 0."""
1232:     genesis = ledger.read(0)
1233:     if genesis.get("k") != "genesis":
1234:         raise RuntimeWriteRefused("ledger record 0 is not a physical genesis")
1235:     observer = genesis.get("observer")
1236:     if not isinstance(observer, str) or not observer:
1237:         raise RuntimeWriteRefused("physical genesis has no custodian observer")
1238:     return observer
1239: 
1240: 
1241: def capture_runtime(
1242:     registry: BackendRegistry,
1243:     descriptor: StoreDescriptor,
1244:     locator: VertexFile,
1245:     *,
1246:     fold_overrides: dict[str, FoldOverride] | None = None,
1247:     source_mode: bool = False,
1248:     evaluated_at: float | None = None,
1249:     credentials: WriteCredentials | None = None,
1250: ) -> RuntimeCapture:
1251:     """Capture one immutable, closed-handle Authority/CURRENT runtime view."""
1252:     from .arrival_contract import Profile, ProjectionRequirement
1253: 
1254:     if descriptor.role is not Profile.AUTHORITY:
1255:         raise NotAuthority("runtime capture requires an Authority descriptor role")
1256:     ledger, query = registry.open(descriptor)
1257:     snapshot = None
1258:     try:
1259:         if not isinstance(ledger, AttestedLedger):
1260:             raise TypeError("BackendRegistry.open must return an AttestedLedger")
1261:         comparison = ledger.opened.comparison
1262:         if not isinstance(comparison, Compared):
1263:             if isinstance(comparison, PreGenesis) and comparison.ledger_refusal is not None:
1264:                 raise comparison.ledger_refusal
1265:             if isinstance(comparison, Indeterminate):
1266:                 raise comparison.refusal
1267:             raise RuntimeWriteRefused("runtime capture requires a minted compared ledger")
1268:         captured = comparison.presented
1269:         snapshot = query.open_snapshot(
1270:             captured_head=captured, requirement=ProjectionRequirement.CURRENT
1271:         )
1272:         basis = _current_write_basis(ledger, snapshot, captured)
1273:         candidate, effective, documents, sources, facts, ticks, runtime_facts, runtime_ticks = (
1274:             _build_effective_arrival_candidate(
1275:                 snapshot, basis, locator, fold_overrides=fold_overrides,
1276:                 wire_genesis_record=(
1277:                     None if snapshot.declaration_anchor.genesis is None
1278:                     else ledger.read(snapshot.declaration_anchor.genesis.arrival_ordinal)
1279:                 ),
1280:             )
1281:         )
1282:         at = time.time() if evaluated_at is None else evaluated_at
1283:         post_boundary_candidate = candidate.detached_copy() if source_mode else None
1284:         pending = (
1285:             post_boundary_candidate.plan_pending_boundaries(
1286:                 runtime_facts, runtime_ticks, evaluated_at=at
1287:             )
1288:             if post_boundary_candidate is not None
1289:             else ()
1290:         )
1291:         captured_locator = _capture_locator_ingress(locator)
1292:         signing_context = None
1293:         if credentials is not None and credentials.mapped:
1294:             from .arrival import key_registry_from_records
1295: 
1296:             verifier = credentials.signature_verifier
1297:             if verifier is None:  # guarded by WriteCredentials construction
1298:                 raise CredentialBindingRefused(
1299:                     "mapped signing requires a signature verifier",
1300:                     captured_head=captured,
1301:                     use_position=captured.ordinal + 1,
1302:                 )
1303:             try:
1304:                 key_registry, _key_rows = key_registry_from_records(
1305:                     ledger.scan(through=captured),
1306:                     lambda key, signature, digest: verifier(
1307:                         SigningDomain.ARRIVAL, key, signature, digest
1308:                     ),
1309:                 )
1310:             except CredentialBindingRefused as exc:
1311:                 raise CredentialBindingRefused(
1312:                     exc.reason,
1313:                     request=exc.request,
1314:                     captured_head=captured,
1315:                     use_position=captured.ordinal + 1,
1316:                     evidence=exc.evidence,
1317:                 ) from exc
1318:             except Exception as exc:
1319:                 raise CredentialBindingRefused(
1320:                     "key-history-unverified",
1321:                     captured_head=captured,
1322:                     use_position=captured.ordinal + 1,
1323:                 ) from exc
1324:             author_keys = tuple(
1325:                 (
1326:                     observer,
1327:                     tuple(
1328:                         key
1329:                         for key, _introduced in key_registry.keys_valid_at(
1330:                             observer, captured.ordinal + 1
1331:                         )
1332:                     ),
1333:                 )
1334:                 for observer in sorted(key_registry.introductions)
1335:             )
1336:             receipt_keys = tuple(
1337:                 observer.key
1338:                 for observer in (effective.observers or ())
1339:                 if isinstance(observer.key, str) and observer.key
1340:             )
1341:             signing_context = CapturedSigningContext(
1342:                 captured_head=captured,
1343:                 author_keys=author_keys,
1344:                 receipt_keys=receipt_keys,
1345:             )
1346:         return RuntimeCapture(
1347:             basis=basis,
1348:             custodian=_custodian_from_verified_genesis(ledger),
1349:             max_atomic_records=ledger.capabilities().max_atomic_records,
1350:             evaluated_at=at,
1351:             _effective_declaration=effective,
1352:             _locator=captured_locator,
1353:             _declaration_anchor=copy.deepcopy(snapshot.declaration_anchor),
1354:             _declaration_documents=copy.deepcopy(documents),
1355:             _facts=copy.deepcopy(facts),
1356:             _ticks=copy.deepcopy(ticks),
1357:             _runtime_facts=copy.deepcopy(runtime_facts),
1358:             _runtime_ticks=copy.deepcopy(runtime_ticks),
1359:             _candidate_template=candidate.detached_copy(),
1360:             _post_boundary_candidate_template=(
1361:                 None
1362:                 if post_boundary_candidate is None
1363:                 else post_boundary_candidate.detached_copy()
1364:             ),
1365:             _sources=copy.deepcopy(sources),
1366:             _pending_boundaries=copy.deepcopy(tuple(pending)),
1367:             _signing_context=signing_context,
1368:         )
1369:     finally:
1370:         if snapshot is not None:
1371:             _close_quietly(snapshot)
1372:         _close_quietly(query)
1373:         _close_quietly(ledger)
1374: 
1375: 
1376: def prepare_ordinary_write(
1377:     registry: BackendRegistry,
1378:     descriptor: StoreDescriptor,
1379:     locator: VertexFile,
1380:     fact: Fact,
1381:     *,
1382:     credentials: WriteCredentials,
1383:     fact_id: str | None = None,
1384:     fold_overrides: dict[str, FoldOverride] | None = None,
1385:     admit_undeclared: bool = False,
1386: ) -> OrdinaryWritePlan:
1387:     """Capture a CURRENT basis and prepare one retryable ordinary write.
1388: 
1389:     The writer opens its own registry handles because a read consumer never
1390:     receives append capability.  It closes those handles before returning the
1391:     detached plan; execution later compares the same complete head under the
1392:     ledger fence and refuses any intervening append.
1393:     """
1394:     capture = capture_runtime(
1395:         registry,
1396:         descriptor,
1397:         locator,
1398:         fold_overrides=fold_overrides,
1399:         credentials=credentials,
1400:     )
1401:     basis = capture.basis
1402:     effective = capture.effective_declaration
1403:     candidate = capture._candidate_copy()
1404:     snapshot = _BatchSnapshot(capture, capture._facts, capture._ticks)
1405:     credential_session = CredentialResolutionSession()
1406:     duplicate = _existing_fact_plan(
1407:         snapshot,
1408:         basis,
1409:         fact,
1410:         credentials,
1411:         fact_id,
1412:         signing_context=capture._signing_context,
1413:         credential_session=credential_session,
1414:     )
1415:     if duplicate is not None:
1416:         return replace(
1417:             duplicate,
1418:             effective_declaration=effective,
1419:             custodian=capture.custodian,
1420:             admit_undeclared=admit_undeclared,
1421:         )
1422:     grant = None
1423:     try:
1424:         from .admission import AdmissionError, grant_for_observer
1425: 
1426:         grant = grant_for_observer(effective, fact.observer)
1427:         plan = plan_ordinary_write(
1428:             snapshot,
1429:             basis,
1430:             candidate,
1431:             fact,
1432:             grant=grant,
1433:             credentials=credentials,
1434:             custodian=capture.custodian,
1435:             fact_id=fact_id,
1436:             admit_undeclared=admit_undeclared,
1437:             _signing_context=capture._signing_context,
1438:             _credential_session=credential_session,
1439:         )
1440:     except (AdmissionError, _AdmissionPlanRefused) as exc:
1441:         raise OrdinaryWritePreparationRefused(
1442:             effective_declaration=effective,
1443:             admission_grant=grant,
1444:             custodian=capture.custodian,
1445:             basis=basis,
1446:             fact=fact,
1447:             cause=exc,
1448:         ) from exc
1449:     return replace(
1450:         plan,
1451:         effective_declaration=effective,
1452:         admission_grant=grant,
1453:         custodian=capture.custodian,
1454:         admit_undeclared=admit_undeclared,
1455:     )
1456: 
1457: 
1458: def execute_ordinary_write(
1459:     registry: BackendRegistry,
1460:     descriptor: StoreDescriptor,
1461:     plan: OrdinaryWritePlan,
1462:     *,
1463:     after_commit: Callable[[Head], object] | None = None,
1464: ) -> CommittedWrite:
1465:     """Append a previously prepared plan once against its exact full head.
1466: 
1467:     Projection publication is deliberately not attempted in 3A.  A successful
1468:     result says only that custody committed; maintenance is an explicit later
1469:     operation.  ``after_commit`` is the optional injected maintenance seam:
1470:     it receives the durable ``Commit.after`` and cannot change the append
1471:     outcome.  ``NotWitnessed`` already carries the durable commit and is
1472:     intentionally propagated rather than relabeled as a refusal.
1473:     """
1474:     from .arrival_contract import Profile
1475: 
1476:     if descriptor.role is not Profile.AUTHORITY:
1477:         raise NotAuthority("ordinary writes require an Authority descriptor role")
1478:     ledger, query = registry.open(descriptor)
1479:     try:
1480:         if not isinstance(ledger, AttestedLedger):
1481:             raise TypeError("BackendRegistry.open must return an AttestedLedger")
1482:         comparison = ledger.opened.comparison
1483:         if isinstance(comparison, PreGenesis):
1484:             if comparison.ledger_refusal is not None:
1485:                 raise comparison.ledger_refusal
1486:             raise RuntimeWriteRefused("ordinary emission requires a minted ledger")
1487:         if isinstance(comparison, Indeterminate):
1488:             raise comparison.refusal
1489:         if not isinstance(comparison, Compared):
1490:             raise TypeError(f"unsupported head comparison {comparison!r}")
1491:         if plan.already_present:
1492:             return CommittedWrite(
1493:                 commit=None,
1494:                 fact_id=plan.fact_id,
1495:                 tick_id=None,
1496:                 projection=ProjectionOutcome.NOT_REQUESTED,
1497:             )
1498:         if comparison.presented != plan.captured_head:
1499:             raise RuntimeWriteRefused("captured head changed before append")
1500:         try:
1501:             commit = ledger.append(plan.captured_head, plan.drafts)
1502:         except NotWitnessed:
1503:             raise
1504:         except ContractRefusal:
1505:             raise
1506:         except Exception as exc:
1507:             raise WriteCommitUnknown(plan, exc) from exc
1508:         if after_commit is not None:
1509:             try:
1510:                 after_commit(commit.after)
1511:             except Exception as exc:
1512:                 raise PostCommitProjectionFailed(commit, plan, exc) from exc
1513:             projection = ProjectionOutcome.SYNCED
1514:         else:
1515:             projection = ProjectionOutcome.NOT_REQUESTED
1516:         return CommittedWrite(
1517:             commit=commit,
1518:             fact_id=plan.fact_id,
1519:             tick_id=plan.tick_id,
1520:             projection=projection,
1521:         )
1522:     finally:
1523:         _close_quietly(query)
1524:         _close_quietly(ledger)
1525: 
1526: 
1527: def _pack_batch_drafts(
1528:     drafts: Sequence[RecordDraft],
1529:     credentials: WriteCredentials,
1530:     *,
1531:     captured_head: Head | None = None,
1532:     signing_context: CapturedSigningContext | None = None,
1533:     credential_session: CredentialResolutionSession | None = None,
1534: ) -> tuple[RecordDraft, ...]:
1535:     """Turn adjacent ordinary fact drafts into wire-valid same-author batches."""
1536:     packed: list[RecordDraft] = []
1537:     held: list[RecordDraft] = []
1538:     session = credential_session or CredentialResolutionSession()
1539: 
1540:     def flush() -> None:
1541:         if not held:
1542:             return
1543:         if len(held) == 1:
1544:             packed.append(held[0])
1545:         else:
1546:             first = held[0]
1547:             rows = [
1548:                 (
1549:                     row.body["id"],
1550:                     row.body["kind"],
1551:                     row.body["ts"],
1552:                     row.body["observer"],
1553:                     row.body["origin"],
1554:                     row.body["payload"],
1555:                     row.body.get("signature"),
1556:                 )
1557:                 for row in held
1558:             ]
1559:             body = body_of_batch(rows)
1560:             digest = content_commitment(
1561:                 "batch", first.authored_at, first.observer, first.origin, body
1562:             )
1563:             if credentials.mapped:
1564:                 if captured_head is None:
1565:                     raise CredentialBindingRefused(
1566:                         "mapped batch signing requires a captured head"
1567:                     )
1568:                 signature = _author_signature(
1569:                     credentials,
1570:                     session,
1571:                     signing_context,
1572:                     captured_head=captured_head,
1573:                     observer=first.observer,
1574:                     domain=SigningDomain.ARRIVAL,
1575:                     purpose=CredentialPurpose.AUTHORSHIP,
1576:                     digest=digest,
1577:                     legacy_signer=None,
1578:                 )
1579:             else:
1580:                 signature = (
1581:                     credentials.arrival_signer(first.observer, digest)
1582:                     if credentials.arrival_signer is not None
1583:                     else None
1584:                 )
1585:             packed.append(
1586:                 RecordDraft(
1587:                     kind="batch",
1588:                     authored_at=first.authored_at,
1589:                     observer=first.observer,
1590:                     origin=first.origin,
1591:                     body=body,
1592:                     signature=signature,
1593:                 )
1594:             )
1595:         held.clear()
1596: 
1597:     for draft in drafts:
1598:         if draft.kind == "fact" and (not held or held[0].observer == draft.observer):
1599:             held.append(draft)
1600:             continue
1601:         flush()
1602:         if draft.kind == "fact":
1603:             held.append(draft)
1604:         else:
1605:             packed.append(draft)
1606:     flush()
1607:     return tuple(packed)
1608: 
1609: 
1610: def _pending_tick_draft(
1611:     tick: Any,
1612:     facts: tuple[SnapshotFact, ...],
1613:     ticks: tuple[SnapshotTick, ...],
1614:     *,
1615:     credentials: WriteCredentials,
1616:     custodian: str,
1617:     captured_head: Head,
1618:     signing_context: CapturedSigningContext | None,
1619:     credential_session: CredentialResolutionSession,
1620: ) -> RecordDraft:
1621:     """Encode one captured pending boundary without re-evaluating it."""
1622:     if not facts:
1623:         raise RuntimeWriteRefused("a pending boundary requires captured fact evidence")
1624:     current_fact = max(facts, key=lambda row: (row.arrival_ordinal, row.arrival_seq))
1625:     previous_hash, window_start = _current_tick_context(ticks, current_fact_id=current_fact.id)
1626:     tick_id = str(ULID())
1627:     payload_text = _payload_text(tick.payload)
1628:     row = (
1629:         tick_id,
1630:         tick.name,
1631:         tick.ts.timestamp(),
1632:         None if tick.since is None else tick.since.timestamp(),
1633:         tick.origin,
1634:         payload_text,
1635:         previous_hash,
1636:         window_start,
1637:         current_fact.id,
1638:         _window_hash(facts, start=window_start),
1639:     )
1640:     signed_era = any(
1641:         existing.signature is not None and existing.window_hash is not None for existing in ticks
1642:     )
1643:     signature = _tick_signature(
1644:         credentials,
1645:         credential_session,
1646:         signing_context,
1647:         captured_head=captured_head,
1648:         digest=tick_commitment_hash(row),
1649:         signed_era=signed_era,
1650:     )
1651:     return RecordDraft(
1652:         kind="tick",
1653:         authored_at=tick.ts.timestamp(),
1654:         observer=custodian,
1655:         origin=tick.origin,
1656:         body=body_of_tick_row((*row, signature)),
1657:         signature=None,
1658:     )
1659: 
1660: 
1661: def plan_batch_from_capture(
1662:     capture: RuntimeCapture,
1663:     items: Sequence[BatchFactInput],
1664:     *,
1665:     credentials: WriteCredentials,
1666:     include_pending_boundaries: bool = False,
1667: ) -> BatchWritePlan:
1668:     """Plan one batch from frozen evidence without reopening the registry."""
1669:     from .admission import AdmissionError, grant_for_observer
1670: 
1671:     pending = capture._pending_boundaries if include_pending_boundaries else ()
1672:     if not items and not pending:
1673:         raise RuntimeWriteRefused("batch requires at least one fact or pending boundary")
1674:     basis = capture.basis
1675:     effective = capture._effective_declaration
1676:     candidate = capture._candidate_copy(after_pending_boundaries=include_pending_boundaries)
1677:     from .declaration import validate_arrival_runtime_identity
1678: 
1679:     validate_arrival_runtime_identity(
1680:         candidate.name,
1681:         candidate.kinds,
1682:         refusal=RuntimeWriteRefused,
1683:     )
1684:     facts = copy.deepcopy(capture._facts)
1685:     ticks = copy.deepcopy(capture._ticks)
1686:     logical: list[RecordDraft] = []
1687:     pending_ids: list[str] = []
1688:     pending_names: list[str] = []
1689:     pending_runs: list[str | None] = []
1690:     credential_session = CredentialResolutionSession()
1691:     for sequence, tick in enumerate(copy.deepcopy(pending)):
1692:         draft = _pending_tick_draft(
1693:             tick,
1694:             facts,
1695:             ticks,
1696:             credentials=credentials,
1697:             custodian=capture.custodian,
1698:             captured_head=basis.captured_head,
1699:             signing_context=capture._signing_context,
1700:             credential_session=credential_session,
1701:         )
1702:         logical.append(draft)
1703:         pending_ids.append(str(draft.body["id"]))
1704:         pending_names.append(str(draft.body["name"]))
1705:         pending_runs.append(tick.run)
1706:         ticks = (
1707:             *ticks,
1708:             _tick_from_draft(draft, basis.captured_head.ordinal + 1, sequence),
1709:         )
1710: 
1711:     results: list[BatchItemResult] = []
1712:     for index, item in enumerate(items):
1713:         synthetic = _BatchSnapshot(capture, facts, ticks)
1714:         try:
1715:             plan = _existing_fact_plan(
1716:                 synthetic,
1717:                 basis,
1718:                 item.fact,
1719:                 credentials,
1720:                 item.fact_id,
1721:                 signing_context=capture._signing_context,
1722:                 credential_session=credential_session,
1723:             )
1724:             if plan is None:
1725:                 grant = grant_for_observer(effective, item.fact.observer)
1726:                 plan = plan_ordinary_write(
1727:                     synthetic,
1728:                     basis,
1729:                     candidate,
1730:                     item.fact,
1731:                     grant=grant,
1732:                     credentials=credentials,
1733:                     custodian=capture.custodian,
1734:                     fact_id=item.fact_id,
1735:                     admit_undeclared=item.admit_undeclared,
1736:                     _mutate_candidate=True,
1737:                     _signing_context=capture._signing_context,
1738:                     _credential_session=credential_session,
1739:                 )
1740:         except (AdmissionError, _AdmissionPlanRefused) as exc:
1741:             raise BatchWritePreparationRefused(
1742:                 input_index=index,
1743:                 item=item,
1744:                 effective_declaration=capture.effective_declaration,
1745:                 custodian=capture.custodian,
1746:                 basis=basis,
1747:                 cause=exc,
1748:                 admission_refused=True,
1749:             ) from exc
1750:         except CredentialBindingRefused as exc:
1751:             raise BatchWritePreparationRefused(
1752:                 input_index=index,
1753:                 item=item,
1754:                 effective_declaration=capture.effective_declaration,
1755:                 custodian=capture.custodian,
1756:                 basis=basis,
1757:                 cause=exc,
1758:                 admission_refused=False,
1759:             ) from exc
1760:         except RuntimeWriteRefused as exc:
1761:             raise BatchWritePreparationRefused(
1762:                 input_index=index,
1763:                 item=item,
1764:                 effective_declaration=capture.effective_declaration,
1765:                 custodian=capture.custodian,
1766:                 basis=basis,
1767:                 cause=exc,
1768:                 admission_refused=False,
1769:             ) from exc
1770:         tick_draft = next((draft for draft in plan.drafts if draft.kind == "tick"), None)
1771:         results.append(
1772:             BatchItemResult(
1773:                 fact_id=plan.fact_id,
1774:                 tick_id=plan.tick_id,
1775:                 tick_name=None if tick_draft is None else tick_draft.body["name"],
1776:                 already_present=plan.already_present,
1777:                 tick_run=plan.tick_run,
1778:             )
1779:         )
1780:         if plan.already_present:
1781:             continue
1782:         ordinal = basis.captured_head.ordinal + 1 + len(logical)
1783:         for sequence, draft in enumerate(plan.drafts):
1784:             if draft.kind == "fact":
1785:                 facts = (*facts, _fact_from_draft(draft, ordinal, sequence))
1786:             elif draft.kind == "tick":
1787:                 ticks = (*ticks, _tick_from_draft(draft, ordinal, sequence))
1788:         logical.extend(plan.drafts)
1789: 
1790:     packed = _pack_batch_drafts(
1791:         logical,
1792:         credentials,
1793:         captured_head=basis.captured_head,
1794:         signing_context=capture._signing_context,
1795:         credential_session=credential_session,
1796:     )
1797:     if capture.max_atomic_records is not None and len(packed) > capture.max_atomic_records:
1798:         raise AtomicLimitExceeded(
1799:             f"{len(packed)} packed records exceeds this backend's configured "
1800:             f"atomic limit of {capture.max_atomic_records}; the batch was refused before append"
1801:         )
1802:     return BatchWritePlan(
1803:         captured_head=basis.captured_head,
1804:         items=tuple(results),
1805:         drafts=packed,
1806:         effective_declaration=capture.effective_declaration,
1807:         custodian=capture.custodian,
1808:         pending_tick_ids=tuple(pending_ids),
1809:         pending_tick_names=tuple(pending_names),
1810:         pending_tick_runs=tuple(pending_runs),
1811:         credential_bindings=credential_session.evidence,
1812:     )
1813: 
1814: 
1815: def prepare_batch_write(
1816:     registry: BackendRegistry,
1817:     descriptor: StoreDescriptor,
1818:     locator: VertexFile,
1819:     items: Sequence[BatchFactInput],
1820:     *,
1821:     credentials: WriteCredentials,
1822:     fold_overrides: dict[str, FoldOverride] | None = None,
1823: ) -> BatchWritePlan:
1824:     """Capture once, then prepare every item against that exact evidence."""
1825:     if not items:
1826:         raise RuntimeWriteRefused("batch requires at least one fact")
1827:     capture = capture_runtime(
1828:         registry,
1829:         descriptor,
1830:         locator,
1831:         fold_overrides=fold_overrides,
1832:         credentials=credentials,
1833:     )
1834:     return plan_batch_from_capture(capture, items, credentials=credentials)
1835: 
1836: 
1837: def execute_batch_write(
1838:     registry: BackendRegistry,
1839:     descriptor: StoreDescriptor,
1840:     plan: BatchWritePlan,
1841:     *,
1842:     after_commit: Callable[[Head], object] | None = None,
1843: ) -> CommittedBatchWrite:
1844:     """Append a prepared batch exactly once; no item is retried separately."""
1845:     from .arrival_contract import Profile
1846: 
1847:     if descriptor.role is not Profile.AUTHORITY:
1848:         raise NotAuthority("batch writes require an Authority descriptor role")
1849:     if not plan.drafts:
1850:         return CommittedBatchWrite(
1851:             None,
1852:             plan.items,
1853:             ProjectionOutcome.NOT_REQUESTED,
1854:             plan.pending_tick_ids,
1855:             plan.pending_tick_names,
1856:             plan.pending_tick_runs,
1857:         )
1858:     ledger, query = registry.open(descriptor)
1859:     try:
1860:         if not isinstance(ledger, AttestedLedger):
1861:             raise TypeError("BackendRegistry.open must return an AttestedLedger")
1862:         comparison = ledger.opened.comparison
1863:         if isinstance(comparison, PreGenesis):
1864:             if comparison.ledger_refusal is not None:
1865:                 raise comparison.ledger_refusal
1866:             raise RuntimeWriteRefused("batch emission requires a minted ledger")
1867:         if isinstance(comparison, Indeterminate):
1868:             raise comparison.refusal
1869:         if not isinstance(comparison, Compared):
1870:             raise TypeError(f"unsupported head comparison {comparison!r}")
1871:         if comparison.presented != plan.captured_head:
1872:             raise RuntimeWriteRefused("captured head changed before batch append")
1873:         try:
1874:             commit = ledger.append(plan.captured_head, plan.drafts)
1875:         except NotWitnessed:
1876:             raise
1877:         except ContractRefusal:
1878:             raise
1879:         except Exception as exc:
1880:             raise BatchWriteCommitUnknown(plan, exc) from exc
1881:         if after_commit is not None:
1882:             try:
1883:                 after_commit(commit.after)
1884:             except Exception as exc:
1885:                 raise BatchPostCommitProjectionFailed(commit, plan, exc) from exc
1886:         projection = ProjectionOutcome.SYNCED if after_commit else ProjectionOutcome.NOT_REQUESTED
1887:         return CommittedBatchWrite(
1888:             commit,
1889:             plan.items,
1890:             projection,
1891:             plan.pending_tick_ids,
1892:             plan.pending_tick_names,
1893:             plan.pending_tick_runs,
1894:         )
1895:     finally:
1896:         _close_quietly(query)
1897:         _close_quietly(ledger)

=== libs/engine/src/engine/sqlite_store.py ===
1: """SqliteStore — SQLite-backed append-only event store.
2: 
3: Implements the Store protocol with durable persistence. Facts are stored
4: with kind, ts, observer as real columns (SQL-queryable) and payload as
5: JSON text (queryable via json_extract()).
6: 
7: Uses WAL mode for concurrent reads during folds. IDs are ULIDs generated
8: Python-side via python-ulid (26-char Crockford base32, time-sortable to the
9: millisecond — but NOT within-ms monotonic; see ``gen_id``). Ms-granular
10: time-sortability is load-bearing for cross-store fact interleaving (ORDER BY
11: id ≈ chronological) and for merge dedup on slice→merge round-trips via INSERT
12: OR IGNORE on the id PK. Receipt order is always (arrival_ordinal, arrival_seq), never
13: id order.
14: 
15: History: 2026-03-15 to 2026-05-16 a perf-driven change swapped to
16: uuid.uuid4() to avoid loading the sqlite-ulid C extension per connection
17: (~0.5ms dlopen). That swap dropped the time-sortable property without
18: naming the substrate contract. Restored 2026-05-16 via pure-Python
19: python-ulid (no dlopen, ~2.3μs/id, negligible at this scale). See
20: project decision architecture/id-primitive-python-ulid.
21: """
22: 
23: from __future__ import annotations
24: 
25: import hashlib
26: import json
27: 
28: import sqlite3
29: 
30: # The fact-domain content commitment and its canonical encoding moved to
31: # `admission` in slice 2: the inner signature travels through re-custody, so
32: # it belongs beside the policy that checks it rather than in the module that
33: # becomes a projection engine. Imported back under both historical names —
34: # the mint paths below still call the private one, and it dies with them in
35: # slice 5. Module-level is safe in this direction only: `admission` reaches
36: # back for `FACT_COLUMN_INDEX` inside a function, never at import.
37: from .admission import _canonical_bytes
38: from .admission import fact_commitment_hash as _fact_commitment_hash
39: from .admission import fact_commitment_hash as fact_commitment_hash  # re-export

53: class CommittedRowMissing(RuntimeError):
54:     """The row just INSERTed is absent at pre-commit read-back.
55: 
56:     Something inside the same transaction (an AFTER INSERT trigger, a
57:     schema-level rewrite) deleted the row between the staged INSERT and the
58:     read-back. The write rolls back and raises — a store that eats rows
59:     must never hand out a stored=True receipt (SOL-R4-02). On a
60:     JSONL-canonical store the refusal fires before any log byte.
61:     """

64: def gen_id() -> str:
65:     """Generate a unique ID for store records.
66: 
67:     Uses python-ulid: 26-char Crockford base32 ULID. Guaranteed:
68: 
69:     - **Unique** — 48-bit millisecond timestamp + 80 bits of randomness.
70:     - **Time-sortable to the millisecond** — lexicographic order matches
71:       generation time across *different* milliseconds (the timestamp prefix
72:       dominates). Load-bearing for cross-store interleaving (``ORDER BY id`` ≈
73:       chronological at ms granularity) and merge dedup on the id PK.
74: 
75:     NOT guaranteed: **within-millisecond ordering**. python-ulid draws a fresh
76:     random 80-bit component per id (it is not a monotonic factory), so two ids
77:     minted in the same millisecond have NO order relation — adjacent calls can
78:     invert (empirically ~1/5000 in a tight loop). Any code that needs receipt
79:     order MUST use the arrival coordinate (arrival_ordinal, arrival_seq), never id order — see the ORDERING
80:     AUTHORITY note on ``append_tick`` and the WitnessPosition A3 rule. Pure
81:     Python — no C extension, no dlopen cost.
82:     """
83:     return str(ULID())
84: 
85: 
86: # --- Tick hash chain -------------------------------------------------------
87: #
88: # The chain is a STORE-LAYER property, not a Tick-atom property (project
89: # decision design/tick-chain-at-store-layer). Each persisted tick row commits
90: # to (a) the previous tick row via prev_hash and (b) the fact window
91: # (window_start, fact_cursor] via window_hash — making both the tick sequence
92: # and the fact stream tamper-evident under verification. The Tick dataclass
93: # stays pure; merged/transported stores start fresh chains (new custody
94: # context). Rows written before the chain existed keep NULL chain columns —
95: # a visible pre-chain era, never retro-claimed.
96: #
97: # ORDERING AUTHORITY (observation design/event-order-vs-witness-order): window
98: # cursors are fact IDS (portable handles), but window MEMBERSHIP and hashing
99: # follow APPEND ORDER (rowid) — never id order. The chain's claim is receipt-
100: # integrity ("this store received these facts and nothing changed after
101: # sealing"), not chronology. Two reasons id order is the wrong authority here:
102: # (1) mixed-id-era stores — uuid4-era ids (2026-03-15..05-16) sort above every
103: # ULID, so MAX(id) pins to a mid-history fact forever and every window minted
104: # after is empty (friction chain-cursor-assumes-ulid-order); (2) late arrival —
105: # a backfilled/synced fact honestly carrying an old event timestamp would land
106: # INSIDE a sealed id-window and raise a false tamper alarm, where in witness
107: # order it lands on the live edge and the next tick seals it as received-now.
108: # Event order (ULID, fact.ts) remains the READ path's order; the two orders
109: # answer different questions and neither substitutes for the other.
110: #
111: # Delta 2 (design/tick-signature-on-every-tick): each tick row may carry an
112: # Ed25519 signature over its COMMITMENT hash (the 10 chain fields). Signing
113: # is injected, never imported — the store takes an optional signer callable
114: # (digest str -> signature str); verify_chain takes an optional verifier
115: # (signature str, digest str -> bool). apps/loops composes both with
116: # libs/sign. Pre-signature rows keep NULL — a visible era, same posture as
117: # the pre-chain era. The successor's prev_hash commits to the signature
118: # (design/tick-signature-in-chain-envelope): the row-IDENTITY hash is
119: # era-aware (includes the signature key only when non-NULL), so stripping a
120: # signature breaks the successor's link and a forger must rewrite the whole
121: # chain ahead — at which point only the registry outside the store (and
122: # external witnessing, a later delta) anchors the truth.
123:

158: def cursor_fact_summary(conn, fact_id: str) -> dict:
159:     """Resolve a fact_cursor id to a terse summary of its target fact.
160: 
161:     Read-path affordance, NOT part of any commitment — the chain commits
162:     to ids and hashes; this is the human-facing dereference. Returns
163:     ``{"cursor_kind": str, "cursor_preview": str}``. An empty cursor
164:     resolves to empty fields; a dangling cursor (fact deleted) is named
165:     explicitly rather than silently blank — verify reports that case as
166:     a break, but read paths still render honestly.
167:     """
168:     if not fact_id:
169:         return {"cursor_kind": "", "cursor_preview": ""}
170:     row = conn.execute(
171:         "SELECT kind, payload FROM facts WHERE id = ?", (fact_id,)
172:     ).fetchone()
173:     if row is None:
174:         return {"cursor_kind": "", "cursor_preview": "(cursor fact missing)"}
175:     try:
176:         payload = json.loads(row[1])
177:     except (TypeError, ValueError):
178:         payload = {}
179:     preview = ""
180:     if isinstance(payload, dict):
181:         for key in ("message", "topic", "name", "status"):
182:             val = payload.get(key)
183:             if isinstance(val, str) and val:
184:                 preview = val
185:                 break
186:     if len(preview) > 80:
187:         preview = preview[:79] + "…"
188:     return {"cursor_kind": row[0], "cursor_preview": preview}

193: # function — a reimplementation could silently diverge from what verify
194: # walks. Same function, two names: _tick_row_hash stays the internal
195: # spelling, tick_row_hash is the exported contract.
196: def tick_row_hash(row: tuple) -> str:
197:     """Era-aware tick row-identity hash (see _tick_row_hash)."""
198:     return _tick_row_hash(row)

224: class UnsignedTickInSignedEra(Exception):
225:     """``append_tick`` was asked to append an unsigned tick to a store already
226:     in the signed era — the tick-signing floor (decision design/tick-signing
227:     -era-is-a-floor). Minting it would break chain era-monotonicity
228:     (verify_chain flags "unsigned tick after signed era").
229: 
230:     The floor is enforced BY DEFAULT (``enforce_floor=True``): the invariant
231:     lives on the store mint, so every caller — every verb that fires a boundary
232:     AND every other live mint (e.g. the tasks harness) — is fail-safe without
233:     having to opt in. Only re-mint paths that legitimately reconstruct history
234:     under their own signer wiring (rebirth/slice/replay) opt OUT explicitly
235:     with ``enforce_floor=False``; the exemptions are named, not the enforcement.
236: 
237:     The signed-era predicate matches verify_chain exactly: a *chained* signed
238:     tick (``signature IS NOT NULL AND window_hash IS NOT NULL``) — a legacy
239:     pre-chain signed row does not open the era.
240:     """
241: 
242: 
243: class GenesisExists(Exception):
244:     """``absorb_genesis`` found a ``_decl.genesis`` row already in the store.
245: 
246:     Genesis is identity, not fold state (SPEC §9.2): a store's OWN lineage is
247:     opened exactly once, so re-absorption is refused rather than last-write-
248:     wins. Scoped by the ``store_meta.own_lineage`` marker — a merged foreign
249:     genesis does NOT block minting our own; only an already-open own lineage
250:     (marker present, or a single pre-marker genesis adopted as self) refuses.
251:     Re-absorb over an open lineage is the edit ceremony (``absorb_edit``).
252:     """
253: 
254: 
255: class UnsignableGenesis(Exception):
256:     """``absorb_genesis`` could not sign the genesis event.
257: 
258:     A genesis is the lineage's attestation root — an unsigned one is a hole
259:     in the store's attestation story (SPEC §9.2 / §9.4), so absorb refuses
260:     (rollback, no write) rather than append an unsigned root. Raised when the
261:     injected ``fact_signer`` is absent or returns no signature for the
262:     recording observer. The signature that matters is over the ACTUAL final
263:     payload, verified before commit — never a throwaway probe digest.
264:     """
265: 
266: 
267: class NoGenesis(Exception):
268:     """``absorb_edit`` found no ``_decl.genesis`` row — the store is unabsorbed.
269: 
270:     The edit ceremony (SPEC §9.2, S4) re-emits changed subjects over an
271:     already-opened lineage; there is nothing to diff against before genesis.
272:     Opening the lineage is the genesis path (``absorb_genesis``), not an edit.
273:     """
274: 
275: 
276: class AmbiguousGenesis(Exception):
277:     """No ``own_lineage`` marker and more than one ``_decl.genesis`` row.
278: 
279:     Without the store-local marker (pre-marker stores) the self-lineage id a
280:     write ceremony must stamp is indeterminate among several genesis rows.
281:     Conservative refusal, mirroring the resolver's ``AmbiguousLineage``
282:     (SPEC §9.2 Lineage). A marked store never raises this.
283:     """
284: 
285: 
286: class UnsignableEdit(Exception):
287:     """``absorb_edit`` could not sign a change event.
288: 
289:     Declaration events must be attestable (SPEC §9.4); an edit rides the same
290:     signing posture as genesis (an absorbed store already had a key at genesis),
291:     so an unsignable change refuses the WHOLE batch (rollback, no partial write)
292:     rather than append an unsigned declaration row.
293:     """
294: 
295: 
296: class StaleDeclarationHead(Exception):
297:     """``absorb_edit``'s ``expected_head`` no longer matches the store.
298: 
299:     The caller diffed the file against a declaration head that has since
300:     moved (a concurrent re-absorb landed). Applying the stale diff could
301:     leave the store's fold matching neither author's file, with both
302:     reporting success — so the edit refuses (rollback) and the caller re-runs
303:     against the current head. Compare-and-swap, not last-write-wins.
304:     """
305: 
306: 
307: class ReservedKindViolation(Exception):
308:     """``absorb_edit`` was handed a kind outside the frozen edit vocabulary.
309: 
310:     The edit ceremony emits only ``*-defined``/``*-retired``/``*-removed``
311:     declaration events (SPEC §9.2 table). This primitive is not a general
312:     ``_decl.*`` (or domain-kind) append escape: genesis has its own primitive,
313:     receipts are the transport layer's (S6), and user facts go through the
314:     emit path with its write-time reservation.
315:     """
316: 
317: 
318: class SqliteStore(Generic[T]):
319:     """Append-only SQLite event store.
320: 
321:     Cursor semantics: since(cursor) returns rows with rowid > cursor,
322:     matching EventStore's logical index behavior (0 = all events).
323:     """
324: 
325:     def __init__(
326:         self,
327:         *,
328:         path: Path,
329:         serialize: Callable[[T], dict],
330:         deserialize: Callable[[dict], T],
331:         tick_signer: Callable[[str], str] | None = None,
332:         fact_signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None] | None = None,
333:     ) -> None:
334:         """tick_signer: optional callable (commitment digest str -> signature
335:         str, e.g. base64 Ed25519). Injected, never imported — custody is a
336:         property of the store handle (the key lives next to the db), so the
337:         signer rides the constructor rather than each append_tick call.
338:         None = ticks append unsigned (pre-signature era, honest NULL).
339: 
340:         fact_signer (delta 3): optional callable (observer str, content
341:         commitment digest str -> signature str | None). Per-observer
342:         authorship (design/fact-signing-per-observer-keys): the callable
343:         selects a key by observer and returns None for observers without
344:         one — those facts append unsigned (honest NULL, a per-observer
345:         era rather than a per-store epoch). Injected, never imported.
346:         """
347:         self._path = Path(path)
348:         self._serialize = serialize
349:         self._deserialize = deserialize
350:         self._tick_signer = tick_signer
351:         self._fact_signer = fact_signer
352:         self._direct_fact_build: bool | None = None  # lazy detection
353:         self._fact_class: type | None = None
354: 
355:         try:
356:             is_new = self._path.stat().st_size == 0
357:         except OSError:
358:             is_new = True
359:             self._path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
360:         self._conn = sqlite3.connect(str(self._path))
361:         self._chain_ready = is_new  # new DBs get chain columns in schema
362:         self._fact_sig_ready = is_new  # new DBs get facts.signature in schema
363:         self._coordinate_ready = is_new  # new DBs get coordinates in schema
364:         self._coordinate_mode: Literal["mirrored", "arrival"] = "mirrored"
365:         self._coordinate_provider: Callable[[], Iterator[tuple[str, str, int, int]]] | None = None
366:         if is_new:
367:             # New DB — set WAL (persistent) and synchronous, create schema
368:             self._conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
369:             self._conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")
370:             for stmt in _SCHEMA_STMTS:
371:                 self._conn.execute(stmt)
372:             self._ensure_meta_table()
373:             _stamp_coordinate_axis(self._conn, self._coordinate_mode)
374:             self._conn.commit()
375:             self._sync_set = True
376:         else:
377:             # Existing DB: skip schema + pragmas — WAL is persistent,
378:             # schema already exists, first real query triggers schema load.
379:             # Defer synchronous=NORMAL to first write (after schema is loaded).
380:             self._sync_set = False
381: 
382:     def _detect_fact_build(self) -> None:
383:         """Detect if deserializer is Fact.from_dict for direct construction."""
384:         self._direct_fact_build = False
385:         deserialize = self._deserialize
386:         if hasattr(deserialize, '__self__') and hasattr(deserialize.__self__, '__name__'):
387:             self._fact_class = deserialize.__self__
388:             self._direct_fact_build = True
389:         elif hasattr(deserialize, '__func__'):
390:             try:
391:                 from atoms import Fact
392:                 if deserialize.__func__ is Fact.from_dict.__func__:
393:                     self._fact_class = Fact
394:                     self._direct_fact_build = True
395:             except (ImportError, AttributeError):
396:                 pass
397: 
398:     def _ensure_sync(self) -> None:
399:         """Set synchronous=NORMAL before first write. Deferred so schema load
400:         happens on first read (replay_into) rather than on pragma."""
401:         if not self._sync_set:
402:             self._conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")
403:             self._sync_set = True
404: 
405:     def append(
406:         self,
407:         event: T,
408:         *,
409:         id_override: str | None = None,
410:         signature_override: str | None = None,
411:     ) -> str:
412:         """Append one event to the store. Returns the ID assigned.
413: 
414:         If id_override is provided, that ID is used; otherwise a new ID
415:         is generated via gen_id(). The ID is returned in either case so
416:         callers (e.g. emit's receipt path) can reference the stored row.
417: 
418:         Signature (delta 3): when a fact_signer was injected, signs the
419:         CONTENT commitment of the new row under the fact's own observer;
420:         NULL when the signer returns None for that observer (per-observer
421:         pre-signature era). signature_override carries an EXISTING
422:         signature verbatim — replay/rebirth/transport paths must preserve
423:         the original authorship signature, never re-sign (re-signing
424:         another observer's fact under a local key would be forgery; the
425:         override bypasses the signer entirely).
426:         """
427:         return self.append_attested(
428:             event, id_override=id_override, signature_override=signature_override
429:         )[0]
430: 
431:     def append_attested(
432:         self,
433:         event: T,
434:         *,
435:         id_override: str | None = None,
436:         signature_override: str | None = None,
437:     ) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
438:         """:meth:`append`, also returning the committed row's signature.
439: 
440:         The signature handed back is the COMMITTED column, read back inside
441:         the write transaction after the INSERT (any AFTER triggers have
442:         fired) and before the commit — the write-receipt attestation
443:         contract (LIBS_CHANGES P1: "the committed row, or the write
444:         operation's actual result"). Assembly state is not enough: an AFTER
445:         INSERT trigger can rewrite the row between the two, and the receipt
446:         follows the row (SOL-R3-02). ``signature_override`` flows through
447:         the assembly verbatim. :meth:`fact_signature` remains the public
448:         read-back API for cross-checks.
449:         """
450:         if self._conn is None:
451:             # close() is part of the public lifecycle now — use-after-close
452:             # gets a named error, not AttributeError on a None connection.
453:             raise RuntimeError(f"store closed: {self._path}")
454:         self._ensure_sync()
455:         self._ensure_fact_signature_column()
456:         self._ensure_coordinate_schema()
457:         d = self._serialize(event)
458:         fact_id = id_override if id_override is not None else gen_id()
459:         observer = d["observer"]
460:         origin = d.get("origin", "")
461:         payload_text = json.dumps(d["payload"])
462:         if signature_override is not None:
463:             signature = signature_override
464:         elif self._fact_signer is not None:
465:             signature = self._fact_signer(
466:                 observer,
467:                 _fact_commitment_hash(d["kind"], d["ts"], observer, origin, payload_text),
468:             )
469:         else:
470:             signature = None
471:         committed = self._write_fact_row(
472:             (fact_id, d["kind"], d["ts"], observer, origin, payload_text, signature)
473:         )
474:         return fact_id, committed
475: 
476:     def fact_signature(self, fact_id: str) -> str | None:
477:         """Signature column of the COMMITTED fact row, or None.
478: 
479:         The read-back half of the write-receipt attestation contract
480:         (LIBS_CHANGES P1): the committed row is the authority on whether a
481:         write was signed — never "keys exist locally" inference. Returns
482:         None for an unsigned row, a pre-signature-column schema, or an
483:         unknown id (callers that need to distinguish absence hold the id
484:         ``append`` just returned). Read-only: never migrates schema.
485:         """
486:         if self._conn is None:
487:             raise RuntimeError(f"store closed: {self._path}")
488:         if not self._facts_have_signature_column():
489:             return None
490:         row = self._conn.execute(
491:             "SELECT signature FROM facts WHERE id = ?", (fact_id,)
492:         ).fetchone()
493:         return row[0] if row is not None else None
494: 
495:     def tick_signature_state(self, tick_id: str) -> tuple[str | None, bool] | None:
496:         """(signature, chained) of the COMMITTED tick row; None if unknown id.
497: 
498:         Same committed-row authority as :meth:`fact_signature`, for the
499:         ticks axis: ``signature`` is the row's persisted Ed25519 signature
500:         (None in the pre-signature era), ``chained`` whether the row
501:         carries chain fields (``window_hash`` non-NULL). Read-only: never
502:         migrates schema — pre-chain/pre-signature schemas report
503:         ``(None, False)`` for a known id.
504:         """
505:         if self._conn is None:
506:             raise RuntimeError(f"store closed: {self._path}")
507:         if self._ticks_have_chain_columns():
508:             select = "signature, window_hash"
509:         else:
510:             cols = {r[1] for r in self._conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(ticks)")}
511:             select = ", ".join(
512:                 c if c in cols else f"NULL AS {c}"
513:                 for c in ("signature", "window_hash")
514:             )
515:         row = self._conn.execute(
516:             f"SELECT {select} FROM ticks WHERE id = ?", (tick_id,)
517:         ).fetchone()
518:         if row is None:
519:             return None
520:         return (row[0], row[1] is not None)
521: 
522:     def _ticks_have_chain_columns(self) -> bool:
523:         """Cached read-only probe for the ticks chain/signature columns.
524: 
525:         Same posture as ``_fact_sig_ready`` / ``_facts_have_signature_column``:
526:         the positive result is cached (adopting ``_chain_ready``, which then
527:         correctly no-ops ``_ensure_chain_columns``); a legacy schema re-probes.
528:         Never migrates.
529:         """
530:         if self._chain_ready:
531:             return True
532:         cols = {r[1] for r in self._conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(ticks)")}
533:         if all(c in cols for c in _CHAIN_COLUMNS):
534:             self._chain_ready = True
535:             return True
536:         return False
537: 
538:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
539:     # Row-write seam. Both append paths assemble the full persisted row —
540:     # exactly the 7-field fact / 11-field tick shape the commitment hashers
541:     # and engine.jsonl_codec take — and hand it to these hooks, which own the
542:     # INSERT *and* the commit. Subclasses (engine.jsonl_store) override them
543:     # to make a durable JSONL line the authoritative write and sqlite the
544:     # derived index, without touching mint logic or the read surface.
545:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
546: 
547:     def _sync_derived_state(self) -> None:
548:         """Seam: bring derived state up to date before reading chain state.
549: 
550:         A no-op here — sqlite IS the state. A subclass whose sqlite is a
551:         DERIVED index (engine.jsonl_store) must reconcile the index with its
552:         canonical log *before* any mint reads chain state from it: a durable
553:         but unindexed line would otherwise be invisible to the predecessor,
554:         window-start and fact-cursor derivation, and the resulting mis-linked
555:         tick lands in the canonical log where no rebuild can repair it.
556: 
557:         Called at the top of ``append_tick`` (before the ``prev_row`` read)
558:         and at the top of ``absorb_genesis``/``absorb_edit`` — strictly
559:         BEFORE their ``BEGIN IMMEDIATE``, because a reconcile commits and
560:         would split the ceremony transaction. The chain-head, fact-cursor and
561:         declaration-head reads inside those transactions therefore see an
562:         index that has consumed every durable line.
563:         """
564: 
565:     def _ceremony_persist(self, rows: list[tuple]) -> None:
566:         """Seam: make a declaration ceremony's rows canonical, pre-commit.
567: 
568:         Called inside the open ``BEGIN IMMEDIATE`` transaction, after every
569:         CAS check has passed and all fact-row INSERTs (and meta stamps) are
570:         staged, immediately before COMMIT. ``rows`` are the full 7-field
571:         persisted fact rows, in emission order.
572: 
573:         A no-op here — sqlite IS the store, and the staged INSERTs commit.
574:         ``engine.jsonl_store`` overrides it to append the ceremony as ONE
575:         durable log line (a plain fact line for one row, a ``batch`` envelope
576:         for several) and stamp the consumed offset/counts, preserving
577:         ``_write``'s ordering: refusals before any log byte, fsync before the
578:         index row is observable.
579:         """
580: 
581:     def _committed_row_state(self, table: str, row_id: str) -> tuple[bool, str | None]:
582:         """(exists, signature) of the row as it stands post-INSERT, pre-commit.
583: 
584:         Existence and signature are separate answers (SOL-R4-02): a NULL
585:         signature on a committed row and a row an AFTER trigger deleted are
586:         different facts, and conflating them once minted a stored=True
587:         receipt for no row. ``table`` is an internal constant
588:         (``facts``/``ticks``), never caller input.
589:         """
590:         r = self._conn.execute(
591:             f"SELECT signature FROM {table} WHERE id = ?", (row_id,)  # noqa: S608
592:         ).fetchone()
593:         return (r is not None, r[0] if r is not None else None)
594: 
595:     def _committed_full_row(self, table: str, row_id: str) -> tuple:
596:         """The COMPLETE inserted row, post-INSERT pre-commit, or refuse.
597: 
598:         Read back after any AFTER triggers fired, in persisted column
599:         order — what the store will actually commit. An absent row is the
600:         SOL-R4-02 typed refusal. Used wherever the caller must compare or
601:         persist the committed truth, not the assembled intent: the JSONL
602:         log derivation (SOL-R4-03) and the ceremony full-row equality
603:         check (R4 arbiter follow-up).
604:         """
605:         columns = FACT_ALL_COLUMNS if table == "facts" else TICK_ALL_COLUMNS
606:         r = self._conn.execute(
607:             f"SELECT {', '.join(columns)} FROM {table} "  # noqa: S608
608:             "WHERE id = ?", (row_id,)
609:         ).fetchone()
610:         if r is None:
611:             raise CommittedRowMissing(
612:                 f"the inserted {table} row {row_id} is ABSENT at pre-commit "
613:                 "read-back (a schema-level rewrite, e.g. an AFTER INSERT "
614:                 "trigger, deleted it) — rolling back; refusing to mint a "
615:                 "stored receipt for a row the store did not keep"
616:             )
617:         return tuple(r)
618: 
619:     def _committed_signature(self, table: str, row_id: str) -> str | None:
620:         """The COMMITTED signature; raises if the row itself is gone.
621: 
622:         The one read-back per write (SOL-R3-02): executed after the INSERT
623:         — so any AFTER triggers have already fired — and before the commit,
624:         it reads exactly what will be committed. An ABSENT row (something
625:         deleted it out from under the staged INSERT) is a typed refusal
626:         (SOL-R4-02): callers roll back — a store that eats rows must not
627:         get a stored=True receipt.
628:         """
629:         exists, signature = self._committed_row_state(table, row_id)
630:         if not exists:
631:             raise CommittedRowMissing(
632:                 f"the inserted {table} row {row_id} is ABSENT at pre-commit "
633:                 "read-back (a schema-level rewrite, e.g. an AFTER INSERT "
634:                 "trigger, deleted it) — rolling back; refusing to mint a "
635:                 "stored receipt for a row the store did not keep"
636:             )
637:         return signature
638: 
639:     def _write_fact_row(self, row: tuple) -> str | None:
640:         """Persist one assembled fact row (id, kind, ts, observer, origin,
641:         payload, signature). Returns the COMMITTED signature (read back
642:         inside the transaction, after triggers, before commit); raises
643:         CommittedRowMissing — after rollback — if the row is gone."""
644:         try:
645:             if len(row) == len(FACT_CONTENT_COLUMNS):
646:                 ord_val = self._conn.execute(
647:                     "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(arrival_ordinal), 0) + 1 FROM facts"
648:                 ).fetchone()[0]
649:                 row = (*row, ord_val, 0)
650:             self._conn.execute(FACT_INSERT_SQL, row)
651:             committed = self._committed_signature("facts", row[0])
652:             self._conn.commit()
653:         except BaseException:
654:             self._conn.rollback()
655:             raise
656:         return committed
657: 
658:     def _write_tick_row(self, row: tuple) -> str | None:
659:         """Persist one assembled tick row (_TICK_ROW_SQL order + signature).
660:         Same read-back + rollback-on-absence contract as facts."""
661:         try:
662:             if len(row) == len(TICK_CONTENT_COLUMNS):
663:                 ord_val = self._conn.execute(
664:                     "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(arrival_ordinal), 0) + 1 FROM ticks"
665:                 ).fetchone()[0]
666:                 row = (*row, ord_val, 0)
667:             self._conn.execute(TICK_INSERT_SQL, row)
668:             committed = self._committed_signature("ticks", row[0])
669:             self._conn.commit()
670:         except BaseException:
671:             self._conn.rollback()
672:             raise
673:         return committed
674: 
675:     def current_chain_head(self) -> str | None:
676:         """The row-identity hash of the latest *chained* tick, or None.
677: 
678:         What a successor tick's ``prev_hash`` commits to (era-aware
679:         ``_tick_row_hash``) — the "chain head" a genesis pins. None when the
680:         store has no chained tick (a pre-chain-only or empty store pins on
681:         the fact cursor instead). Read-only; never migrates schema.
682:         """
683:         cols = {r[1] for r in self._conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(ticks)")}
684:         if "window_hash" not in cols:
685:             return None
686:         row_sql = _TICK_ROW_SQL if "signature" in cols else _TICK_ROW_SQL_V1
687:         row = self._conn.execute(
688:             f"SELECT {row_sql} FROM ticks "
689:             "WHERE window_hash IS NOT NULL ORDER BY arrival_ordinal DESC, arrival_seq DESC LIMIT 1"
690:         ).fetchone()
691:         if row is None:
692:             return None
693:         # _tick_row_hash reads an 11-field row (signature at [10]); a delta-1
694:         # schema yields 10 — pad the signature slot NULL.
695:         return _tick_row_hash(row if len(row) > 10 else (*row, None))
696: 
697:     def _genesis_payload(self, protocol: int, documents: list) -> dict[str, Any]:
698:         """The ``_decl.genesis`` payload — the era pins live HERE, and only
699:         here.
700: 
701:         A seam, not a convenience: an arrival-canonical store overrides this
702:         because its era boundary is the dense ordinal (``ord < N`` is
703:         structural) and a tick-row hash frozen into a signed immutable
704:         record would rest an integrity claim on a projection. Legacy modes
705:         keep the pins byte-identical. MUST be called inside the ceremony's
706:         open transaction — the pins are read against the same snapshot the
707:         append lands in.
708:         """
709:         chain_head = self.current_chain_head()
710:         frow = self._conn.execute(
711:             "SELECT id FROM facts ORDER BY arrival_ordinal DESC, arrival_seq DESC LIMIT 1"
712:         ).fetchone()
713:         return {
714:             "protocol": protocol,
715:             "documents": list(documents),
716:             "chain_head": chain_head,
717:             "fact_cursor": frow[0] if frow else None,
718:         }
719: 
720:     def _genesis_lineage_id(self) -> str:
721:         """The id the ``_decl.genesis`` row is minted under — which IS the
722:         declaration lineage id (§9.2).
723: 
724:         A seam for the same reason as :meth:`_genesis_payload`: an
725:         arrival-canonical store's identity is its arrival genesis, so the
726:         declaration genesis row projects that lineage instead of minting a
727:         fresh one. Legacy modes mint here, unchanged.
728:         """
729:         return gen_id()
730: 
731:     def _allocate_ceremony_coordinates(
732:         self, conn: Any, count: int
733:     ) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
734:         ord_val = conn.execute(
735:             "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(arrival_ordinal), 0) + 1 FROM facts"
736:         ).fetchone()[0]
737:         return [(ord_val + idx, 0) for idx in range(count)]
738: 
739:     def absorb_genesis(
740:         self,
741:         documents: list,
742:         *,
743:         observer: str,
744:         origin: str = "",
745:         fact_signer: Callable[[str, str], str | None] | None,
746:         protocol: int | None = None,
747:     ) -> dict[str, Any]:
748:         """Open the store's declaration lineage — the atomic genesis primitive.
749: 
750:         The lineage-opening ceremony's write half (SPEC §9.2 era rule),
751:         performed as ONE ``BEGIN IMMEDIATE`` transaction so the identity check,
752:         the era pins, and the append are indivisible: a concurrent emit cannot
753:         falsify a pin between read and write, and two concurrent absorbs cannot
754:         both mint a genesis (the second blocks on the write lock, then sees the
755:         first's row and refuses).
756: 
757:         Steps, all inside the transaction:
758: 
759:         1. Refuse (``GenesisExists``) if the store's OWN lineage is already
760:            open — the ``store_meta.own_lineage`` marker exists. An unmarked
761:            store with ANY ``_decl.genesis`` rows refuses as ambiguous:
762:            identity is claimed only by the explicit :meth:`adopt_lineage`
763:            ceremony, never inferred from facts (the singleton heuristic was
764:            a hijack vector — closing re-review #1). Foreign genesis rows
765:            (marker present, ids differ) do NOT block: merge legitimately
766:            carries them as inert citizens (§9.2 Lineage), and a store that
767:            received one must still be able to mint its own identity.
768:         2. Read the era pins — chain head (latest chained tick's row hash) and
769:            fact cursor (newest fact by arrival coordinate order) — so
770:            "everything before me predates historization" is verifiable.
771:         3. Build the whole payload (``documents`` + ``protocol`` + pins), sign
772:            its CONTENT commitment under ``observer`` via ``fact_signer``, and
773:            refuse (``UnsignableGenesis``, rollback) if no signature is
774:            produced. The signed commitment is over the ACTUAL final payload,
775:            never a throwaway probe — genesis is the attestation root.
776:         4. Append the ``_decl.genesis`` row, stamp ``store_meta.own_lineage``
777:            with its id (the store-local identity marker — merge copies facts,
778:            never meta, so identity cannot arrive from outside), and commit.
779:            The genesis row's own id IS the lineage id (§9.2), returned in the
780:            receipt.
781: 
782:         This is protocol surface the Go conformance oracle mirrors FOR THE
783:         LEGACY MODES: the payload shape (``protocol``, ``documents``,
784:         ``chain_head``, ``fact_cursor``), the witness-order cursor, and the
785:         sign-final-payload rule are that contract. The payload shape is
786:         per-mode through the :meth:`_genesis_payload` seam — an
787:         arrival-canonical store's payload sheds both pins, and its receipt
788:         carries no pin keys at all (absent, not None). The
789:         sign-final-payload rule holds in every mode. ``documents`` are the
790:         subject-scoped declaration documents (from
791:         ``lang.document.vertex_to_documents``).
792: 
793:         Returns a receipt dict: ``{lineage, protocol, documents,
794:         <the mode's payload keys beyond protocol/documents>, observer,
795:         signed}`` — for legacy modes exactly ``{lineage, protocol,
796:         documents, chain_head, fact_cursor, observer, signed}``.
797:         """
798:         from lang.document import DECL_GENESIS
799: 
800:         if protocol is None:
801:             protocol = 1
802: 
803:         # Prepare schema OUTSIDE the transaction (these commit): the genesis
804:         # write and the chain-head read need the signature and chain columns
805:         # present. Safe pre-work — they mutate no facts.
806:         self._ensure_sync()
807:         self._ensure_fact_signature_column()
808:         self._ensure_chain_columns()
809:         self._ensure_coordinate_schema()
810:         self._ensure_meta_table()
811:         # Reconcile derived state BEFORE the transaction (a reconcile commits):
812:         # the chain-head and fact-cursor pins read below must not miss a
813:         # durable-but-unindexed line — a mis-pin lands in the canonical log
814:         # where no rebuild can repair it. No-op when sqlite is the store.
815:         self._sync_derived_state()
816: 
817:         conn = self._conn
818:         prev_iso = conn.isolation_level
819:         conn.isolation_level = None  # autocommit — explicit transaction control
820:         try:
821:             conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
822:             try:
823:                 own = self._own_lineage_in_txn(conn)
824:                 if own is not None:
825:                     raise GenesisExists(
826:                         "the store's own lineage is already open "
827:                         f"(own_lineage {own}) — re-absorb/edit is a later "
828:                         "ceremony (no --force)"
829:                     )
830: 
831:                 payload = self._genesis_payload(protocol, documents)
832:                 # Receipt pin-extras come from the seam: whatever keys the
833:                 # mode's payload carries beyond {protocol, documents} are
834:                 # reported, and ONLY those — a mode that dissolved its pins
835:                 # must not fake them as None in the receipt.
836:                 extras = {
837:                     key: value
838:                     for key, value in payload.items()
839:                     if key not in ("protocol", "documents")
840:                 }
841:                 ts = datetime.now(_UTC).timestamp()
842:                 lineage_id = self._genesis_lineage_id()
843:                 payload_text = json.dumps(payload)
844:                 signature = (
845:                     fact_signer(
846:                         observer,
847:                         _fact_commitment_hash(
848:                             DECL_GENESIS, ts, observer, origin, payload_text
849:                         ),
850:                     )
851:                     if fact_signer is not None
852:                     else None
853:                 )
854:                 if signature is None:
855:                     raise UnsignableGenesis(
856:                         f"no signature produced for observer {observer!r} — a "
857:                         "genesis must be signed (it is the lineage's "
858:                         "attestation root); set up signing first"
859:                     )
860: 
861:                 coords = self._allocate_ceremony_coordinates(conn, 1)[0]
862:                 row = (
863:                     lineage_id, DECL_GENESIS, ts, observer, origin,
864:                     payload_text, signature,
865:                     coords[0], coords[1],
866:                 )
867:                 conn.execute(FACT_INSERT_SQL, row)
868:                 # Committed-row honesty (SOL-R3-02 + R4 arbiter follow-up):
869:                 # read the WHOLE row back after the INSERT (AFTER triggers
870:                 # fired), before any log byte and before COMMIT, and refuse
871:                 # on ANY divergence — the signature covers the final
872:                 # persisted payload (ratified encoding contract), so a
873:                 # rewritten non-signature field leaves a signature that no
874:                 # longer verifies against its row; persisting either the
875:                 # assembled or the mutated row would be a verification lie.
876:                 if self._committed_full_row("facts", lineage_id) != row:
877:                     raise UnsignableGenesis(
