141: class AggregateRead:
142:     """Pure composition view over one closeable, sequential member capture."""
143: 
144:     def __init__(self, capture: AggregateCapture) -> None:
145:         self.capture = capture
146:         self._definitions = {
147:             _identity_key(definition.identity): definition for definition in capture.definitions
148:         }
149:         self._members = {_member_key(member): member for member in capture.members}
150:         self._spec_cache: dict[tuple[object, ...], dict[str, Any]] = {}
151:         self._stream_cache: dict[tuple[object, ...], tuple[_Stream, ...]] = {}
152: 
153:     @property
154:     def root(self) -> CapturedDefinition:
155:         return self.capture.definitions[0]
156: 
157:     def member_evidence(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
158:         return [
159:             {
160:                 "path": [
161:                     {"relation": step.relation, "ordinal": step.ordinal, "label": step.label}
162:                     for step in member.identity.path
163:                 ],
164:                 "locator": member.identity.locator,
165:                 "declaration_identity": member.identity.declaration_identity,
166:                 "role": member.identity.role,
167:                 "definition": {
168:                     "locator": member.definition.locator,
169:                     "sha256": member.definition.sha256,
170:                 },
171:                 "basis": member.basis,
172:             }
173:             for member in self.capture.members
174:         ]
175: 
176:     def definition_evidence(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
177:         return [
178:             {
179:                 "path": [
180:                     {"relation": step.relation, "ordinal": step.ordinal, "label": step.label}
181:                     for step in definition.identity.path
182:                 ],
183:                 "locator": definition.identity.locator,
184:                 "role": definition.identity.role,
185:                 "local_definition": {
186:                     "locator": definition.local_definition.locator,
187:                     "sha256": definition.local_definition.sha256,
188:                 },
189:                 "basis": definition.basis,
190:                 "children": [
191:                     {
192:                         "path": [
193:                             {
194:                                 "relation": step.relation,
195:                                 "ordinal": step.ordinal,
196:                                 "label": step.label,
197:                             }
198:                             for step in child.path
199:                         ],
200:                         "locator": child.locator,
201:                         "role": child.role,
202:                     }
203:                     for child in definition.children
204:                 ],
205:             }
206:             for definition in self.capture.definitions
207:         ]
208: 
209:     def specs(self, definition: CapturedDefinition | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
210:         definition = self.root if definition is None else definition
211:         key = _identity_key(definition.identity)
212:         cached = self._spec_cache.get(key)
213:         if cached is not None:
214:             return cached
215:         child_specs = [
216:             (child.locator, self.specs(self._definitions[_identity_key(child)]))
217:             for child in definition.children
218:         ]
219:         own = compile_vertex(definition.effective_declaration)
220:         inherited = merge_fold_specs(child_specs, override_kinds=frozenset(own))
221:         result = {**inherited, **own}
222:         self._spec_cache[key] = result
223:         return result
224: 
225:     def _facts(self, member: AggregateMember) -> tuple[Fact, ...]:
226:         return member.snapshot.facts(
227:             FactRequest(limit=None, include_internal=False, order="oldest")
228:         ).items
229: 
230:     def streams(self, definition: CapturedDefinition | None = None) -> tuple[_Stream, ...]:
231:         definition = self.root if definition is None else definition
232:         key = _identity_key(definition.identity)
233:         cached = self._stream_cache.get(key)
234:         if cached is not None:
235:             return cached
236:         children = tuple(
237:             stream
238:             for child in definition.children
239:             for stream in self.streams(self._definitions[_identity_key(child)])
240:         )
241:         identity = definition.identity
242:         overlay = self._members.get((identity.path, identity.locator, "own-overlay"))
243:         member = self._members.get((identity.path, identity.locator, identity.role))
244:         if overlay is not None:
245:             own_specs = compile_vertex(definition.effective_declaration)
246:             shadowed = set(own_specs)
247:             retained_children = tuple(
248:                 _Stream(
249:                     child.member,
250:                     tuple(
251:                         fact
252:                         for fact in child.facts
253:                         if _kind_target(fact.kind, own_specs) not in shadowed
254:                     ),
255:                 )
256:                 for child in children
257:             )
258:             result = retained_children + (
259:                 _Stream(
260:                     overlay,
261:                     tuple(
262:                         fact
263:                         for fact in self._facts(overlay)
264:                         if _kind_target(fact.kind, own_specs) in shadowed
265:                     ),
266:                 ),
267:             )
268:         elif member is not None:
269:             result = children + (_Stream(member, self._facts(member)),)
270:         else:
271:             result = children
272:         self._stream_cache[key] = result
273:         return result
274: 
275:     def observations(
276:         self, *, observer: str | None = None
277:     ) -> tuple[_Observation, ...]:
278:         return tuple(
279:             _Observation(stream.member, fact)
280:             for stream in self.streams()
281:             for fact in stream.facts
282:             if observer is None or observer_matches(fact.observer, observer)
283:         )
284: 
285:     def _eligible_members(
286:         self, definition: CapturedDefinition, kind: str
287:     ) -> tuple[AggregateMember, ...]:
288:         """Structural member axis after overlay selection, before row filters."""
289:         identity = definition.identity
290:         overlay = self._members.get((identity.path, identity.locator, "own-overlay"))
291:         direct_specs = compile_vertex(definition.effective_declaration)
292:         if overlay is not None and _kind_target(kind, direct_specs) is not None:
293:             # Empty own data still shadows descendants for its declared kind.
294:             return (overlay,)
295:         children = tuple(
296:             member
297:             for child in definition.children
298:             for member in self._eligible_members(self._definitions[_identity_key(child)], kind)
299:         )
300:         member = self._members.get((identity.path, identity.locator, identity.role))
301:         if member is not None:
302:             return children + (member,)
303:         return children
304: 
305:     def ordered_for_kind(
306:         self,
307:         kind: str,
308:         *,
309:         observer: str | None = None,
310:         runtime_epoch_only: bool = False,
311:     ) -> list[Fact]:
312:         specs = self.specs()
313:         eligible = self._eligible_members(self.root, kind)
314:         eligible_keys = {_member_key(member) for member in eligible}
315:         selected = [
316:             observation
317:             for observation in self.observations(observer=observer)
318:             if _member_key(observation.member) in eligible_keys
319:             and _kind_target(observation.fact.kind, specs) == kind
320:             and (
321:                 not runtime_epoch_only
322:                 or observation.member.runtime_epoch.start_ordinal is None
323:                 or observation.fact.arrival_ordinal
324:                 > observation.member.runtime_epoch.start_ordinal
325:             )
326:         ]
327:         if len(eligible_keys) <= 1:
328:             return [item.fact for item in selected]
329:         selected.sort(
330:             key=lambda item: (
331:                 _path_key(item.member.identity.path),
332:                 item.member.identity.locator,
333:                 item.member.identity.role,
334:                 item.fact.arrival_ordinal,
335:                 item.fact.arrival_seq,
336:             )
337:         )
338:         ordered = totalize(
339:             selected,
340:             ByKey("ts"),
341:             get_field=lambda item, field: (
342:                 item.fact.ts if field == "ts" else item.fact.payload.get(field)
343:             ),
344:             get_id=lambda item: item.fact.id,
345:         )
346:         return [item.fact for item in ordered]
347: 
348:     def all_events(
349:         self, *, start: float, end: float
350:     ) -> list[tuple[str, AggregateMember, Fact | Tick]]:
351:         events: list[tuple[str, AggregateMember, Fact | Tick]] = []
352:         for member in self.capture.members:
353:             for fact in self._facts(member):
354:                 if start <= fact.ts <= end:
355:                     events.append(("fact", member, fact))
356:             for tick in member.snapshot.ticks(TickRequest(since=start, until=end)):
357:                 events.append(("tick", member, tick))
358:         if len(self.capture.members) <= 1:
359:             events.sort(
360:                 key=lambda item: (
361:                     item[2].ts,
362:                     item[2].arrival_ordinal,
363:                     item[2].arrival_seq,
364:                     item[2].id,
365:                 )
366:             )
367:         else:
368:             events.sort(
369:                 key=lambda item: (
370:                     item[2].ts,
371:                     item[2].id,
372:                     _path_key(item[1].identity.path),
373:                     item[1].identity.locator,
374:                     item[1].identity.role,
375:                     item[2].arrival_ordinal,
376:                     item[2].arrival_seq,
377:                 )
378:             )
379:         return events

382: @contextmanager
383: def open_aggregate_read(
384:     target: Path,
385:     *,
386:     registry: BackendRegistry | None = None,
387:     opened_root: OpenedRead | None = None,
388: ) -> Iterator[AggregateRead]:
389:     """Plan exact local topology, then retain all descriptor snapshots."""
390:     resolver = _Resolver()
391:     capture = capture_aggregate(
392:         registry if registry is not None else BackendRegistry.with_builtin_backends(),
393:         resolver.root(target),
394:         resolver,
395:         opened_root=opened_root,
396:     )
397:     try:
398:         yield AggregateRead(capture)
399:     finally:
400:         capture.close()

402: 
403: def is_local_aggregate(target: Path) -> bool:
404:     """Whether the locator bytes declare a composition root before any open."""
405:     if target.suffix.lower() != ".vertex":
406:         return False
407:     try:
408:         ast = parse_vertex(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), path=target)
409:     except Exception:
410:         return False
411:     return ast.combine is not None or ast.discover is not None
412: 
413: 
414: def has_local_descriptor_aggregate(target: Path) -> bool:
415:     """Route a *storeless* local composition with Arrival descendants.
416: 
417:     A descriptor-bearing root must first open its ledger and resolve the
418:     adopted declaration at a bounded head.  Its locator can be ahead of (or
419:     behind) that declaration, so using local ``combine``/``discover`` here
420:     would silently change the execution shape before adoption.  Storeless
421:     roots have no adopted declaration to consult; their local topology is the
422:     honest planner input and this predicate keeps their Arrival descendants
423:     out of the legacy reader.
424:     """
425:     root = target.resolve()
426:     if root.suffix.lower() != ".vertex" or not root.exists():
427:         return False
428:     try:
429:         root_ast = parse_vertex(root.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), path=root)
430:     except Exception:
431:         return False
432:     if descriptor_for(root_ast, root) is not None:
433:         return False
434:     if root_ast.combine is None and root_ast.discover is None:
435:         return False
436: 
437:     seen: set[Path] = set()
438: 
439:     def visit(path: Path) -> bool:
440:         path = path.resolve()
441:         if path in seen or not path.exists():
442:             return False
443:         seen.add(path)
444:         try:
445:             ast = parse_vertex(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), path=path)
446:         except Exception:
447:             return False
448:         if descriptor_for(ast, path) is not None:
449:             return True
450:         if ast.combine is not None:
451:             for entry in ast.combine:
452:                 child = resolve_vertex(entry.name, _loops_home())
453:                 if not child.is_absolute():
454:                     child = path.parent / child
455:                 if visit(child):
456:                     return True
457:         elif ast.discover is not None:
458:             for child in path.parent.glob(ast.discover):
459:                 if child.suffix == ".vertex" and child.resolve() != path and visit(child):
460:                     return True
461:         return False
462: 
463:     return visit(root)

76: def _arrival_semantic_preview(
77:     vertex_path: Path,
78:     proposed_text: str,
79:     *,
80:     registry: Any | None,
81: ) -> DeclarationPlanResult:
82:     """Preview a splice only after confirming the cache matches CURRENT."""
83:     from engine.arrival_boundary_continuity import (
84:         BoundaryContinuityConflict,
85:         analyze_boundary_continuity,
86:         collect_verified_parameter_rows,
87:     )
88:     from engine.arrival_contract import TickRequest
89:     from engine.arrival_declarations import DeclarationPreparationRefused
90:     from engine.declaration import validate_arrival_runtime_identity
91:     from lang import diff_documents, parse_vertex, validate_vertex, vertex_to_documents
92: 
93:     from .declare import DeclarationPreviewResult
94:     from .errors import normalize_exception
95:     from .read import _arrival_declaration, _open_arrival_read
96: 
97:     resolved = _arrival_descriptor_for(vertex_path)
98:     if resolved is None:
99:         raise TargetUnsupported(f"not an explicit Arrival target: {vertex_path}")
100:     _path, locator_ast, descriptor = resolved
101:     active = registry or BackendRegistry.with_builtin_backends()
102:     try:
103:         local_ast = parse_vertex(vertex_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), path=vertex_path)
104:         with _open_arrival_read(resolved, registry=active) as (_locator, _descriptor, opened):
105:             effective_ast, _status, _facts, _lineage = _arrival_declaration(
106:                 locator_ast, vertex_path, opened
107:             )
108:             local_docs = [doc.as_json() for doc in vertex_to_documents(local_ast)]
109:             effective_docs = [doc.as_json() for doc in vertex_to_documents(effective_ast)]
110:             if local_docs != effective_docs:
111:                 return DeclarationPreviewResult(
112:                     applicable=False,
113:                     reason="declaration cache differs from CURRENT Arrival history",
114:                     mode="arrival-semantic-preview",
115:                     vertex_path=str(vertex_path),
116:                     generation_before={"captured_head": opened.basis.captured_head},
117:                     changes=[],
118:                     store=StoreDescriptorInfo.from_descriptor(descriptor),
119:                     basis=asdict(opened.basis),
120:                     captured_head={
121:                         "lineage": opened.basis.captured_head.lineage,
122:                         "ordinal": opened.basis.captured_head.ordinal,
123:                         "record_hash": opened.basis.captured_head.record_hash,
124:                     },
125:                     lineage=opened.basis.lineage,
126:                 )
127:             proposed_ast = parse_vertex(proposed_text, path=vertex_path)
128:             validate_vertex(proposed_ast)
129:             validate_arrival_runtime_identity(
130:                 proposed_ast.name, proposed_ast.loops, refusal=DeclarationPreparationRefused
131:             )
132:             proposed_docs = [
133:                 doc.as_json() for doc in vertex_to_documents(proposed_ast)
134:             ]
135:             changes = diff_documents(local_docs, proposed_docs)
136:             try:
137:                 verified_params = collect_verified_parameter_rows(
138:                     opened.snapshot.declaration_anchor,
139:                     _facts,
140:                     target_documents=proposed_docs,
141:                     base_dir=vertex_path.parent,
142:                 )
143:                 analyze_boundary_continuity(
144:                     opened.snapshot.declaration_anchor,
145:                     _facts,
146:                     opened.snapshot.ticks(TickRequest(since=float("-inf"))),
147:                     target_documents=proposed_docs,
148:                     verified_params=verified_params,
149:                     runtime_epoch=opened.runtime_epoch(),
150:                 )
151:             except BoundaryContinuityConflict as conflict:
152:                 refusal = DeclarationPreparationRefused(
153:                     f"boundary continuity refuses declaration preview: {conflict}",
154:                     coordinator_phase="prepare",
155:                     effects={
156:                         "custody": {
157:                             "attempt": "not-entered",
158:                             "state": "not-attempted",
159:                         }
160:                     },
161:                     captured_head=opened.basis.captured_head,
162:                 )
163:                 raise refusal from conflict
164:             return DeclarationPreviewResult(
165:                 applicable=True,
166:                 reason="semantic preview only; signed execution requires observer credentials",
167:                 mode="arrival-semantic-preview",
168:                 vertex_path=str(vertex_path),
169:                 generation_before={"captured_head": opened.basis.captured_head},
170:                 changes=[c.as_dict() if hasattr(c, "as_dict") else str(c) for c in changes],
171:                 store=StoreDescriptorInfo.from_descriptor(descriptor),
172:                 basis=asdict(opened.basis),
173:                 captured_head={
174:                     "lineage": opened.basis.captured_head.lineage,
175:                     "ordinal": opened.basis.captured_head.ordinal,
176:                     "record_hash": opened.basis.captured_head.record_hash,
177:                 },
178:                 lineage=opened.basis.lineage,
179:             )
180:     except Exception as exc:
181:         normalized = normalize_exception(exc)
182:         if normalized is exc:
183:             raise
184:         raise normalized from exc

187: def plan_kind_mutation(
188:     target: Path | str,
189:     op: str,
190:     kind_name: str,
191:     definition: LoopDef | None = None,
192:     *,
193:     registry: BackendRegistry | None = None,
194: ) -> DeclarationPlanResult:
195:     """Dry-run preview of a proposed kind declaration mutation.
196: 
197:     Parameters:
198:         target: Path to the .vertex file.
199:         op: Operation type ('add', 'edit', or 'remove').
200:         kind_name: The name of the kind to mutate.
201:         definition: LoopDef AST node (for add/edit).
202: 
203:     Returns:
204:         DeclarationPlanResult with proposed changes and applicability status.
205:     """
206:     vertex_path = Path(target).resolve()
207:     if _arrival_descriptor_for(vertex_path) is not None:
208:         from .declare import DeclarationPreviewResult
209: 
210:         loop_def = definition or _default_loop_def()
211:         current_text = vertex_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
212:         try:
213:             if op == "add":
214:                 new_text = add_vertex_kind(current_text, kind_name, loop_def)
215:             elif op == "edit":
216:                 new_text = edit_vertex_kind(current_text, kind_name, loop_def)
217:             elif op == "remove":
218:                 new_text = remove_vertex_kind(current_text, kind_name)
219:             else:
220:                 raise SdkValueError(
221:                     f"unsupported mutation op '{op}', expected 'add', 'edit', or 'remove'"
222:                 )
223:         except SdkValueError:
224:             raise
225:         except ValueError as exc:
226:             return DeclarationPreviewResult(
227:                 applicable=False, reason=str(exc), mode="refused",
228:                 vertex_path=str(vertex_path), generation_before=None, changes=[],
229:             )
230:         return _arrival_semantic_preview(vertex_path, new_text, registry=registry)
231: 
232:     info = resolve_target(target)
233:     if info.target_type != "vertex":
234:         raise TargetUnsupported(
235:             f"plan_kind_mutation requires a .vertex target, got {info.target_type}"
236:         )
237: 
238:     vertex_path = Path(target).resolve()
239:     current_text = vertex_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
240:     loop_def = definition or _default_loop_def()
241: 
242:     try:
243:         if op == "add":
244:             new_text = add_vertex_kind(current_text, kind_name, loop_def)
245:         elif op == "edit":
246:             new_text = edit_vertex_kind(current_text, kind_name, loop_def)
247:         elif op == "remove":
248:             new_text = remove_vertex_kind(current_text, kind_name)
249:         else:
250:             raise SdkValueError(
251:                 f"unsupported mutation op '{op}', expected 'add', 'edit', or 'remove'"
252:             )
253:     except SdkValueError:
254:         raise
255:     except ValueError as exc:
256:         # lang refused the mutation (duplicate add, missing edit/remove target, ...).
257:         # A plan is a preview of applicability, so a describable refusal is a
258:         # non-applicable plan, not an exception — the apply paths raise CeremonyFailed.
259:         return DeclarationPlanResult(
260:             applicable=False,
261:             reason=str(exc),
262:             mode="refused",
263:             vertex_path=str(vertex_path),
264:             generation_before=None,
265:             changes=[],
266:         )
267: 
268:     preview = plan_declaration_update(vertex_path, proposed_text=new_text)
269:     return DeclarationPlanResult(
270:         applicable=preview.applicable,
271:         reason=preview.reason,
272:         mode=preview.mode,
273:         vertex_path=str(vertex_path),
274:         generation_before=preview.generation,
275:         changes=[c.as_dict() if hasattr(c, "as_dict") else str(c) for c in preview.changes],
276:     )

279: def add_kind(
280:     target: Path | str,
281:     kind_name: str,
282:     definition: LoopDef | None = None,
283:     *,
284:     observer: str,
285:     credentials: CredentialProvider | None = None,
286:     registry: BackendRegistry | None = None,
287: ) -> KindMutationResult:
288:     """Add a new loop-kind definition to a vertex and orchestrate declaration persistence.
289: 
290:     Parameters:
291:         target: Path to the .vertex file.
292:         kind_name: The name of the kind to add.
293:         definition: LoopDef AST node (defaults to items 'collect' 100).
294:         observer: Authorship identity performing the declaration update.
295:         credentials: Key provider for signing the ceremony.
296: 
297:     Returns:
298:         KindMutationResult detailing the preview, apply status, and updated generation.
299:     """
300:     vertex_path = Path(target).resolve()
301:     arrival = _arrival_descriptor_for(vertex_path)
302:     if arrival is None:
303:         _refuse_legacy_mapped_credentials(credentials, vertex=vertex_path)
304:         info = resolve_target(target)
305:         if info.target_type != "vertex":
306:             raise TargetUnsupported(f"add_kind requires a .vertex target, got {info.target_type}")
307:     loop_def = definition or _default_loop_def()
308:     cred_provider = credentials or CustodyCredentialProvider()
309: 
310:     current_text = vertex_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
311:     try:
312:         new_text = add_vertex_kind(current_text, kind_name, loop_def)
313:     except Exception as exc:
314:         if arrival is not None:
315:             raise SdkValueError(f"could not generate Arrival kind mutation: {exc}") from exc
316:         raise CeremonyFailed(f"could not generate kind mutation: {exc}") from exc
317: 
318:     if arrival is not None:
319:         from .declare import _edit_arrival_declaration
320: 
321:         return _edit_arrival_declaration(
322:             vertex_path, new_text, observer=observer, credentials=cred_provider,
323:             registry=registry,
324:             source_cache_bytes=current_text.encode("utf-8"),
325:             require_cache_basis=True,
326:         )
327: 
328:     preview = plan_declaration_update(vertex_path, proposed_text=new_text)
329:     if not preview.applicable:
330:         raise CeremonyFailed(f"declaration update not applicable: {preview.reason}")
331: 
332:     result = apply_declaration_update(preview, observer=observer, credentials=cred_provider)
333:     if result.status not in ("applied", "noop"):
334:         raise CeremonyFailed(f"declaration update failed ({result.status}): {result.reason}")
335: 
336:     from engine.declaration import declaration_generation
337: 
338:     gen_after = declaration_generation(vertex_path)
339: 
340:     return _legacy_result(KindMutationResult(
341:         status=result.status,
342:         reason=result.reason,
343:         mode=preview.mode,
344:         vertex_path=str(vertex_path),
345:         generation_before=preview.generation,
346:         generation_after=gen_after,
347:         changes=[c.as_dict() if hasattr(c, "as_dict") else str(c) for c in preview.changes],
348:         file_written=result.file_written,
349:     ))

475: def grant_observer(
476:     target: Path | str,
477:     observer_name: str,
478:     *,
479:     grants: Sequence[str] | None = None,
480:     identity: str | None = None,
481:     key: str | None = None,
482:     observer: str,
483:     credentials: CredentialProvider | None = None,
484:     registry: BackendRegistry | None = None,
485: ) -> KindMutationResult:
486:     """Add or update an observer in the vertex's admission block via ceremony.
487: 
488:     Parameters:
489:         target: Path to the .vertex file.
490:         observer_name: Name of the observer to declare/grant.
491:         grants: List of kind names this observer is allowed to emit.
492:         identity: Optional backing vertex identity store name.
493:         key: Optional base64 public key (if omitted, ensured via custody).
494:         observer: Authorship identity performing the declaration update.
495:         credentials: Key provider for signing the ceremony.
496: 
497:     Returns:
498:         KindMutationResult detailing the applied ceremony outcome.
499:     """
500:     vertex_path = Path(target).resolve()
501:     arrival = _arrival_descriptor_for(vertex_path)
502:     if arrival is None:
503:         _refuse_legacy_mapped_credentials(credentials, vertex=vertex_path)
504:         info = resolve_target(target)
505:         if info.target_type != "vertex":
506:             raise TargetUnsupported(
507:                 f"grant_observer requires a .vertex target, got {info.target_type}"
508:             )
509:     cred_provider = credentials or CustodyCredentialProvider()
510: 
511:     if key is None:
512:         mapped = getattr(cred_provider, "mapped", False)
513:         if arrival is not None and not mapped:
514:             # A wrapper need not expose a provider-level marker. Classify its
515:             # actual write configuration before the legacy custody helper can
516:             # mint a key for this requested observer.
517:             from .declare import _arrival_credentials
518: 
519:             mapped = _arrival_credentials(vertex_path, cred_provider).mapped
520:         if mapped:
521:             raise SdkValueError(
522:                 "mapped observer grants require an explicitly pre-created binding public key"
523:             )
524:         from custody import ensure_signing_key
525: 
526:         try:
527:             keypair = ensure_signing_key(vertex_path, observer=observer_name)
528:         except ValueError as exc:
529:             if arrival is not None:
530:                 raise SdkValueError(f"could not prepare Arrival observer grant: {exc}") from exc
531:             raise CeremonyFailed(f"could not splice observer grant: {exc}") from exc
532:         pub_key = keypair.public_b64
533:     else:
534:         pub_key = key
535: 
536:     current_text = vertex_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
537:     try:
538:         new_text = upsert_vertex_observer(
539:             current_text,
540:             observer_name,
541:             identity=identity,
542:             key=pub_key,
543:             grants=tuple(grants) if grants else (),
544:         )
545:     except Exception as exc:
546:         if arrival is not None:
547:             raise SdkValueError(f"could not generate Arrival observer grant: {exc}") from exc
548:         raise CeremonyFailed(f"could not splice observer grant: {exc}") from exc
549: 
550:     if arrival is not None:
551:         from .declare import _edit_arrival_declaration
552: 
553:         return _edit_arrival_declaration(
554:             vertex_path, new_text, observer=observer, credentials=cred_provider,
555:             registry=registry,
556:             source_cache_bytes=current_text.encode("utf-8"),
557:             require_cache_basis=True,
558:         )
559: 
560:     preview = plan_declaration_update(vertex_path, proposed_text=new_text)
561:     if not preview.applicable:
562:         raise CeremonyFailed(f"declaration update not applicable: {preview.reason}")
563: 
564:     result = apply_declaration_update(preview, observer=observer, credentials=cred_provider)
565:     if result.status not in ("applied", "noop"):
566:         raise CeremonyFailed(f"declaration update failed ({result.status}): {result.reason}")
567: 
568:     from engine.declaration import declaration_generation
569: 
570:     gen_after = declaration_generation(vertex_path)
571: 
572:     return _legacy_result(KindMutationResult(
573:         status=result.status,
574:         reason=result.reason,
575:         mode=preview.mode,
576:         vertex_path=str(vertex_path),
577:         generation_before=preview.generation,
578:         generation_after=gen_after,
579:         changes=[c.as_dict() if hasattr(c, "as_dict") else str(c) for c in preview.changes],
580:         file_written=result.file_written,
581:     ))
582: 
583: 
584: def revoke_observer(
585:     target: Path | str,
586:     observer_name: str,
587:     *,
588:     observer: str,
589:     credentials: CredentialProvider | None = None,
590:     registry: BackendRegistry | None = None,
591: ) -> KindMutationResult:
592:     """Remove an observer from the vertex's declared admission block via ceremony."""
593:     vertex_path = Path(target).resolve()
594:     arrival = _arrival_descriptor_for(vertex_path)
595:     if arrival is None:
596:         _refuse_legacy_mapped_credentials(credentials, vertex=vertex_path)
597:         info = resolve_target(target)
598:         if info.target_type != "vertex":
599:             raise TargetUnsupported(
600:                 f"revoke_observer requires a .vertex target, got {info.target_type}"
601:             )
602:     cred_provider = credentials or CustodyCredentialProvider()
603: 
604:     current_text = vertex_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
605:     try:
606:         new_text = remove_vertex_observer(current_text, observer_name)
607:     except ValueError as exc:
608:         if arrival is not None:
609:             raise SdkValueError(f"could not generate Arrival observer removal: {exc}") from exc
610:         raise CeremonyFailed(f"could not remove observer '{observer_name}': {exc}") from exc
611: 
612:     if arrival is not None:
613:         from .declare import _edit_arrival_declaration
614: 
615:         return _edit_arrival_declaration(
616:             vertex_path, new_text, observer=observer, credentials=cred_provider,
617:             registry=registry,
618:             source_cache_bytes=current_text.encode("utf-8"),
619:             require_cache_basis=True,
620:         )
621: 
622:     preview = plan_declaration_update(vertex_path, proposed_text=new_text)
623:     if not preview.applicable:
624:         raise CeremonyFailed(f"declaration update not applicable: {preview.reason}")
625: 
626:     result = apply_declaration_update(preview, observer=observer, credentials=cred_provider)
627:     if result.status not in ("applied", "noop"):
628:         raise CeremonyFailed(f"declaration update failed ({result.status}): {result.reason}")
629: 
630:     from engine.declaration import declaration_generation
631: 
632:     gen_after = declaration_generation(vertex_path)
633: 
634:     return _legacy_result(KindMutationResult(
635:         status=result.status,
636:         reason=result.reason,
637:         mode=preview.mode,
638:         vertex_path=str(vertex_path),
639:         generation_before=preview.generation,
640:         generation_after=gen_after,
641:         changes=[c.as_dict() if hasattr(c, "as_dict") else str(c) for c in preview.changes],
642:         file_written=result.file_written,
643:     ))
644: 
645: 
646: def recover_ceremony(
647:     intent_path: Path | str,
648:     *,
649:     registry: BackendRegistry | None = None,
650: ) -> dict[str, Any]:
651:     """Recover an interrupted legacy or explicit Arrival ceremony."""
652:     try:
653:         import json
654: 
655:         intent = Path(intent_path).resolve()
656:         data = json.loads(intent.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
657:         if data.get("schema") == "loops.engine/arrival-declaration-intent/v1":
658:             from .declare import recover_declaration
659: 
660:             return recover_declaration(intent, registry=registry).as_dict()
661:     except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
662:         pass
663:     outcome = recover_declaration_update(intent_path)
664:     return {
665:         "classification": outcome.classification,
666:         "finished": outcome.finished,
667:         "reason": outcome.reason,
668:         "intent_path": str(outcome.intent_path),
669:     }

150: def _latest_timestamp(kinds: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]]) -> float | None:
151:     latest: list[float] = []
152:     for stats in kinds.values():
153:         value = stats.get("latest")
154:         if isinstance(value, datetime):
155:             latest.append(value.timestamp())
156:         elif isinstance(value, (int, float)):
157:             latest.append(float(value))
158:         elif isinstance(value, str):
159:             with contextlib.suppress(ValueError, TypeError):
160:                 latest.append(datetime.fromisoformat(value).timestamp())
161:     return max(latest) if latest else None

164: def _arrival_generation(
165:     ast: Any,
166:     facts: tuple[Fact, ...],
167:     own_lineage: str,
168:     declaration_status: str,
169:     runtime_epoch: Any,
170: ) -> dict[str, Any]:
171:     """Build the established declaration-generation review fields from one snapshot."""
172:     documents = vertex_to_documents(ast)
173:     canonical = json.dumps(
174:         [document.as_json() for document in documents],
175:         sort_keys=True,
176:         separators=(",", ":"),
177:     )
178:     declaration_head = None
179:     if declaration_status == "store":
180:         declaration_head = own_lineage
181:         for fact in sorted(facts, key=lambda item: (item.arrival_ordinal, item.arrival_seq)):
182:             if not fact.kind.startswith("_decl."):
183:                 continue
184:             if fact.id == own_lineage or fact.payload.get("lineage") == own_lineage:
185:                 declaration_head = fact.id
186:     return {
187:         "status": declaration_status,
188:         "lineage": own_lineage,
189:         "review_fingerprint": "sha256:"
190:         + hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
191:         "decl_head": declaration_head,
192:         "runtime_epoch": {
193:             "mode": runtime_epoch.mode,
194:             "anchor_ordinal": runtime_epoch.start_ordinal,
195:         },
196:     }

199: def _arrival_declaration(
200:     locator_ast: Any,
201:     target_path: Path,
202:     opened: Any,
203:     *,
204:     include_user_facts: bool = False,
205:     allow_aggregate: bool = False,
206: ) -> tuple[Any, str, tuple[Fact, ...], str]:
207:     """Resolve effective declarations from the same bounded read snapshot."""
208:     facts = opened.snapshot.facts(
209:         FactRequest(
210:             limit=None,
211:             kind=None if include_user_facts else "_decl",
212:             include_internal=True,
213:             order="oldest",
214:         )
215:     ).items
216:     anchor = opened.snapshot.declaration_anchor
217:     documents = resolve_declaration_documents_from_snapshot(anchor, facts)
218:     if documents is None:
219:         raise SdkError(
220:             "the Arrival snapshot has no adopted declaration; refusing to "
221:             "substitute the current vertex file as store history"
222:         )
223:     status = "unhistorized" if isinstance(documents, Unhistorized) else "store"
224:     document_rows = documents.documents if isinstance(documents, Unhistorized) else documents
225:     effective_ast = documents_to_vertex(
226:         document_rows,
227:         path=target_path,
228:         store=locator_ast.store,
229:         store_backend=locator_ast.store_backend,
230:         store_location=locator_ast.store_location,
231:     )
232:     if not allow_aggregate and (
233:         effective_ast.combine is not None or effective_ast.discover is not None
234:     ):
235:         raise TargetUnsupported(
236:             "the bounded Arrival declaration is an aggregate; member-basis reads "
237:             "are not implemented in this single-store stage"
238:         )
239:     if anchor.own_lineage is None:
240:         raise SdkError("resolved declaration has no own lineage anchor")
241:     return effective_ast, status, facts, anchor.own_lineage

279: def _check_declared_ordering(ordering: Ordering | None, *, single_store: bool) -> None:
280:     """Validate a declared read ordering against the axis this page path serves.
281: 
282:     ``None`` is the whole of today's behavior: the defaults are already what the
283:     paged read paths serve, so nothing reroutes. A DECLARED ordering must resolve
284:     to that same axis — ``Arrival()`` single-store, ``ByKey('ts')`` aggregate,
285:     with ``Arrival()`` on an aggregate refused by the one engine resolver. Any
286:     other declared ordering is refused rather than approximated: ordering-aware
287:     witness pagination is not this cut.
288: 
289:     Raises:
290:         SdkValueError: The ordering is refused, or names an axis paged reads do
291:             not serve this cut.
292:     """
293:     if ordering is None:
294:         return
295:     try:
296:         resolved = resolve_ordering(ordering, single_store=single_store)
297:     except OrderingError as exc:
298:         raise SdkValueError(str(exc)) from exc
299:     served = resolve_ordering(None, single_store=single_store)
300:     if resolved != served:
301:         raise SdkValueError(
302:             f"ordering {ordering!r} is not supported on a paged read this cut: "
303:             f"this path serves {served!r}. Declare that, or omit ordering."
304:         )

318: def _compute_summary_stats(
319:     reader: StoreReader,
320:     *,
321:     include_internal: bool = False,
322: ) -> tuple[int, int, float | None, dict[str, dict[str, Any]], tuple[int, int] | None]:
323:     """Extract factual totals, tick counts, time bounds, and attestation metrics."""
324:     raw_summary = reader.summary(include_internal=include_internal)
325:     fact_total = raw_summary.get("facts", {}).get("total", 0)
326:     tick_total = raw_summary.get("ticks", {}).get("total", 0)
327:     kinds_dict = raw_summary.get("facts", {}).get("kinds", {})
328: 
329:     all_latest: list[float] = []
330:     kinds: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
331:     for k, stats in kinds_dict.items():
332:         earliest_iso = stats.get("earliest")
333:         latest_iso = stats.get("latest")
334:         if latest_iso is not None:
335:             if isinstance(latest_iso, datetime):
336:                 all_latest.append(latest_iso.timestamp())
337:             elif isinstance(latest_iso, (int, float)):
338:                 all_latest.append(float(latest_iso))
339:             elif isinstance(latest_iso, str):
340:                 with contextlib.suppress(ValueError, TypeError):
341:                     all_latest.append(datetime.fromisoformat(latest_iso).timestamp())
342:         kinds[k] = {
343:             "count": stats.get("count", 0),
344:             "earliest": earliest_iso,
345:             "latest": latest_iso,
346:         }
347: 
348:     latest_ts = max(all_latest) if all_latest else None
349:     signed_counts = reader.signed_counts()
350:     return fact_total, tick_total, latest_ts, kinds, signed_counts

357:     registry: BackendRegistry | None,

363: 
364: def _aggregate_summary_from(
365:     aggregate: Any, target_path: Path, *, include_internal: bool
366: ) -> ReadSummary:
367:     kinds: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
368:     ticks: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
369:     fact_total = tick_total = signed_count = unsigned_count = 0
370:     for member in aggregate.capture.members:
371:         raw = member.snapshot.summary(SummaryRequest(include_internal=include_internal))
372:         fact_total += raw.fact_total
373:         tick_total += raw.tick_total
374:         signed_count += raw.signed_count
375:         unsigned_count += raw.unsigned_count
376:         for name, stats in raw.fact_kinds.items():
377:             target = kinds.setdefault(name, {"count": 0, "earliest": None, "latest": None})
378:             target["count"] += stats.get("count", 0)
379:             for edge, reducer in (("earliest", min), ("latest", max)):
380:                 value = stats.get(edge)
381:                 if value is not None:
382:                     target[edge] = value if target[edge] is None else reducer(target[edge], value)
383:         for name, stats in raw.tick_names.items():
384:             target = ticks.setdefault(name, {"count": 0, "earliest": None, "latest": None})
385:             target["count"] += stats.get("count", 0)
386:             for edge, reducer in (("earliest", min), ("latest", max)):
387:                 value = stats.get(edge)
388:                 if value is not None:
389:                     target[edge] = value if target[edge] is None else reducer(target[edge], value)
390:     return ReadSummary(
391:             read_path="arrival-aggregate",
392:             target_type="vertex",
393:             target_path=str(target_path),
394:             fact_total=fact_total,
395:             tick_total=tick_total,
396:             latest_ts=_latest_timestamp(kinds),
397:             kinds=kinds,
398:             ticks=ticks,
399:             agreement=None,
400:             declaration_status="aggregate-captured",
401:             unfolded_kinds=[
402:                 name
403:                 for name in kinds
404:                 if name not in aggregate.specs() and not name.startswith("_decl.")
405:             ],
406:             signed_count=signed_count,
407:             unsigned_count=unsigned_count,
408:             aggregate_members=aggregate.member_evidence(),
409:             aggregate_definitions=aggregate.definition_evidence(),
410:     )

415: ) -> FoldStateResult:

418:         return _aggregate_state_from(

427: def _aggregate_state_from(
428:     aggregate: Any,
429:     target_path: Path,
430:     *,
431:     kind: str | None,
432:     observer: str | None,
433:     runtime_epoch_only: bool = False,
434: ) -> FoldStateResult:
435:     specs = aggregate.specs()
436:     sections: dict[str, Any] = {}
437:     for section_name, spec in specs.items():
438:         if kind is not None and section_name != kind:
439:             continue
440:         payloads: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
441:         for fact in aggregate.ordered_for_kind(
442:             section_name,
443:             observer=observer,
444:             runtime_epoch_only=runtime_epoch_only,
445:         ):
446:             payload = dict(fact.payload)
447:             payload.update(
448:                 {
449:                     "_ts": fact.ts,
450:                     "_observer": fact.observer,
451:                     "_origin": fact.origin,
452:                     "_id": fact.id,
453:                 }
454:             )
455:             payloads.append(payload)
456:         sections[section_name] = _serialize_fold_section(spec.replay(payloads))
457:     return FoldStateResult(
458:             read_path="arrival-aggregate",
459:             vertex_name=aggregate.root.effective_declaration.name,
460:             target_path=str(target_path),
461:             declaration_status="aggregate-captured",
462:             generation={
463:                 "status": "aggregate",
464:                 "member_count": len(aggregate.capture.members),
465:                 "runtime_epochs": [
466:                     {
467:                         "lineage": member.basis.lineage,
468:                         "mode": member.runtime_epoch.mode,
469:                         "anchor_ordinal": member.runtime_epoch.start_ordinal,
470:                     }
471:                     for member in aggregate.capture.members
472:                 ],
473:             },
474:             sections=sections,
475:             aggregate_members=aggregate.member_evidence(),
476:             aggregate_definitions=aggregate.definition_evidence(),
477:     )

480: def _aggregate_timeline(
481:     target_path: Path,
482:     *,
483:     start_ts: float | None,
484:     end_ts: float | None,
485:     limit: int,
486:     order: str,
487:     registry: BackendRegistry | None,
488: ) -> TimelineResult:
489:     """Timestamp lens over retained member snapshots; it does not fold rows."""
490:     with open_aggregate_read(target_path, registry=registry) as aggregate:
491:         return _aggregate_timeline_from(
492:             aggregate,
493:             start_ts=start_ts,
494:             end_ts=end_ts,

499: 
500: def _aggregate_timeline_from(
501:     aggregate: Any,
502:     *,
503:     start_ts: float | None,
504:     end_ts: float | None,
505:     limit: int,
506:     order: str,
507: ) -> TimelineResult:
508:     since = start_ts if start_ts is not None else 0.0
509:     until = end_ts if end_ts is not None else float("inf")
510:     events = [
511:             TimelineEvent(
512:                 event_type=event_type,
513:                 id=row.id,
514:                 kind_or_name=row.kind if event_type == "fact" else row.name,
515:                 ts=row.ts,
516:                 observer=row.observer if event_type == "fact" else "",
517:                 origin=row.origin,
518:                 payload=dict(row.payload),
519:             )
520:         for event_type, _member, row in aggregate.all_events(start=since, end=until)
521:     ]
522:     if order == "newest":
523:         events.reverse()
524:     return TimelineResult(
525:             read_path="arrival-aggregate",
526:             events=events[:limit],
527:             start_ts=start_ts,
528:             end_ts=end_ts,
529:             total_events=len(events),
530:             truncated=len(events) > limit,
531:             order=order,
532:             aggregate_members=aggregate.member_evidence(),
533:             aggregate_definitions=aggregate.definition_evidence(),
534:     )

537: def read_summary(
538:     target: Path | str,
539:     *,
540:     include_internal: bool = False,
541:     registry: BackendRegistry | None = None,
542: ) -> ReadSummary:
543:     """Read domain-neutral statistical inventory of a target artifact.
544: 
545:     Parameters:
546:         target: Path to .vertex, .jsonl, or .db artifact.
547:         include_internal: Whether to include reserved `_decl.*` kinds.
548: 
549:     Returns:
550:         ReadSummary containing fact/tick totals, kind distribution, and agreement.
551:     """
552:     target_path = Path(target).resolve()
553:     if has_local_descriptor_aggregate(target_path):
554:         return _aggregate_summary(
555:             target_path, include_internal=include_internal, registry=registry
556:         )
557:     arrival = _aggregate_aware_arrival_descriptor(target_path)
558:     if arrival is not None:
559:         with _open_arrival_read(arrival, registry=registry) as (
560:             locator_ast,
561:             descriptor,
562:             opened,
563:         ):
564:             raw = opened.snapshot.summary(
565:                 SummaryRequest(include_internal=include_internal)
566:             )
567:             effective_ast, declaration_status, _facts, _own_lineage = _arrival_declaration(
568:                 locator_ast, target_path, opened, allow_aggregate=True
569:             )
570:             if effective_ast.combine is not None or effective_ast.discover is not None:
571:                 with open_aggregate_read(
572:                     target_path, registry=registry, opened_root=opened
573:                 ) as aggregate:
574:                     return _aggregate_summary_from(
575:                         aggregate, target_path, include_internal=include_internal
576:                     )
577:             kinds = {name: dict(stats) for name, stats in raw.fact_kinds.items()}
578:             return ReadSummary(
579:                 read_path="arrival",
580:                 basis=opened.basis,
581:                 store=StoreDescriptorInfo.from_descriptor(descriptor),
582:                 target_type="vertex",
583:                 target_path=str(target_path),
584:                 fact_total=raw.fact_total,
585:                 tick_total=raw.tick_total,
586:                 latest_ts=_latest_timestamp(raw.fact_kinds),
587:                 kinds=kinds,
588:                 ticks={name: dict(stats) for name, stats in raw.tick_names.items()},
589:                 agreement=None,
590:                 declaration_status=declaration_status,
591:                 unfolded_kinds=[
592:                     name
593:                     for name in kinds
594:                     if name not in effective_ast.loops and not name.startswith("_decl.")
595:                 ],
596:                 signed_count=raw.signed_count,
597:                 unsigned_count=raw.unsigned_count,
598:             )
599: 
600:     _refuse_arrival_aggregate_members(target_path)
601:     info = resolve_target(target)
602:     if info.target_type == "vertex":
603:         decl_ast, decl_status = load_declaration_status(target_path)
604:         is_aggregate = decl_ast is not None and (
605:             decl_ast.combine is not None or decl_ast.discover is not None
606:         )
607: 
608:         if not is_aggregate and (info.canonical_path is None or not info.canonical_path.exists()):
609:             return ReadSummary(
610:                 target_type="vertex",
611:                 target_path=str(target_path),
612:                 canonical_mode=info.canonical_mode or "unknown",
613:                 canonical_path=str(info.canonical_path) if info.canonical_path else None,
614:                 index_path=str(info.index_path) if info.index_path else None,
615:                 declaration_status=decl_status or "unknown",
616:                 fact_total=0,
617:                 tick_total=0,
618:                 latest_ts=None,
619:                 kinds={},
620:                 unfolded_kinds=[],
621:                 agreement=True,
622:                 signed_count=0,
623:                 unsigned_count=0,
624:             )
625: 
626:         if is_aggregate:
627:             raw_sum = vertex_summary(target_path, include_internal=include_internal)
628:             fact_total = raw_sum.get("facts", {}).get("total", 0)
629:             tick_total = raw_sum.get("ticks", {}).get("total", 0)
630:             kinds_raw = raw_sum.get("facts", {}).get("kinds", {})
631:             kinds = {
632:                 k: {
633:                     "count": v.get("count", 0),
634:                     "earliest": v.get("earliest"),
635:                     "latest": v.get("latest"),
636:                 }
637:                 for k, v in kinds_raw.items()
638:             }
639:             return ReadSummary(
640:                 target_type="vertex",
641:                 target_path=str(target_path),
642:                 canonical_mode=info.canonical_mode or "aggregate",
643:                 canonical_path=str(info.canonical_path) if info.canonical_path else None,
644:                 index_path=str(info.index_path) if info.index_path else None,
645:                 declaration_status=decl_status or "aggregate-head",
646:                 fact_total=fact_total,
647:                 tick_total=tick_total,
648:                 latest_ts=None,
649:                 kinds=kinds,
650:                 unfolded_kinds=[],
651:                 agreement=True,
652:                 signed_count=0,
653:                 unsigned_count=fact_total,
654:             )
655: 
656:         canonical = info.canonical_path or target_path
657:         index_path = info.index_path or canonical
658:         reader, agreed = _ensure_reader(canonical, index_path)
659:         try:
660:             fact_total, tick_total, latest_ts, kinds, signed_counts = _compute_summary_stats(
661:                 reader, include_internal=include_internal
662:             )
663:             unfolded = [
664:                 k
665:                 for k in kinds
666:                 if decl_ast is not None and k not in decl_ast.loops and not k.startswith("_decl.")
667:             ]
668:             # signed_counts is (signed, TOTAL) — unsigned is the difference
669:             signed_count = signed_counts[0] if signed_counts else 0
670:             unsigned_count = (signed_counts[1] - signed_counts[0]) if signed_counts else 0
671: 
672:             return ReadSummary(
673:                 target_type="vertex",
674:                 target_path=str(target_path),
675:                 canonical_mode=info.canonical_mode or "unknown",
676:                 canonical_path=str(canonical),
677:                 index_path=str(index_path),
678:                 declaration_status=decl_status or "unknown",
679:                 fact_total=fact_total,
680:                 tick_total=tick_total,
681:                 latest_ts=latest_ts,
682:                 kinds=kinds,
683:                 unfolded_kinds=unfolded,
684:                 agreement=agreed,
685:                 signed_count=signed_count,
686:                 unsigned_count=unsigned_count,
687:             )
688:         finally:
689:             reader.close()
690: 
691:     # Bare store (.jsonl or .db)
692:     canonical = info.canonical_path or target_path
693:     index_path = info.index_path or canonical
694:     reader, agreed = _ensure_reader(canonical, index_path)
695:     try:
696:         fact_total, tick_total, latest_ts, kinds, signed_counts = _compute_summary_stats(
697:             reader, include_internal=include_internal
698:         )
699:         # signed_counts is (signed, TOTAL) — unsigned is the difference
700:         signed_count = signed_counts[0] if signed_counts else 0
701:         unsigned_count = (signed_counts[1] - signed_counts[0]) if signed_counts else 0
702: 
703:         return ReadSummary(
704:             target_type=info.target_type,
705:             target_path=str(target_path),
706:             canonical_mode=info.canonical_mode or "unknown",
707:             canonical_path=str(canonical),
708:             index_path=str(index_path),
709:             declaration_status=None,
710:             fact_total=fact_total,
711:             tick_total=tick_total,
712:             latest_ts=latest_ts,
713:             kinds=kinds,
714:             unfolded_kinds=[],
715:             agreement=agreed,
716:             signed_count=signed_count,
717:             unsigned_count=unsigned_count,
718:         )
719:     finally:
720:         reader.close()
721: 
722: 
723: def read_facts(
724:     target: Path | str,
725:     *,
726:     limit: int = 50,
727:     kind: str | None = None,
728:     observer: str | None = None,
729:     order: str = "newest",
730:     ordering: Ordering | None = None,
731:     before: str | Continuation | None = None,
732:     after: str | Continuation | None = None,
733:     include_internal: bool = False,
734:     registry: BackendRegistry | None = None,
735: ) -> FactPageResult:
736:     """Read a bounded page of facts with stable witness pagination cursors.
737: 
738:     Parameters:
739:         target: Path to .vertex, .jsonl, or .db artifact.
740:         limit: Maximum number of facts to return.
741:         kind: Optional kind filter.
742:         observer: Optional observer identity filter.
743:         order: Sort direction along the ordering axis — 'oldest' ascending,
744:             'newest' descending.
745:         ordering: Declared read ordering. ``None`` keeps today's axis: receipt
746:             order for a single-store vertex, the ``(ts, id)`` read lens for an
747:             aggregate. Declaring ``Arrival()`` on a multi-store aggregate is
748:             refused — see :func:`engine.vertex_reader.resolve_ordering`. Only
749:             the resolved default axis is supported this cut; any other declared
750:             ordering is refused rather than silently approximated.
751:         before: Cursor token to fetch rows before (older than) the cursor in newest order.
752:         after: Cursor token to fetch rows after (newer than) the cursor in oldest order.
753:         include_internal: Whether to include internal `_decl.*` facts.
754: 
755:     Returns:
756:         FactPageResult containing deserialized fact items and pagination metadata.
757:     """
758:     if order not in ("newest", "oldest"):
759:         raise SdkValueError(f"invalid order '{order}': expected 'newest' or 'oldest'")
760: 
761:     target_path = Path(target).resolve()
762:     arrival = _arrival_descriptor(target_path)
763:     if arrival is not None:
764:         if before is not None and after is not None:
765:             raise SdkValueError("before and after are mutually exclusive")
766:         token = before if before is not None else after
767:         if token is not None and not isinstance(token, Continuation):
768:             raise SdkValueError(
769:                 "descriptor-first reads require the Continuation returned by a prior page"
770:             )
771:         if before is not None and order != "newest":
772:             raise SdkValueError("before continuation requires order='newest'")
773:         if after is not None and order != "oldest":
774:             raise SdkValueError("after continuation requires order='oldest'")
775:         request = FactRequest(
776:             limit=limit,
777:             kind=kind,
778:             observer=observer,
779:             order=order,
780:             include_internal=include_internal,
781:         )
782:         with _open_arrival_read(
783:             arrival, registry=registry, continuation=token
784:         ) as (locator_ast, descriptor, opened):
785:             if token is None:
786:                 _arrival_declaration(locator_ast, target_path, opened)
787:             page = opened.snapshot.facts(request)
788:             next_cursor = opened.continuation(request, page)
789:             return FactPageResult(
790:                 read_path="arrival",
791:                 basis=opened.basis,
792:                 store=StoreDescriptorInfo.from_descriptor(descriptor),
793:                 items=[_fact_as_dict(fact) for fact in page.items],
794:                 next_cursor=next_cursor,
795:                 prev_cursor=None,
796:                 truncated=page.truncated,
797:                 order=page.order,
798:             )
799: 
800:     _refuse_arrival_aggregate_members(target_path)
801:     info = resolve_target(target)
802:     if isinstance(before, Continuation) or isinstance(after, Continuation):
803:         raise SdkValueError(
804:             "Arrival Continuation values cannot be used on a legacy read path"
805:         )
806: 
807:     if info.target_type == "vertex":
808:         decl_ast, _ = load_declaration_status(target_path)
809:         is_aggregate = decl_ast is not None and (
810:             decl_ast.combine is not None or decl_ast.discover is not None
811:         )
812:         # read_facts keys on DECLARATION SHAPE, not member count: an aggregate's
813:         # page comes off the (ts, id) lens whatever its member count, so that is
814:         # the axis a declared ordering is checked against.
815:         _check_declared_ordering(ordering, single_store=not is_aggregate)
816: 
817:         if is_aggregate:
818:             # Multi-store aggregate vertex
819:             all_facts = vertex_facts(
820:                 target_path,
821:                 since_ts=0.0,
822:                 until_ts=float("inf"),
823:                 kind=kind,
824:                 observer=observer,
825:                 include_internal=include_internal,
826:             )
827:             if order == "newest":
828:                 all_facts = list(reversed(all_facts))
829: 
830:             capped = all_facts[:limit]
831:             truncated = len(all_facts) > len(capped)
832:             return FactPageResult(
833:                 items=capped,
834:                 next_cursor=None,
835:                 prev_cursor=None,
836:                 truncated=truncated,
837:                 order=order,
838:             )
839: 
840:         if info.canonical_path is None or not info.canonical_path.exists():
841:             return FactPageResult(
842:                 items=[],
843:                 next_cursor=None,
844:                 prev_cursor=None,
845:                 truncated=False,
846:                 order=order,
847:             )
848: 
849:         # Witness resolution reads the sqlite index, not the (possibly jsonl)
850:         # canonical log — passing the canonical raised DatabaseError on
851:         # jsonl-canonical vertices.
852:         witness_store = info.index_path or info.canonical_path
853:         before_pos = resolve_witness_position(witness_store, before) if before else None
854:         after_pos = resolve_witness_position(witness_store, after) if after else None
855: 
856:         page = vertex_query_facts(
857:             target_path,
858:             limit=limit,
859:             before=before_pos,
860:             after=after_pos,
861:             kind=kind,
862:             observer=observer,
863:             include_internal=include_internal,
864:             order=order,
865:         )
866:         next_tok = page.next.fact_id or f"seq:{page.next.seq}" if page.next is not None else None
867:         page_prev: Any = getattr(page, "prev", None)
868:         prev_tok = page_prev.fact_id or f"seq:{page_prev.seq}" if page_prev is not None else None
869:         return FactPageResult(
870:             items=page.items,
871:             next_cursor=next_tok,
872:             prev_cursor=prev_tok,
873:             truncated=page.truncated,
874:             order=order,
875:         )
876: 
877:     # A bare .db/.jsonl target is one store, so its axis is Arrival().
878:     _check_declared_ordering(ordering, single_store=True)
879: 
880:     canonical = info.canonical_path or target_path
881:     index_path = info.index_path or canonical
882: 
883:     reader, _ = _ensure_reader(canonical, index_path)
884:     try:
885:         # Same as the vertex branch: witness cursors resolve against the sqlite
886:         # index — after _ensure_reader, which builds it for bare jsonl targets.
887:         before_pos = resolve_witness_position(index_path, before) if before else None
888:         after_pos = resolve_witness_position(index_path, after) if after else None
889: 
890:         page = reader.query_facts(
891:             limit=limit,
892:             before=before_pos,
893:             after=after_pos,
894:             kind=kind,
895:             observer=observer,
896:             include_internal=include_internal,
897:             order=order,
898:         )
899:         next_tok = page.next.fact_id or f"seq:{page.next.seq}" if page.next is not None else None
900:         page_prev: Any = getattr(page, "prev", None)
901:         prev_tok = page_prev.fact_id or f"seq:{page_prev.seq}" if page_prev is not None else None
902: 
903:         return FactPageResult(
904:             items=page.items,
905:             next_cursor=next_tok,
906:             prev_cursor=prev_tok,
907:             truncated=page.truncated,
908:             order=order,
909:         )
910:     finally:
911:         reader.close()
912: 
913: 
914: def _tick_as_dict(t: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
915:     """Serialize a tick record: engine's Tick exposes to_dict(), not as_dict().
916: 
917:     The old ``dict(t)`` fallback raised TypeError on every real fired Tick.
918:     """
919:     if hasattr(t, "as_dict"):
920:         return t.as_dict()
921:     if hasattr(t, "to_dict"):
922:         return t.to_dict()
923:     return dict(t)
924: 
925: 
926: def _serialize_fold_item(item: Any) -> Any:
927:     """Serialize fold state item values cleanly."""
928:     if hasattr(item, "predicate") and hasattr(item, "address"):
929:         return {"predicate": item.predicate, "address": item.address}
930:     if hasattr(item, "as_dict"):
931:         return item.as_dict()
932:     if isinstance(item, Mapping):
933:         return {str(k): _serialize_fold_item(v) for k, v in item.items()}
934:     if hasattr(item, "__dict__"):
935:         return {str(k): _serialize_fold_item(v) for k, v in vars(item).items()}
936:     if isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
937:         return [_serialize_fold_item(x) for x in item]
938:     return item
939: 
940: 
941: def _serialize_fold_section(section: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
942:     """Serialize a single kind fold state section."""
943:     if hasattr(section, "as_dict"):
944:         raw = section.as_dict()
945:     elif isinstance(section, Mapping):
946:         raw = dict(section)
947:     elif hasattr(section, "__dict__"):
948:         raw = vars(section)
949:     else:
950:         raw = {"value": section}
951: 
952:     serialized: dict[str, Any] = {}
953:     for k, v in raw.items():
954:         serialized[str(k)] = _serialize_fold_item(v)
955:     return serialized
956: 
957: 
958: def read_state(
959:     target: Path | str,
960:     *,
961:     kind: str | None = None,
962:     observer: str | None = None,
963:     registry: BackendRegistry | None = None,
964: ) -> FoldStateResult:
965:     """Reconstruct live fold state by replaying facts through declared vertex folds.
966: 
967:     Parameters:
968:         target: Path to .vertex artifact.
969:         kind: Optional single-kind filter.
970:         observer: Optional observer view filter.
971: 
972:     Returns:
973:         FoldStateResult containing reconstructed state sections and generation info.
974:     """
975:     target_path = Path(target).resolve()
976:     if has_local_descriptor_aggregate(target_path):
977:         return _aggregate_state(
978:             target_path, kind=kind, observer=observer, registry=registry
979:         )
980:     arrival = _aggregate_aware_arrival_descriptor(target_path)
981:     if arrival is not None:
982:         with _open_arrival_read(arrival, registry=registry) as (
983:             locator_ast,
984:             descriptor,
985:             opened,
986:         ):
987:             effective_ast, declaration_status, facts, own_lineage = _arrival_declaration(
988:                 locator_ast,
989:                 target_path,
990:                 opened,
991:                 include_user_facts=True,
992:                 allow_aggregate=True,
993:             )
994:             runtime_epoch = opened.runtime_epoch()
995:             if effective_ast.combine is not None or effective_ast.discover is not None:
996:                 with open_aggregate_read(
997:                     target_path, registry=registry, opened_root=opened
998:                 ) as aggregate:
999:                     return _aggregate_state_from(
1000:                         aggregate,
1001:                         target_path,
1002:                         kind=kind,
1003:                         observer=observer,
1004:                         runtime_epoch_only=True,
1005:                     )
1006:             specs = compile_vertex(effective_ast)
1007:             sections: dict[str, Any] = {}
1008:             for section_name, spec in specs.items():
1009:                 if kind is not None and section_name != kind:
1010:                     continue
1011:                 selected = [
1012:                     fact
1013:                     for fact in facts
1014:                     if fact.kind == section_name
1015:                     and (
1016:                         runtime_epoch.start_ordinal is None
1017:                         or fact.arrival_ordinal > runtime_epoch.start_ordinal
1018:                     )
1019:                     and (observer is None or observer_matches(fact.observer, observer))
1020:                 ]
1021:                 payloads: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
1022:                 for fact in selected:
1023:                     payload = dict(fact.payload)
1024:                     payload.update(
1025:                         {
1026:                             "_ts": fact.ts,
1027:                             "_observer": fact.observer,
1028:                             "_origin": fact.origin,
1029:                             "_id": fact.id,
1030:                         }
1031:                     )
1032:                     payloads.append(payload)
1033:                 sections[section_name] = _serialize_fold_section(spec.replay(payloads))
1034: 
1035:             return FoldStateResult(
1036:                 read_path="arrival",
1037:                 basis=opened.basis,
1038:                 store=StoreDescriptorInfo.from_descriptor(descriptor),
1039:                 vertex_name=effective_ast.name,
1040:                 target_path=str(target_path),
1041:                 declaration_status=declaration_status,
1042:                 generation=_arrival_generation(
1043:                     effective_ast,
1044:                     facts,
1045:                     own_lineage,
1046:                     declaration_status,
1047:                     runtime_epoch,
1048:                 ),
1049:                 sections=sections,
1050:             )
1051: 
1052:     _refuse_arrival_aggregate_members(target_path)
1053:     info = resolve_target(target)
1054:     if info.target_type != "vertex":
1055:         raise TargetUnsupported(f"read_state requires a .vertex target, got {info.target_type}")
1056: 
1057:     decl_ast, decl_status = load_declaration_status(target_path)
1058:     vertex_path = target_path
1059: 
1060:     if info.canonical_path is None or not info.canonical_path.exists():
1061:         return FoldStateResult(
1062:             vertex_name=decl_ast.name if decl_ast else vertex_path.stem,
1063:             target_path=str(vertex_path),
1064:             declaration_status=decl_status or "unknown",
1065:             generation={},
1066:             sections={},
1067:         )
1068: 
1069:     state_dict = vertex_read(vertex_path, observer=observer)
1070:     if not isinstance(state_dict, dict):
1071:         state_dict = {}
1072: 
1073:     sections: dict[str, Any] = {}
1074:     for sec_name, sec_val in state_dict.items():
1075:         if kind is not None and sec_name != kind:
1076:             continue
1077:         sections[sec_name] = _serialize_fold_section(sec_val)
1078: 
1079:     gen = getattr(decl_ast, "generation", {}) if decl_ast else {}
1080: 
1081:     generation_as_dict = getattr(gen, "as_dict", None)
1082:     return FoldStateResult(
1083:         vertex_name=decl_ast.name if decl_ast else vertex_path.stem,
1084:         target_path=str(vertex_path),
1085:         declaration_status=decl_status or "unknown",
1086:         generation=generation_as_dict() if callable(generation_as_dict) else gen,
1087:         sections=sections,
1088:     )
1089: 
1090: 
1091: def read_ticks(
1092:     target: Path | str,
1093:     *,
1094:     name: str | None = None,
1095:     registry: BackendRegistry | None = None,
1096: ) -> TickReadResult:
1097:     """Read chronological tick seals and cadence boundaries.
1098: 
1099:     Parameters:
1100:         target: Path to .vertex, .jsonl, or .db artifact.
1101:         name: Optional tick mark name filter.
1102: 
1103:     Returns:
1104:         TickReadResult with chronological records and the read basis when the
1105:         target uses a descriptor-first Arrival store.
1106:     """
1107:     target_path = Path(target).resolve()
1108:     arrival = _arrival_descriptor(target_path)
1109:     if arrival is not None:
1110:         with _open_arrival_read(arrival, registry=registry) as (
1111:             locator_ast,
1112:             descriptor,
1113:             opened,
1114:         ):
1115:             _arrival_declaration(locator_ast, target_path, opened)
1116:             ticks = opened.snapshot.ticks(TickRequest(name=name))
1117:             return TickReadResult(
1118:                 read_path="arrival",
1119:                 basis=opened.basis,
1120:                 store=StoreDescriptorInfo.from_descriptor(descriptor),
1121:                 items=[_arrival_tick_as_dict(tick) for tick in ticks],
1122:             )
1123: 
1124:     _refuse_arrival_aggregate_members(target_path)
1125:     info = resolve_target(target)
1126: 
1127:     if info.target_type == "vertex":
1128:         decl_ast, _ = load_declaration_status(target_path)
1129:         is_aggregate = decl_ast is not None and (
1130:             decl_ast.combine is not None or decl_ast.discover is not None
1131:         )
1132:         if is_aggregate:
1133:             ticks = vertex_ticks(target_path, 0.0, float("inf"), name=name)
1134:             return TickReadResult(items=[_tick_as_dict(t) for t in ticks])
1135: 
1136:         if info.canonical_path is None or not info.canonical_path.exists():
1137:             return TickReadResult(items=[])
1138: 
1139:     canonical = info.canonical_path or target_path
1140:     index_path = info.index_path or canonical
1141:     reader, _ = _ensure_reader(canonical, index_path)
1142:     try:
1143:         ticks = reader.ticks_between(0.0, float("inf"), name=name)
1144:         return TickReadResult(items=[_tick_as_dict(t) for t in ticks])
1145:     finally:
1146:         reader.close()
1147: 
1148: 
1149: def read_fact_by_id(
1150:     target: Path | str,
1151:     fact_id: str,
1152:     *,
1153:     registry: BackendRegistry | None = None,
1154: ) -> FactLookupResult:
1155:     """Locate and return a single fact by its ULID identifier.
1156: 
1157:     Parameters:
1158:         target: Path to .vertex, .jsonl, or .db artifact.
1159:         fact_id: ULID or ID string of the target fact.
1160: 
1161:     Returns:
1162:         FactLookupResult retaining the read basis even when no fact matched.
1163:     """
1164:     target_path = Path(target).resolve()
1165:     arrival = _arrival_descriptor(target_path)
1166:     if arrival is not None:
1167:         request = FactRequest(limit=None, fact_id=fact_id)
1168:         with _open_arrival_read(arrival, registry=registry) as (
1169:             locator_ast,
1170:             descriptor,
1171:             opened,
1172:         ):
1173:             _arrival_declaration(locator_ast, target_path, opened)
1174:             matches = opened.snapshot.facts(request).items
1175:             if len(matches) > 1:
1176:                 raise SdkValueError(f"Ambiguous ID prefix: {fact_id!r}")
1177:             return FactLookupResult(
1178:                 read_path="arrival",
1179:                 basis=opened.basis,
1180:                 store=StoreDescriptorInfo.from_descriptor(descriptor),
1181:                 fact=None if not matches else _fact_as_dict(matches[0]),
1182:             )
1183: 
1184:     _refuse_arrival_aggregate_members(target_path)
1185:     info = resolve_target(target)
1186: 
1187:     if info.target_type == "vertex":
1188:         decl_ast, _ = load_declaration_status(target_path)
1189:         is_aggregate = decl_ast is not None and (
1190:             decl_ast.combine is not None or decl_ast.discover is not None
1191:         )
1192:         if is_aggregate:
1193:             return FactLookupResult(fact=vertex_fact_by_id(target_path, fact_id))
1194: 
1195:         if info.canonical_path is None or not info.canonical_path.exists():
1196:             return FactLookupResult(fact=None)
1197: 
1198:     canonical = info.canonical_path or target_path
1199:     index_path = info.index_path or canonical
1200:     reader, _ = _ensure_reader(canonical, index_path)
1201:     try:
1202:         return FactLookupResult(fact=reader.fact_by_id(fact_id))
1203:     finally:
1204:         reader.close()
